tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas brgal lan gsang gsum rdo rje'i snying po
༄༅/ /ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas brgal lan gsang gsum rdo rje'i snying po

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas brgal lan gsang gsum rdo rje'i snying po

mchog tu grub pa'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// "$ ༄༅// ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas brgal lan gsang gsum rdo rje'i snying po mchog tu grub pa'i gtam zhes bya ba dkar brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar rnam dpyod gsal ba'i me long du// ji snyed chos kyi ngang tshul kun 'phos pa// ji bzhin gzigs pa'i spyan ni lha yi lha// kun mkhyen 'brug pas rtag tu dge legs mdzod// sdom gsum nor gyis gang ba'i gan mdzod sgo// phye nas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin mkhan// sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying stobs la 'khu ba'i// bshes gnyen gzhan dag smyon pa'i brtul zhugs/'dzin// rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer yan lag bcas// srid gsum rnam par rgyal bas zos zin gyi// mngon rloms rdul phran brtsegs pa'i phrag gong du// 'dzegs pa'i 'od zer bdun pas ci zhig bya// blo gros nang gi nyin byed gzi 'bar bas// rnyog pa'i mun pa mthar byed nges gsang gi /snang ba 'bum phrag gcig car 'gyed nus pa'i// sngon med nam mkha'i nor bu 'di na rngom// 'on kyang 'od kyi pa tra 'bar bas mig /'phrog byed dang 'grogs gad mo'i dbyangs ldan la// legs bshad ltad mo lta ba'i skal med kyi// gzur gnas mkhyen yangs spyan gyis 'dir gzigs shig /ces ched du brjod nas/ skabs don/ sa dkar gyi mkhas pa rnams phyag rgya chen po las brtsams te 'bel mchid mang du gleng ba'i don la/ re zhig kho bos kyang rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' la zhib mor dpyad pa'i smra sgo/ mkhas pa la 'os pa'i tshig don snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur bag shin tu dod pas 'phral du nyams 'tshar la phugs su don bzang ba/ brjod tshul gyi sgo nas rgol ba dag la'ang bstod bsngags dang sun 'byin mi 'gal bar ston pa'i legs bshad rin po che'i do shal tshar du dngar te/ blo gsal gyi mgrin pa mdzes par byas pa la/

lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ci 'dra yang*/ mkhan chen bgres po'i sku'i skye ba de la thug pa'o zhes grags pa'i rjes su nye bar song ste/ go 'phang chen po la bzhugs su gsol phyin// dge 'dun gyi dbus su seng ge'i khri la rnam par 'gyings te/ yon bshad yongs su bsngo ba'i rim pa sogs rang gi bgo skal du thob pa'i legs mdzad lhur bzhes te sbyin pa po'i tshogs kyi zhing du lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa kho na mdzes shing spa ste/ ji skad du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ rgyal po lkog tu sbas na mdzes// sgyu ma brgya lam mthong na mdzes// zhes sogs gsungs pa dgongs yul rin po cher bzhugs nas mi chen gyi rdzu bag la brten par rigs pa las de bzhin mi mdzad par/ rang nyid dpon du bskos gyur na// de yi bya ba shes par dka'// gzhan la lta ba'i mig yod kyang*// rang nyid lta na me long dgos// zhes pa'i lung bstan dang du bzhes nas/ ji skad du/ srid gsum rnam rgyal las/ de la nyan byed lpags byi'u// gzur mi gnas pa'i smra sgo las// smra ba ngan pa'i bshang gci zung*// cig char mtshan mo'i thun mthar skyugs// zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smra yul gyi khrod rang gi ngang gis zhugs te/ sku tshe snga ma rang gi ngang tshul gzhan la ngom pa'i 'phro can rnams/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar dang bcas 'dir lhag lus med par gsal bar mdzad pa la bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'o dgongs nas/ rigs ngan mgu ba'i dmod tshigs bzhin du smre sngags brgya rtsa'i phreng ba ring du brgyus nas/ bod yul gyi mkhas grub kun las rang nyid ches lhag pa'o zhes mngon pa'i nga rgyal gzengs mtho ba'i sgo nas bdag nyid rgyas bshad kyis smra ba po nyid dam pa ma yin par bsgrub par kha byang yi ge bzhin du btab 'dug pa'i lan du/ phyi nang gang du'ang kha gtong ba'i las la nged khro phu ba rnams sbyangs stobs che ba lags pas smra ba'i sgo ma 'gags kyang*/

gshe ba'i lan du gshe ba ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin pas bzhag thal ba 'gam gyi lan du phyi sa gsar pa bzhes shig rang yang zer mi 'dod pas skabs dang bstun pa'i lan brjod par bya yis// sku gzugs chung yang re zhig thugs khog rgya chen po bskyed du gsol// ༈ de yang khyed kyi bstan bcos kyi 'go 'dren du/ de lta'i mod las bstan la dga' ba yis// skye dgus bsngags te chos kyi gzhal med rtser// log rtog dga' bas dben yang mdo rgyud kyi// rgyal srid bde bas skyong ba kho bo tsam// zhes dang*/ mdo rgyud kun gyi nges gnas ji snyed pa// zer zlos rgan po'i gtam gyis ma bslad par// 'jam pa'i rdo rje snying la 'phos pa bzhin// rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod 'dzin pa nga min su// zhes dang*/ sbyar byang du'ang*/ phrag dog 'gran sems tsher mas ma dkrugs shing*// zer zlos sgyu ma'i 'khor los ma bcings par/ sogs mdo rgyud kyi nges gnas ma zhu ba'i sgregs pa dri nga ba dang lhan cig mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi stong sgra lung stong gi spyang ki bzhin du bu ga dgu nas sgrogs par snang mod/ de yang bstan 'dzin gyi khrod na lung rtogs kyi sgo nas khyed 'ba' zhig lhag cing mtho bar khas 'che ba de gal te bden pa ltar na/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i snyan grags bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha dag gis bsgrags te phyogs dang phyogs bral du cung zad grags par 'gyur thal ba la/ da bar 'phro gleng gang yang mi snang ba de gsang sgo dam drags pas lan nam/ drag shos a pho hor yin na de la ni mda' gzhu mi gda'o// snyigs ma lnga'i lang tsho ches bdo bas rgyal bstan cung zad nyams pa'i skabs su snang yang*/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i bden stobs mi bslu ba 'dra bas/ da lta kar 'brug 'bri stag jo zhal bo dge sogs gzhan lugs skyong ba'i skyes chen du ma dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa dag gi gtso mdzad pa'i/

ngor rdzong sogs sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mkhas pa ji snyed bzhugs bzhin du/ ham pa su che la lhab lhab bka' babs nas/ gzhan thams cad las khyed lhag pa lta bu/ bsgrubs 'dug pa 'di mi chos bla ma'i rdzun kham po cher snang bas sdom pa 'jig pa'i rgyur e 'gro bsam dgos la/ 'on kyang sbyar byang du byang phyogs kyi smyon pa klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes dngos po dang mthun pa'i mtshan bla dwags su nyid rang gis gsol 'dug pa des na/ 'dul ba mdor/ smyos pa dang*/ sems 'khrugs pa dang*/ tshor bas gzir ba la ni nyes pa med do// ces gsungs pas cung zad drag mod kyi/ sku gzhon nu nas smyo ba phongs pas thugs rnal du dbab pa'i thabs tshol ba la 'bad 'tshal lo// 'o na khyed rang gis kyang srid gsum rnam rgyal du/ sdom pa gsum gyis rab tu phye ba'i nor// rgyal ba'i gan mdzod chen por rgyas btab pa// rang gir spyod pa'i mthu ldan ngal sos bu'i// rnam thar 'khyong pa mi mang kho bo tsam// zhes pa'ang der thal lo snyam na/ sa dkar gyi khrod na bstan bcos de gnyis so so la 'dris pa'i phyogs re ba mang mod kyang gnyis ka la 'dris pa dka' zhing*/ kho bos bstan bcos chen po de gnyis kyi tshig dang don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa thob ste/ gzi brjid can gyi rgyan du sbyar ba de tsam don la'ang gnas kyi/ lung rtogs gang la'ang nga bas lhag pa med do ces ma smras pa'i phyir kha na ma tho ba gcig kyang med do// sa skya'i gong ma rnams tshad ldan yin par mkhas pa spyi la grags shing*/ lhag par nged kyi ngor yang dag pa'i nges pas grub nas lo mang po song zin gyi/ gtan tshigs ltar snang gis da gzod sgrub dgos pa mi bdog gong ma lnga zhes lnga nges bzung yang yang zlos 'dug pa de lnga las gzhan pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo slob rgyun dang bcas pa tshad ldan min par sgrub rgyu yin grang*//

༈ yang khyed kyis/ de lta bas na/ gong ma lnga po 'di dag skye bo spyi mthun gyi snang ngor zhabs zung brtan pa'i skabs na/ mnyam med dwags po chen po zhes bya ba rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur pa de nyid dang*/ phag 'bri gling la sogs pa dkar brgyud kyi chen po/ brgyud pa de dag gi bstan pa la ston pa sangs rgyas dngos su grags pa su zhig gis kyang*// mnyam bzhag smra bsam brjod med kyi zol 'dzin pa tsam las mdo rgyud kyi gsung rab rin po che las brtsams pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mgrin pa 'degs ma nus zhes bris so// mnyam med sgam po pa/ phag 'bri gling rnams rab dbye mdzad pa po'i sngon du 'das zin na/ sa paṇa la rtsod pa'i mgrin pa ji ltar 'degs soms shig/ ༈ yang byang smyon rin po ches/ snying la 'khon du dam bzung nas// kha la tshig 'jam smra'o zhes// drang srong gdug pa'i gdams ngag ste// dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal ba yin// zhes pa lung du drangs nas/ srid gsum du sa paṇa la mchod brjod dang*/ bar skabs su rab dbye'i bstan bcos la bsngags pa'i tshig mang du brjod pa yang snang mod/ g.yon can gus par ston pa ni// dgos pa'i phyir yin gus phyir min// zhes bshad pa de khyed kyi thugs la bzhag nas/ sa skya pa'i ring lugs khyad par can 'di/ ci nas kyang sun 'byin par 'dod bzhin du/ gnas skabs sgyu thabs kyi tshig tsam du snang ste/ dper mtshon pa ni/ lhas sbyin gyis ston pa bcom ldan 'das la reg dug bku ba'i bsam pas phyag 'tshal zhing zhabs spyi bor blangs pa bzhin no// zhes smra ba de'i lan brjod par bya'o// nged kyis snying la 'khon dam du bzung ba khyed kyis sgrub mi nus pa tsam du ma zad/ kha ru tshig 'jam smra ba yang legs pa yin gyis/ kha zhe gnyis ka rtsub pa ni khyed kho na'i khyad chos so// ji skad du/ bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la// mi phyed pa yi dad pa yod// 'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la// 'khrul par spyod la bdag ma dad// ces gsungs pa dang cha 'dra bar/

sa skya pa'i bstan pa ngo ma dang*/ bstan 'dzin gtsang ma la kho bo mos pa zhig yod lags pas/ sa paṇa la mchod brjod dang rab dbye la bstod bsngags byas pa yin gyis/ gal te mi mos pa zhig na dngos su tshar bcad cing brgal bas chog pa la/ ngan sems kyis sgyu thabs smras nas dgos pa ci zhig yod/ de lta bas na/ sa paṇa la phyag 'tshal ba ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid yin par shes nas gus pa'i sgo nas dang*/ gsung kha cig la dpyad pa ni/ dgos dbang gis gsung mtho man sna tshogs byon 'dug pa rnams dgongs pa can dang dgongs min sogs su 'grel dgos pa go ba'i slad du'o// ci phyir phyag 'tshal nas brdung bar mi rigs so snyam na/ gaṇ+ḍi'i mdor/ de 'gro dkon mchog gsum la ni// phyag 'tshal nas ni brdung bya ste// ces pa'ang lhas sbyin gyi brtul zhugs yin zhes smros shig dkar brgyud gong ma rnams kyis dgag sgrub btang snyoms su bzhag spong ba bsam gtan gtso bo mdzad nas bcom bskyungs te bzhugs pa la/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ bstan pa'i gad bdar la dgongs pa'i rtsod 'dzugs mang zhig gnang ba la brten/ rje pad+ma dkar po dang*/ mkhan chen gser pas 'bel gtam rim par mdzad pa ni legs pa 'ba' zhig yin par mthong nas srid gsum du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang spyan ras kyis// gzigs pa nam mkha'i rjes 'gro gnyis// legs bgros bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang pos// thub bstan byi dor mdzad la dgyes// de tshe mkhas rlom 'byung po'i bya// phal cher smra bcad rgyar 'thums kyang*// klu sgrub dpyid kyi pho nya yis// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags// zhes smos/ 'on kyang de'i rjes zhugs pa 'ga' zhig gis/ kun slong ngan pa'i gdon snying la bzung nas 'brug pas lan ma thebs so zhes smre sngags kyi rgyang glu rna bar zhen pa dang*/ lugs 'di pa'i khrod kyi sgam sgom mgo ltag ma phyed pa 'ga' la'ang de ltar yin nam snyam pa'i log shes skyes 'dug pa sogs la bsam nas/

de la nyan byed lpags byi'u sogs smras pa 'dis/ byang smyon rin po che'i gsung las/ ci ste rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs 'dir gus na srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes bya'i bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa dgos pa med par yang 'gyur te zhes sogs bkod pa'i 'gal spong yang legs par grub bo// khyed kyi bstan bcos 'di ni/ nags kyi spre'u'i tshogs 'dus nas// skyes bu'i lus la rtog pa na// spu dang mjug ma mi ldan zhes// khrel zhing rang lus dam par 'dzin// zer ba dang kun tu mtshungs te/ tha na yi ge'i sdeb dang thob gang yang rtsir med pas ma dag pa brgyud mar bris la/ sa lugs gtsang ma dor nas rnying ma sogs mang pos bslad pa mtshon byed du/ 'dir dgos med kyi gter tshig sogs dang*/ sa lugs dang mi mthun phyogs su gnas pa'i tshig don kha cig kyang gzhan nas g.yar gyin gzhog yon mdzad pa rnams dpe bral gyi lung rigs rnam dag yin par sgom/ pha rol po'i legs bshad yin nges pa tsho la'ang thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'phyas 'dogs 'ba' zhig snang ba'i phyir ro// rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ khyed kyi bstan bcos ha le gze ma ra mgo'i 'bru la stong sbad kyi phub ma btab pa de la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gzi 'od ces ming snyan po de 'dra mi 'os pas/ deng phyin chad shing gi rang 'thag tu mtshan gsol lo// mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis// bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' la'ang brtag dpyad dgos phyin gzhan la lta ci smos/ des na brgal rtags kyi rnam dbye bkod pa tsam la khro gnyer sdud mi rigs la/ gal te kho bos sa lugs bzung nas/ rab dbye sogs bstan bcos gsum la chos dang mthun par 'bru gnyer na khyed kyis smras pa las ches lhag pa'i don 'bras ston par spobs nges yin gyi/

mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma yin no// ༈ shing gi rang 'thag las/ 'di ni sdom gsum rab dbye skabs gsum par ji skad du bshad pa dgag byar bzung nas/ blo'i rtsal ci nus su bskyed de dgag pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'gram chu ldang bar ci zhig nus zhes pa'i bar du smyo gtam mang du bkod par brjod par bya ste/ spyod 'jug gi lung*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan// zhes sogs khyed rang gis drangs pa'i lung la go ba thebs kyi yod na/ ma rtogs pa'i rtogs rdzu dang mi mkhyen pa'i mkhyen rdzu/ des sangs rgyas byang sems rnams thugs khrel bar 'gyur bas/ ngo tsha shes pa sogs gnyen pos deng phyin chad smra ba ngan pa rnams dor cig mkhan chen klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung dpyad gzhir bzhag nas 'bel gtam gleng ba'i tshe/ mkhan chen pa'i thugs bzhed kyi rtsa ba rab dbye sogs yin pas/ ltar snang tsam du de la'ang zur za cung zad 'phog srid mod/ de la khyed ma dgyes pa ni// tshangs thigs drang por btab pa na// ya yo can gyi sems la gzan// zhes rje sa paṇa rang gis lung bstan pa dus la bab pa'o// de'i phyir blo chung mgo stong mdzad dam/ lkug pa mgo yon mdzad khyed rang la rag cing*/ mgo bo 'khor mi 'khor dang*/ 'gram chu ldang mi ldang yang mtshungs so// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ de ltar na srid gsum mkhan pos/ sa lugs kyi bka' srol bzang po de nyid la dngos sam brgyud pa'i klan ka ji snyed cig btsal mod kyi/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bzhed dgongs yang dag pa'i don ni so so skye bo skal ba dman pa dag gi spyod yul du ma gyur pas/ nges gsang bla na med pa'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis sdang bar 'gyur zhing rtsod pa lhur len gyi bsam sbyor rtsub mo kho na la gzhol bas/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po chen po spungs par gyur la/ nges pa'i don la skabs gzhan du lhung ste/ phyogs 'dzin gyi zhen pas bcings bzhin du skrag pa'i gnas ma yin pa la skrag par byas pas/

'di ltar brgal ba'i tshig 'byin pa ni/ nyan thos pa dag theg pa chen po'i sgra tsam thos pas skrag ste/ theg chen gyi gang zag dang chos la skur pa 'debs pa dang rnam par kun tu mtshungs par mngon la/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa mdo sde rgyan las/ 'gro ba de yis gnas min zhes sogs lung 'dren mang po dang bcas bris shing*/ nged la 'jigs ldir ltag gcog gi khul yin par 'dug ste/ byis pa'i am gtsigs la dar ma ga la 'jigs/ lung rigs mgo yon de ka khyed rang gi dbu la 'khor te/ ji ltar zhe na/ mkhan chen gser pa sku skye snga phyi gnyis kyis 'brug lugs kyi bka' srol bzang po 'di nyid la dngos sam brgyud pas klan ka ji snyed cig btsal mod kyi/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bzhed dgongs yang dag pa'i don ni/ so so skye bo skal ba dman pa dag gis spyod yul du ma gyur pas/ nges gsang phyag rgya chen po'i sgra 'di thos pa tsam gyis sdang bar 'gyur zhing zhes pa nas/ mdo sde rgyan dang zla grags kyi lung drangs te bsnyon na bden 'brel gyis gsung rgyu yod dam// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ zab mo'i de kho na nyid kyi tshul lugs rnams/ tshe 'di rkyang par thos pa rgya chen btsal ba tsam gyis go bar mi nus kyi/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su de kho na nyid la bag chags bzhag la/ tshe 'dir dpe hrul mang po gcig tu bsags nas thun tshag bsdus pa rnams kyis don gyi mthar thug rtogs par mi nus pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ theg pa chen po 'di la mchog yin par grub bo// ces pa'i bar du smras pa la brjod par bya ste/ kho bos srid gsum gyi bar zhig tu/ thos pa rgya cher btsal bar bya'o// zhes bkod pa la smra bar 'dug kyang*/ thos pa rgya cher btsal ba tsam gyis zab mo'i de kho na nyid rtogs par su zhig smra/ des na/ khyed kyis lung rigs de dag ni/ dus dang blo gros gron du 'gyur// gsung ba der gda'o// 'on kyang thos pas sdig las ldog par byed// thos pas don min spong bar byed// thos pas chos rnams shes par byed// thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob// ces dang*/

'di na dang po thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung*/ zhes sogs gsungs pas na/ thos pa rgya cher 'tshol la sdang bar mi rigs so// 'on te/ zab mo de kho na nyid dpyis phyin pa mngon du gyur nas gzhan dag la'ang 'doms pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos yin pas/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba// zhes pa der snang la/ smra ba po so skye yin na'ang*/ lung rnam dag la brten nas tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa yi bar gzhal bar nus na khyed kyi smra ba de cir 'gyur ltos shig sku skye yin pa'i thugs yus kyis/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su sbyangs pa 'dir sad ces dang*/ sngon nas nges pa'i don la shin tu sbyangs pa zhes sogs smras mod kyi/ nges pa'i don la sngon sbyangs yod pa'i gsung rigs 'dra mo rang mi snang bas sku stod mi 'tshang bar zhu/ kho bo cag gis/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams khungs su drangs nas smras pa la/ dpe hrul mang po bsdus nas zhes bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog la skur 'debs mdzad nas chos spong gi las bsags 'dug pas sdig ltung sbyongs shig kho bos kyang mdo sde rgyan gyi lung*/ dman par mos shing khams kyang shin tu dman// zhes sogs drangs nas/ dwags po'i lugs la ma mos pa tsam nyid kyis/ dwags po dkar brgyud kyi ring lugs 'di mchog yin par shugs kyis grub ces zlog sde smras na ci gsungs/ des na khyed kyi gsung rigs phal cher ni/ ji skad du/ lung rigs gtan tshigs mi ldan par// gzhan la bab col smra ba ni// skyes bu rdza yi khur thogs nas// rdo ba'i g.yul ngor 'jug pa 'dra// zhes zer ba der snang ngo*// ༈ yang byang smyon rin po ches/ shing rag tu bka' 'di ltar stsal te/ kho bo cag ni 'di ltar du// ji ltar mnam na rab bku la// sogs lung drangs nas/ tshig tsam la ma zhen par dngos shugs dang 'brel ba/

skabs las thob pa'i gsung rab kyi don phyin ci ma log par shes shing*/ rgyal ba'i bka' la rnam dpyod kyi dbang 'byor ba'i legs par bshad pa mi zad pa'i gter chen po blo gros kyi klong nas rtsol med du 'byung ba zhig yin pas/ bod kyi mkhas pa che bar grags pa mang po zhig gis zer zlos la skyabs mi 'chol bar/ mdo rgyud kyi nges gsang du ma la spobs pa rang byung gi so so yang dag rig pa thob cing*/ deng sang gi thos bsam pa bzhin du/ rang rang gi bla ma rgan po rnams kyis rtog pas sbyar ba'i yig nag la smon dgos pa'i rigs shig ma yin la/ de bas na/ mdo rgyud sa bcu sems dpa'i gzhung dang bcas pa rnam la gzhung 'dzugs kyi/ bod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs la kho bo cag tshad mar mi bya mod/ ces bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi tshig ngan kho na dbyangs su gyer ro// bod kyi mkhas pa yongs dang*/ rang rang gi bla ma rgan po rnams kyis gsung rgyun la khyed mi brtsi na/ sa skya gong ma lnga po yang bod kyi mkhas pa dang*/ khyed rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rgan po sha stag yin pas/ gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rnams kyang mkhas pa gzhan tsho dang lhan cig khyad du gsod dam/ yang de'i 'phros su/ de ltar na yang*/ rje btsun sa skya gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rnams ni/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba ma lus pa'i glegs bam chig dril lta bu snang bas/ de las byung ba'i nges don rnams/ phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa mtha' dag gi gzigs pa yang dag pa dang khyad par ci zhig yod ces 'phred lhan zur gsum pa zhig btab bo// de ltar na/ gong ma lnga po bod kyi mkhas pa min zer ram/ khyed rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rgan rabs min zer bsnyon/ gal te de gnyis yin tshe/ khyed kyis brtsi bzhag mi byed pa'i gseb tu gong ma lnga yang ci'i mi 'byon soms dang*/ de dag gi gsung rab mdo rgyud thams cad kyi glegs bam chig dril yin tshe/

gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum la pu sti bcu bzhi mngon sum du snang la/ glegs bam chig dril gyi glegs bam bcu bzhi rgod bro'o// de las byung ba'i nges don rnams phyogs bcu'i 'phags tshogs kyi gzigs ngo dang khyad med ces/ nges don la bsngags mod/ 'o na de las byung ba'i drang don sogs la skyon ci 'dra snang*// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis na/ sa lugs kyi gzhung bzang khyad par can la rtsod pas sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ skur pa 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi bstan pa la bsnyon 'debs pa yin pas/ nges par lung dang rigs pas dgag dgos kyi/ btang snyoms su bzhag mi rung ste/ 'phags pa byams pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyan// bstan pa dag kyang bsrung bar mdzad// dus la'ang ye shes ma sgrib pa// de phyir btang snyoms mi rung ngo*// zhes dang*/ dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis kyang*/ ma 'ongs pa na bstan par gnod pa chen po la btang snyoms su bzhag par mi rung bar bstan te/ ces gsung pa ltar ro/ khyed kyis bkod pa'i lung rigs 'di rnams ni don gyi rtsa ba la mi 'byor zhing*/ dgos med kyi nam mkha' stong pa la lding zhing 'khor ba 'ba' zhig tu snang ste/ dper na/ brjod ma thag pa dang*/ de'i yang gong mar bkod pa'i khyed kyi tshig rnams khyed rang gi dbu la phyir slogs na 'di ltar thob ste/ de ltar yang*/ dpal dwags po dkar brgyud kyi gsung rab rnams ni/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba ma lus pa 'dus pa'i glegs bam chig dril lta bur snang bas/ de las byung ba'i nges don rnams phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa mtha' dag gis gzigs pa yang dag pa dang khyad par ci zhig yod/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis na/ dkar brgyud lugs kyi gzhung bzang khyad par can la rtsod pas sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ skur pa 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa la bsnyon 'dings pa yin pas/

nges par lung dang rigs pas dgag dgos kyi/ btang snyoms su bzhag par mi rung ste/ 'phags pa byams pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyan// zhes sogs drangs nas byang phyogs smyon pa'i dbu la dkris na bden pa dang 'brel ba'i gsung rgyu yod pa ma yin no// tshul de 'dra bar dgongs nas/ shing gi rang 'thag phyin ci log tu 'khor ba la/ zla ba lnga'i bar du gdan sa chen por/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams zhabs kyis yang dag pa'i gzigs pa stong lhung ba na/ 'gal zlos ma 'brel ba'i phung po smyon pa'i 'chal btam chen por gzigs shing*/ bstan pa spyi sgos la rma 'byin pa'i lag cha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra bar dgongs nas/ re zhig bdag gi lag tu ma gnang bar/ dgu rim gyi thems 'og mdzes pa'i rgyan sar rgya rim pa dgus btab ste gter du sba ba'i thugs 'dun mdzad pa 'dra ste/ 'di lta bu ni/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyan// sogs kyi lung don mkhyen pa'i sems kyi rang gzugs su shar bas/ bstan pa'i bdag po'i legs mdzad yang dag pa la gcig tu gzhol ba'o// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ de ltar skabs kyi gleng cung zad gleng pa nas/ 'dir bshad par bya ba ni/ srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes pa'i bstan bcos su don chung cung zad la tshig tshogs chen po yang zlos su bgyis nas/ sa lugs kyi bzhed tshul dri ma med pa rnams ngan rtog gis dkrugs par byas pa de dag gi lan/ tshig nyung la don rgyas pa dag gis mdor bsdus shig bsnyad par 'dod pas/ gzu bor gnas pa dag dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bag yod par gyis shig ces mtshams sbyar te zhes bris so// srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi brjod don phyag rgya chen po yin pa la/ khyed kyis don chung ngu zhes phyag rgya chen po la brnyas pa byas/ tshig tshogs chen po yang zlos su bgyis nas zhes nged kyi bstan bcos la shog bu kha grangs lnga bcu bgrang tsam 'dug par mang bar byas// tshig nyung la zhes shing gi rang 'thag la shog bu mda' tshad ma bdun cu don gsum snang ba nyung bar byas/

srid gsum gyi don rkang mang po la dmigs rnam ma bkral bar hor kong du bzhag nas/ don rgyas pa'i ngag gis zhes mngon sum la blo ma tshad bag med kyi rang nyams smyon pa'i bla col byung rgyal du smras pa 'di la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gang dag gzu bo'i thugs ldan rnams kyis dgongs shig ces smreng gsol to// rje klu sgrub pas/ sems 'od gsal dag pa gangs kyi ri// zhes pa'i skabs su/ srid gsum las/ gshis rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba kun gzhi rgyu rgyud de nyid la de phan gyi rkyen sbyor dgos tshul smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ spyir sems dang sems nyid so sor 'byed pa ni sgra rigs kyang*/ nges don gyi skabs su dgos gal che ba ste/ zhes sogs phal che ba'i rnam dbye go ba phyin ci log pa zhig smras 'dug pa ya cha/ tshig la 'khrul pa spong ba'i bstan bcos sgra rig pa'i skabs 'dir/ tha snyad gtso che bas rang bzhin dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum gyi sgo nas/ rnam dbye dang sbyor tshul dang tshig phrad sogs rang sa'i thob thang ma nor zhing ma 'khrugs pa zhig dgos la/ rje klu sgrub pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sdom brtson mang du thos pa zhig yin par 'khums kyang*/ nges don gyi re sgo med pas de yi 'phros gleng ma btang bar/ thog mar tha snyad mthun mi mthun gyis tshig sbyor 'god tshul brtsad pa yin mod/ des na nyid sgra smos pa de tha snyad kyi phyogs la yin gyis/ nges don gyi skabs su/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// sogs dang 'chad 'gyur gyi rnam rtog chos sku'i skabs su drangs pa'i mdo sde dang rgyud sde dang*/ grub brnyes kyi gzhung rnams las byung ba bzhin spang blang med pa'i rnal ma zhig ston gyis// shing rag tu/ sems la dwangs snyigs phye snyigs ma dor/ zer ba'i lugs ngan de 'dras ci zhig btub// des na nges don gyi phyogs la 'byon ma myong ba'i rang rtags mtshon pa'o// zhes bka' bkyon mdzad 'dug kyang*// gnyis snang zing nge ba'i nges don de 'dra ba'i phyogs la sngar yang ma phyin la da dung 'gro bar ma gyur cig

shing rag gi 'phros der/ de ltar yang rje klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa la gnod mi nus te gshis lugs sems nyid de kun rdzob rdzas kyi sems ma yin yang*// don dam pa'i sems chos nyid kyi sems yin pa la ltos/ sems zhes ming btags pa ni mdo rgyud kun na snang ba'i phyir/ de phyogs tsam mtshon na/ 'phags pa byams pas/ zhes byams chos/ dri med 'od/ do ha'i lung rnams drangs pa 'brel med de/ de gsum mdo rgyud gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro// drangs ma thag pa'i lung de rnams/ sems dang sems nyid/ sems can dang sangs rgyas sogs gnyis chos thams cad spang blangs med par ro mnyam chen por khyab cing gdal ba'i skabs la dgongs pas na/ khyed rang gis drangs pa'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud dang*/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces sogs gsungs phyin/ skabs 'di ga tsam du nyid sgra sbyar ba dang ma sbyar ba la khyad par med pas skabs thob kyis shan phyed par bya'o// ༈ rje klu sgrub pas/ gnas lnga'i mtsho chen hub gcig gis za ba'i// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ za ba dang 'thung ba nor bas nongs te/ 'jig rten dang bstan bcos kyi sgra las zan za/ chu 'thung zhes grags pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro// zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ khyed rang gi thugs rab tu gu dog can des ma dgongs pa ste/ bde mchog gi rgyud mngon brjod bla ma las/ dri chen rdo rje'i chu bza' zhing*// tshogs kyi phung po rdzogs gyur cig /ces rdo rje'i chu bza' ba'i brda' tha snyad btags kyi 'thung ba'i brda' ma sbyar ba dang*/ brtag gnyis su/ kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir// bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'// zhes bdud rtsi byang sems dri chu sogs za bar gsungs kyi/ 'thung zhes ma gsungs la/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar pha las bde thob pa// de yi bde ba rang gi bza'// zhes sogs drangs nas mang du glengs so// tshig rtsa gtan nas mi zin par/

smra ba dges lugs la bltas na/ mkhan chen klu sgrub pa'i bag chags sad pa nges kyis sku skyes gsal por yin par mngon te/ srid gsum du/ za ba dang 'thung ba nor bas nongs te/ 'jig rten dang bstan bcos kyi sgra las zan za chu 'thung zhes grags pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro// zhes bkod pa la/ rgyud kyi lung drangs nas 'gog pa'i khul byas kyang ci yang ma 'brel te/ rgyud kyi lung dngos 'jig rten la grags pa'i sgra yang ma yin la/ bstan bcos la grags pa'i sgra yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang sgron ma gsal ba las/ ka ṭa khya la sogs pa'i sgra// 'jig rten bstan bcos las gzhan byas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi brda'// de ni ji bzhin min par bsgrags// zhes te/ dper na/ ba lang zhes pa lta bu 'jig rten la grags pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid ces pa lta bu bstan bcos la grags pa'i brda' chad dang mi gcig par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rtog ge pa dang sgra pas rtogs dka' ba'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang srog la sogs pa rlung bcu'i ming du mdzad pa bzhin// mngon brjod du'ang rdo rje'i chu za zhes brda'i chu za zhes brda'i skad du mdzad/ spyir bshang gci la sogs pa rnams la bdud rtsi lngar btags pa'ang rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i brda' yin gyis 'jig rten dang bstan bcos la grags pa'i brda' chad ma yin la/ de bzhin du/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud nyung ngur/ man ngag shin tu rnyed dka' ste// dpa' bo brda yi skad du ni// nga yis rgyud du sbas pa yin// zhes gsungs/ su la sbas na/ bshad rgyud kun spyod las/ sangs rgyas mu stegs can la sba// brda' dang brda yi bye brag gis// lam 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs// zhes tha snyad kyi tshig dang rdo rje'i tshig mi 'dre bzhin du bsre mkhan rnams la sbas pas na/ rgyud kyi brda skad 'di dag kla klo'i skad lta bur shin tu brtag dka' ba yin pas cha gcig nas dbu 'thoms pa'ang mad pa tsam yin mchis so// der ma zad rgyud sde spyi tsam shes pa rnams kyis kyang rtogs dka' bar dgongs nas/

rgyud du/ rgod dang lta ba dag gis dang*// 'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis sbyor gyi// rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis// dgongs pa'i skad ni ma bsgrags pa// bcom ldan nges par gsung du gsol// zhes dang*/ 'di 'dra ba la dgongs nas/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i ngor// 'jig rten bstan bcos la med pa'i// brda ni skye bo'i spyod yul min// kun mkhyen dgongs pa bsam mi khyab// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// yang gal te dri chen rdo rje'i chu bza' zhing*// zhes pa la bshad pa'i rnam grangs su sgra ji bzhin pa ltar gyi 'bru gnyer bar bzhad na/ rdo rje'i chu dang bcas pa'i dri chen la sogs pa bza' zhes bya ba ste/ rgya 'grel rnams la gzigs shig yang na dgyes rdor gyi nā ro 'grel chen las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ril bu yungs kar gyi tshod tsam nyin zhag so so'i dam tshig gi don du bsten par bya'o// zhes bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga la sogs pa'i rdzas ma sha ka bdun cu rtsa lnga cho ga bzhin du sbyar zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bza' zhes pa'i don du song zhing*/ bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'// zhes pa'ang de ka'o// rdo rje'i tshig de dag mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i man ngag gis bshad na zab cing rgya che bar 'gyur mod kyi/ gzhung chen po rnams drang don 'ba' zhig tu bkral ba'i skyag rtags mi ston pa zhu zhes khyed la gsol to// skabs 'dir ni/ ji ltar grags pa la bsten nas// rnam par dpyad pa thams cad brjod// ces grags tshod kyi brda dang tha snyad sogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i tshig sbyor dgos shing*/ de yang*/ don shes byed pa brda la rag /brda ni sngon gyi skyes bu la'o// zhes bshad pa bzhin mdzad na legs kyi/ gzhan du na/ zan 'thungs/ chu za /sha bzhur/ mar btsos zhes sogs brda chad gsar pas bzhad gad slong bar 'gyur ro// yang khyed kyis/

des na za zhes pa longs spyod pa'i don yin pas zer ba 'brel med kyi tshig ste/ 'dod yon longs spyod pa dang za ba don gcig na/ gos la longs spyod na gos za ba dang*/ khang ba la longs spyod na khang ba za ba dang*// stan la longs spyod pa'ang stan za ba sogs su khas len dgos par 'gyur bas mkhas blun kun gyis 'phya ba'i gnas su lhung ngo*// des na nged cag shes rab gu dog kyang kha 'chal smra ma myong lags// ༈ yang nyi ma'i 'od zer du/ lha rnams rgod pa'i dbyangs kyis khrel zhes thos// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ khrel nas rgod pa yin gyi/ rgod nas khrel ba ma yin zhes smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ blo gros sbubs 'thums pa'i skyon du snang ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi don dam bsnyen par/ bden pa ma yin smra zhing bu rnams bslu 'dod pa// zhes sogs drangs nas lan gyi khral 'jal mdzad snang yang*/ des khral cung mi 'khyol ba 'dra ste/ don dam bsnyen pa'i lung don ni/ gdug pa'i slob dpon dag gis bsam pa la/ thog mar rdzun tshig gis brid nas/ de'i blo gzhan du 'gyur ba na bslu ba'i las la sbyar bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ slob spring du/ gang zhig thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar byed cing*// zhes sogs kyang 'god khyer gong dang cha 'dra mod kyi/ rtsod spong gi tshig don la dpe rgyas mi khegs te/ khyed kyi dgongs pa la tshig snga phyi log pa tsam la rtsod pa 'dra snyam 'khrungs mdog kha yang*/ rgod pa'i dbyangs kyis zhes byed tshig sbyar 'dug pas skyon zhugs shing*/ lung gnyis po la byed tshig med pas dod mi mnyam/ 'di rigs yi ge nor ba yin gsungs na spa yi/ skyur rjes skam gyis gnon par ci ste rigs/ shing rag las/ mkhan chen klu sgrub pas/ chos stong nyid rang gzigs ma mthong yang*/ zhes sogs la/ srid gsum du/ dgos med kyi tshig rtsub mang po smra ba ni 'jig rten pa'i ngan shags kho nar snang gi

gsung rab dang 'brel ba mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu ba'i 'os su gtogs pa mi snang bas ma dgos zer ba bris so// 'jig rten pa'i ngan shags las// spyir chos pa'i ngan gags dang*/ sgos sprul sku'i ngan gshags bzang zhing mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu bar 'os na ma gtogs/ gzhan ni khyed kyis/ 'brug pa dpon slob la tshig ngan mi 'tshams pa du ma bsgrags snang yang rgol bar khas blangs phyir mi bden kyang bden du chug lo chen byang rtse dang*/ lo chen grags pa dang*/ rgyal sras chos rdzong pas mi shes/ go shaka la sogs pa sa skya pa'i mkhas pa spyis ma go mkhan chen klu sgrub rgya mtshos mi mkhyen/ rje drung 'gyur med dang 'jam dbyangs dga' bas 'chal gtam smras zhes sogs skyor zlos tsam la'ang shin tu ya nga ba'i tshig rtsub brgya phrag skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags 'dug pa 'di rnams mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu bar ji ltar 'os blo tshad ma rnams kyis gzigs shig/ ༈ yang phyag chen rtsod spong du/ e ma ho zhes gsungs pa dang*/ srid gsum du/ grong gseb tu gu ru'i tshes bcu 'dzin pa tsho'i dbyangs kyi 'go 'dren dper mdzad ces bris kyang*/ e ma ho ni rnying ma'i tshes bcur ma zad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud rang du/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi gsang*// e ma ho bde ba las byung ba/ zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung la/ bla med kyi rgyud thams cad na e ma ho zhes tshig med pa ni mi srid pa ltar snang ba dang*/ 'dul ba lung du/ e ma ho bdag cag gi mkhan po dang slob dpon lhung bzed kyi las bya'o zhes pa nas e ma ho dge 'dun gyi mkhan po dang slob dpon mgu ba bya ba dang zhes pa'i bar du e ma ho'i tshig mang du gsal na/ rnying ma'i tshes bcu dang*/ rje klu sgrub pa'i e ma ho 'ba' zhig la snyad 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yod/ ces bris so// khyed kyi gsung lugs la dpags na/ spyir e ma ho zhes pa'i tshig bkag par dgongs pa 'dra ste/

de ni grong gseb tu zhes tshig zur smos pa'i rgyu mtshan la ma brtags pas lan gda' ba/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bka' gter gyi lag len khungs ma la ma sbyangs kyang nang mchod kyis myos pa'i rang nyams 'bar bas rol mo'i sgra dang lhan cig skabs thob brtsi ba'i rnam dpyod med bzhin du/ grong gseb tu tshes bcu'i chang gral la tshogs tshe/ dbyangs kyi 'go 'dren thams cad la e ma ho zhes zer gyin 'dug pa ltar/ rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer du yang skabs dang ma 'brel ba'i e ma ho smos pa la snyad 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no// des na rgyud dang 'dul ba'i lung 'dren gron du song ba 'dra lags/ lung gnyis su e ma ho smos pa la dgongs pa 'dug ste/ e ma ho ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i tshig yin pas/ rgyud du bde chen gyi ye shes la ngo mtshar ba dang*/ 'dul ba mkhan slob mgu bar byas pa la ngo mtshar ba'o// de'i phyir/ sgyu mas bslus pa sogs dang sbrel rgyu yin tshe/ de la skyo ba skyes pa'i tshig kye ma ho zhes sam kye hud ces lta bu 'god par rigs kyi/ ngo mtshar ba'i tshig smra bar mi 'os la/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ gang min byung ba la ngo mtshar rgyu ci zhig yod de/ god kha byung dus glen pa rgod pa bzhin 'brel med yin no// ༈ yang phyag chen rtsod spong du/ khong sgyu ma'i mkhan po sgyu mas bslus// zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ srid gsum du sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis skye bo gzhan bslu ba yin gyi/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi ngor snang yang bden 'dzin med pas bslu mi tshugs/ phyag rgya chen po 'khor gsum yongs dag gi rang tshugs su zhig gis 'jigs par spobs/ ri mgo mjug log na ma gtogs ri'i bu chung thang la 'khyams don med/ theg pa mchog gi gzhung bzang yod bzhin du// rtog ge kha skya'i gzhung la su zhig skyabs// zhes rkang don bzhi bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ sgyu ma mkhan po sgyu mas bslu mi tshugs zer ba ni gsung rab la ma sbyangs par 'jig rten rig bkra'i tshod dpag tsam byas pa'i skyon te/

'phags pa byams pas mdo sde rgyan du/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po sgyu ma yi// rgyal po gzhan gyis phab pa ltar// gang dag gis ni chos mthong ba'i// rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med// ces sgyu ma'i rgyal po nang phan tshun la rgyal pham byung ba dper mdzad pa dang*/ zhes smras te/ dpe don mi mtshungs so// rgyu mtshan/ 'dul ba lung du rgyal rigs kyi bstan bcos drangs par/ mkhas pa rnams ni bzhams pa dang*// rab tu sbyin dang bslu ba dang*// kun tu dpyad dang lnga par ni// dpung gi don rnams sgrub par byed// ces dgra 'dul thabs lnga bshad pa las/ gsum pa thabs kyis bslu ba dang*/ lnga pa dpung gis don sgrub pa ste drag po'i las kyis pham par byed pa so sor bshad pa la/ khyed kyis de gnyis gcig tu go ba 'dra// rgyan gyi lung der yang*/ rgyal po gzhan gyis phab pa ltar/ zhes cham la phab pa lta bur bshad kyis/ bslus zer ba mi gda' bas gsung rab la sbyangs pa tsho'i ngang tshul ni de 'dra'o// dpe gnyis pa'ang mi 'grig ste/ sgyu ma mkhan nang tshogs pa'i tshe sgyu ma bshig la thug pa srid kyang*/ sgyu ma mkhan sgyu mas bslus pa'i dper mi rung ngo*// yang de'i 'phros su mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi lung drangs par/ sgyu ma yis ni 'gro kun rmongs// mkhas pa sgyu ma nyid kyis grol// zhes lung don ni/ skye bo gzhan kun gyi sgyu ma sgyu mar ma shes pas rmongs la/ sgyu ma mkhan sgyu ma'i mtshan ma la mkhas pas ma rmongs pa dper mdzad/ de kho na nyid ma rig pa'i skye bo kun srid tshul gyi sgyu ma la bden par zhen pas rmongs/ rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i mkhas pa dag gi ngor snang yang der 'dzin gyis ma bslad pas grol ba don du bkod pa ste/ brtag gnyis su/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// zhes dang*// dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis// skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur// dug gi de nyid shes pa des// dug gi dum nyid 'bigs par byed// ces sogs gsungs pa dang mthun par khyed kyi bzhed pa la phan gnod med do// rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos// zhes dang*/

rang rig bdag nyid dag pa ste// sogs dang*/ bde ba 'di kun rang gi khyim na 'dug /ces sogs/ drangs pa rnams khyed la sgrub byed du mi 'gyur ba'i khar gnod byed du 'gro ste/ lung de ltar na/ sgyu mas sgyu ma bslus/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma mkhan bslus pa 'dra zhig thob rgyu ste/ rang gis rang bcings shing*/ rang gis rang grol bar bshad pa'i phyir/ khyed kyi dper bkod pa las/ sgyu ma mkhan sgyu mas bslus par bshad pas lung dang mi 'grig la/ gong du/ sems la dwangs snyigs phye ste snyigs ma dor/ dwangs ma'i ngang du 'jog pa'i nges don gyi chos khyad par can kho dang 'gal zhing*/ rang gzhung ma tshugs par tshig sgum btus pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs zing zing pa'o// ༈ shing rag tu/ ri mthon po'i bu chung*// zhes pa su la snyeg rgyu yin soms shig des nges par 'gyur ro// zer ba byas 'dug pa ltar bsam pas/ go 'phang mthon por phebs nas spam po mdzad dgos rgyu la/ mi mkhyen bzhin du mkhas pa'i lad mo mkhan/ la stong rlon pa'i bu chung spyi brtol gyis thang skam po la 'khyam gyin 'dug pa de yin par gtan tshigs dang bcas nges byung lags so// des don tshan bzhi pa'ang go bar gda'// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ rje klu sgrub kyis// a la la ho/ zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ 'di gsang sngags rnying ma'i las byang 'ga' zhig tu tshogs chang 'thung khar brjod pa zhig snang yang*/ rang re btsun pa skam po tsho la mi mkho ba 'dra/ zhes bris pa ni/ rigs pa ma yin te/ zhes pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi lung 'dren mdzad mod/ spyir a la la'i tshig mi 'gog pas lung 'dren de tshos 'dir mi gnod la/ gong gi e ma ho dang 'dra bar skabs thob kyi smras na mdzes rgyu la/ gong 'og gi brjod bya gang yang 'dren mi nus pa glo bur gyi a la la hos ci zhig bya// ༈ phyag chen rtsod spong du/ chos tshig gi bdag po 'dul ba las// zhes sogs la/

srid gsum du/ drang don gtsor byed tshe zhes sogs dang*/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo lung drangs/ bsdus brjod kyi dpe'i ngos 'dzin byas pa la/ shing rag tu// dngos po 'ga' la bsam byas nas// zhes sogs nged kyi rjes zlos byas pa'i mjug tu/ rje 'brug pas/ sa paṇa gyi gsung bkag cing zil gyis gnon blo de dang*/ sbrang bu'i gshog rlabs kyis nyi zla sgrib blo byas pa de gnyis sbyar/ rje 'brug pas/ mdo rgyud thams cad mkhyen rgyu'i blo de dang nags dang bcas pa'i sa nam mkha' la 'phags blo byed pa gnyis go bya go byed du sbyar/ dpe de rnams rgyal bas 'dul ba lung du mi srid srid pa'i dpe lta bu la dgongs nas gsungs kyang*/ don la mi bden pa de dang*/ rje 'brug pas dgag sgrub kyi gsung mang po zhig byon yang*/ phal cher bden pa'i nus pa med par sbyar nas/ khong rgyal ba'i gsung yin bden las che'am ste mi bden zhes pa'i don yin/ de la khyed kyi drang nges shan 'byed des phan gnod gang yang ma mchis so// zhes 'dzer ro// tshigs bcad de la de bas don bzang tsam zhig yod du re na'ang skye ba dran pa'i thugs rgyus thog nas de bzhin gsungs phyin de ka las med pa los yin/ lung rigs mgo yon de ni der thal/ de'i phyir te/ rje 'brug pa'i mtshan gyi tshab tu rje gser pa'i mtshan bcug sa paṇa gyi mtshan gyi dod du rje 'brug pa'i mtshan bkod/ tshig lhag ma rnams gong bzhin brjod nas khyed la slog na khyed rang la gnod par 'gyur bas so// ༈ rje klu sgrub kyis/ sngon rgya gar 'phags yul grub thob rnams// sngar thos bsam sbyangs nas brtul zhugs spyod// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ 'phags yul ba rnam thos bsam la sbyangs rjes sgom sgrub mdzad/ de nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa yin gyi/ thos bsam tsam 'byongs 'phral brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad mi nus kyang*/

de ltar du dgongs pa ni/ a tsa ra rdzun can zhig gis zhus stabs su song ba 'dra// zhes bris pa la shing gi rang 'thag 'thab pa'i skad las/ 'di ni gsung rab rnams las bar tshig mi mngon pa'i gzhung ji snyed gsungs pa rnams la skyon gtong ba ste/ zhes pa'i sgrub byed du/ dper brjod kyi lung 'dren kha yar mdzad snang yang*/ spyir bar gyi rnam dbye dang tshig phrad bsdus nas mi mngon par byas pa saṃskṛta la yod pa dang*/ 'gyur mdzad kyi lo tsā bas brjod bde'i dbang du byas nas bsdus pa sogs shin tu mang mod kyi/ he he/ 'u bu'i tshigs bcad 'di 'dra la dpe bzang po de tsho bkab nas ci mdzad/ yig mkhan dang par pa'i lag nor byung ba ma gtogs/ sngar thos bsam sgom nas brtul zhugs spyod// zer rgyu yin gsung na sku skye phyi ma de jo bo bzang po red zer nyen gda' lags// ༈ rtsod spong las/ dus deng sang gi rtogs ldan rgyal po rnams// sngar dben pa bsten nas grong mthar 'khyams// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ grong mthar kun tu rgyu zhing 'khyams pa de tsho rtogs ldan rgyal po ma yin gyi/ snying po'i don gyi rtogs ldan rgyal po rnams ni chos brgyad kyi bsdu tshoms shig ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ lto gos gtam nor la rtseg rum mi byed par/ phyi dben pa/ nang mal stan/ gsang ba lus gnad/ de kho na nyid dmigs pa gar gtad kyi steng du spang la be phur btab pa ltar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs kyin gda'/ zhes bkod pa la shing rag tu/ khyed rang gi lugs kyi rtogs ldan la bstod phul ci cher byas par 'dug na'ang*// zhabs 'dren du song ste/ dmigs pa gar gtad kyi steng du spang la be phur btab pa lta bu zhig byung na/ dmigs pa la sems grims sbring nge sdod pa zhig las ma byung*/ de ni gnas pa rkyang par lus te/ de kho na nyid kyi lhag mthong gi rnam par cung zad kyang ma shar bas/

de tsam gyis snying po don gyi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan ji ltar 'dzugs/ rgyud kyi rgyal po sam+bu ṭa las/ dmigs med gnas su shes rab dwangs// dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid// rig dang lhan cig tu ni gcig /nam mkhar nam mkha' gyur ji ltar// gang la sgom pa po yang med// gang yang rnam par sgom pa med// bsgom bya nyid kyang yod min pa// de yis de nyid sgom par brjod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa ni/ dmigs gtad thams cad dang bral ba zhig lags na/ khyed kyis dmigs pa gar gtad du zhes pa des ci zhig rung*/ zhes sogs bris mod/ bstod yul chen po byed pa'i 'os de rtogs pa dang ldan pa rnams yin gyi gzhan su yin la ci'i phyir bstod/ ji skad du/ sbyor dus rten rgyu tha dad pas// dngos gzhi so so so sor 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mi 'dra ba sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i dus su/ sbyor ba'i 'dun stobs gang yin sngon du gtong ba dmigs pa gar gtad zer zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos gzhi rkyen gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig g.yo ba mi nus pa'i dper spang la be phur btab pa lta bu ces smos kyi/ dmigs gtad zer ba dang*/ mi g.yo zer ba'i dpe don thams cad zhi gnas su byas/ de'i zlog zla dmigs med dang*/ g.yo ba zer tshad lhag mthong du sgrub pa'i lung rigs ltar snang de 'dras ci btub/ rgyud kyi lung don/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo la dmigs bya dmigs byed dang*/ bsgom bya sgom byed sogs med par ston pa yin pas nged kyi 'dod pa la mi gnod pa'i khar phan pa kho na'o// gang la zhen pa yod pa de yang thong*// zhes khyed kyi drangs pa de'ang*/ las dang po pa spang bya spong byed yod pa'i dbang du byas/ de'i 'phro/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// zhes lhag mas rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad ro mnyam du rtogs par gyur ba gang gi tshe/

zhen pa dang zhen med/ dmigs gtad dang dmigs med/ so so dang*/ dbyer med/ chos can dang chos nyid la dgongs pa thams cad de kho na nyid 'ba' zhig yin gsung bar 'dug pa la/ khyed kyis dmigs gtad ngan par byas/ dmigs med bzang bar byas pas phyogs gcig pa'i a 'thas kyi thog tu ko 'thas kyang brtsegs par 'dug go /spang dang be phur gyi gnas skabs yongs rdzogs ting nge 'dzin la med kyang*/ mnyam bzhag las mi g.yo ba'i dper/ de bkod pa la 'gal ba ci zhig yod/ gang las mi g.yo ba thams cad zhi gnas tsam yin na/ mi g.yo chos rnam thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes dang*/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// sogs kyang der 'gyur ro// de lta bas na/ dpal dwags po dkar brgyud rin po che rnams ni sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan spang la be phur btab pa bzhin g.yo med du sgreng ba lags kyi/ khyed kyi ting nge 'dzin kun rtog gi rlung nag pos g.yo bar 'gyur bar ltos zhig/ ༈ yang chos thos pa byed zer chol chol smra// sogs la/ srid gsum du/ ngag 'khyal mang po bris snang yang*/ gsung rab dang 'brel ba'i dgag sgrub mi snang bas lan bya ma dgos/ mkhan chen gser pas/ chos thos pa byed zer chol chol smra// sogs/ tshig ngan gsungs pa rnams ngag btsun par byas/ de la lan gyi nyams 'tshar tshig nyams dod po rnams ngag 'khyal zhes smra ba ni thugs nan tar mdzad pa'i mtshon dpe ngo ma'o// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// sogs drangs nas/ tshig gi sbyor ba phyogs gcig la zhen nas gzhan la sdang bar mi rung la/ khyad par 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bde ba'i ngang tshul rnyed dka' ba// tshul ldan khyad du gsod mi 'dod// rang dbang legs par smra ba mdzod// ces gsungs/ khyed kyis smra ba de rnams dam pa'i lugs dang ji ltar mthun soms shig ces bris so// bzang spyod kyi lung don ni/

skad rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyis rigs drug so so la chos ston pa'i tshul la dgongs kyi/ tshig gi sbyor ba sna tshogs la dgongs pa min pas cir yang ma 'brel la/ kho bo tshig sbyor ba phyogs gcig la zhen pa dang*/ gzhan la sdang ba gnyis ka ma grub pas khyed kyis sun tshig de snying po med par song*// tshul ldan khyad du gsod mi 'dod// ces sogs la khyed rang bsam dgos par gda' ste/ bstan bcos shing rag gi mgo mjug bar gsum du/ nyid rang dam pa dpe med yin par zhal gyis 'ches shing*/ rang la bka' drin che nges pa'i bla mar khyad gsod kyi tshig ngan smra ba la ya mi nga zhing bag mi tsha ba de la bdag cag ma mos kyis/ smra yul de pa tshul ldan min nam/ tshig ngan de legs par smra ba yin grang*/ bdag ni dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ snying po'i bstan pa rma med pa dang mjal/ legs bshad kyi mgo ltag phyed/ nyams len gyi bgo skal cung zad thob pa'i nyam chung zhig lags kyis/ rang rgyud kyi bslab sdom dri mar 'gyur dogs/ re zhig dam par khas len nus pa'i ham pa mi bdog pas dgongs 'ching glod pa mkhyen/ 'on kyang lung rigs 'di rnams dam pa'i dgongs don dang cha tsam mthun pa yod lags/ khyed kyi rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tshigs bcad khyad par ba bor nas yar mar mchongs 'dug pa de/ tshig de dag snying po med par gzigs pa'i zhad du gda' bas rjes su yi rangs/ lar yang*/ bzhad gad nyams ldan gyi skor 'di pa la lan ldon dgos pa'i rigs su mi snang yang*/ kha 'chol mkhan 'dras 'phyas gdags pa'i lan du cung zad smras pa lags// ༈ rje klu sgrub kyis yang lan mkhas pa'i mig thur las/ drang dang ji bzhin don min ldem po'i ngag /'doms mdzad bshes gnyen gzhan las ches lhag pa// nges gsang bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis pad dkar snying*// tshim mdzad 'dren pa rnam gsum 'dir phyag yin// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/

rkang pa dang po'i min/ zhes pa gsal byed du byas na/ drang don ma yin pa dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa min pa/ zhes par grub/ de gnyis 'og ma dang sbrel na/ drang don min pa'i nges don dang*/ ji bzhin pa min pa gnyis ldem po'i ngag ces par song bas de ltar du bzhed e nus/ zhes sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas bkod pa la/ shing gi rang 'thag gi stong sgra las/ nged kyi ni/ drang don dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa min pa dang*/ ldem po'i ngag gsum gyis gdul bya bkri ba'i bla ma de las ches lhag pa/ nges don gsang ba bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi spel ba'i bla ma la bstod pa yin/ ces bris so/ rgyud sde las bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis/ gsang sngags thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe/ rgyud sde chen po rnams mtha' drug dang tshul bzhis gtan la phab nas rang rang gi skal ba dang mthun par bkri ba ni thabs la mkhas pa yin gyi/ gdul bya mchog dman thams cad la nges don gsang ba bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi spel ba dbang rtul gyis mi 'chun pas/ dman la zab dang rgya che dang*// skyes pa med par bud med min// zhes bkag pa de ma gzig sam/ des na mdo las/ ji ltar nad pa na ba la// sman pas sman ni gtong ba ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// ji tsam bzod pa'i chos ston no// zhes gsungs na/ gang la gang 'tsham gyis chos ston pa'i slob dpon de thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje che ba lags kyi/ slob ma'i skal ba dang mi 'tshams pa'i chos byung rgyal du 'chad pa po de thabs la mi mkhas pa'i bla ma yin la/ de 'dra ba la phyag btsal nas ci zhig don du gnyer snyam mo// de ni khyed kyi 'bru gnon ltar bshad pa yin la/ rtsa ba'i don la gzhigs na khyed kyi 'bru gnon de yang cung min pa 'dra ste/ drang dang ji bzhin min dang ldem po'i ngag /byas pas chog pa la/ bar der don zer ba cig bcug

'doms mkhas bshes gnyen gzhan las ches lhag pa// byas na phul che ba la/ bar der mdzad zer ba cig bcug 'dren pa rnam gsum der phyag 'tshal// zhes byas na bde ba la/ 'dir phyag yin ces smras pa 'di la/ yang na ni/ go rgyu dbyings can nges med cig yod pa ma go bzhin du 'bru gnyer ba'i skyon nam/ yang na ni/ brjod byas stong pa brjod rnams kyi// 'di ste mi shes kyis blangs yin zer ba de gnyis gang rung las phyi ma la cung nye ba 'dra'o// gang ltar yang*/ skyur rjes skam gnon dang rkun rgyab rdzun gnon gnyis ka stabs gcig mdzad dgos byung 'dug pas thugs bsun pa tsam 'ong nyen gda'/ dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi lung 'dren mang du mdzad pa bka' drin che na'ang*/ de phyogs la kho bo rgyus che bas mes po'i rna bar byis pa'i gtam lta bur mthong mod kyi/ de'i lung don la dpyad na tha snyad smra ba'i rtog ge ba spyi la gnod par 'gyur ro// gal te tshig sbyor 'di dag tha snyad ltar byas pa yin tshe/ de yang 'grub dka' bar snang ste/ rtsod spong gi tshigs bcad rnams snyan ngag gi rgyan yin par rlom gyin 'dug pa gang zhig de bzhin yin phyin/ tha snyad kyi brda dang mi 'gal ba zhig dgos rgyu la/ de mi snang ba'i phyir/ lar rang tha snyad la brtsad pa'i tshe nges don gyi phyogs su 'bros/ nges don brtsad tshe rtog ge'i gzhung 'dren pa ni/ bya khral dang byi so'i dper song ma song re zhig khyed rang la 'dri yi/ skabs 'ga' rer thugs tshad mdzad par yang ci gnang*// ༈ nged kyis tshigs bcad du/ log smrar rtsod pa'i rigs tshul zhes log smra la zer rgyu'i la yig bsdus nas ra yig bris pa yin na'ang*/ hob spyod la goms pas ljags klog dag po ma mdzad pa'i skyon gyis smra ba mang du byung 'dug pa ni/ ji skad du/ lhab lhab smra ba'i lam zhugs tsam gyis blun por go ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag byin/

zer ba der gda'o// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ sgra rtog ge dgag sgrub lhur blangs na/ srid gsum las ji skad bshad pa thams cad rdul phran bzhin du gsil bur bshig nus la dka' ba cung zad med mod/ de ni rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos ltar snang la dga' ba dag gi lugs yin pas/ nges pa'i don la brten pa'i skabs 'dir mdzes pa ma yin no// zhes bris so// srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi bstan bcos las bshad pa'i brjod bya'i don ni phyag rgya chen po dang*/ rjod byed kyi tshig ni sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi yin la/ de dag rdul phran bzhin gsil nus pa'i mkhas pa 'di ni 'a rdzi rdzi snyam shin tu 'jigs nas nyin par gnyid mi khug pa tsam du gyur to// yang lan gyi tshigs bcad/ brtsad cing dris pa dag gi dbyug pa yis// zhes sogs shwa lo ka dang*/ rab dbyer brgal ba'i rnga la brgal lan gyi// zhes pa'i sh+lo ka gnyis gnad che bar yod kyang*/ cung zad spyan rnam ma bkrab par/ brjod ma thag pa'i stong sbad yol ba'i zol gyis bsgribs nas mi snang bar byas mod kyi/ gzigs par bzhed na srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi sgron me 'degs par mdzod cig/ // ༈ byang smyon rin po ches bskor ba'i shing gi rang 'thag gi sgra las slar yang 'di skad thos te/ da ni bstan bcos dngos la 'jug par bya ste/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi tas/ deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi// byin rlabs dbang bskur yin zhes zer// zhes sogs las 'phros nas/ rje klu sgrub kyis/ byin rlabs tsam bskur yul gyi slob ma de/ las dang po pa ma yin par/ sngar dbang gis smin zin/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyang skyes zin pa zhig yin pa'i shes byed/ byin rlabs kyi gsol btab skabs su/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid drin can gyis// yang dag ye shes mchog thob ste// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo la// bdag ni shin tu nges pa skyes// zhes pa'i lung drangs pa la/

srid gsum du/ bdag ni zhes pas 'khrul gzhi byas nas go log rgyab/ ces dang*/ yang dag ye shes mchog thob zin nas/ slar chos kyi bdud rtsi'i phyir du gsol ba btab nas ci zhig don du gnyer/ zhes bris so// 'di'i lan ni/ spyir rgyud las bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so// zhes pa'i tshig gcig nyid la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag du ma zhig rung ba ltar/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid drin can gyis// zhes sogs la'ang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma gang la sbyar yang go don rung ba ni/ rang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal yangs po mtshon nus su snang*/ zhes bris so// rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i tshig gcig la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag du ma rung ba'i 'chad tshul mkhyen na lta legs par bshad pa yin la// de bzhin du rje sa paṇa gyi gsung rnams la'ang sbyor tshul gong gis rgyas bkab pa'i 'chad rtsom mdzad na bdag dang mi mthun pa med do// thugs rje'i bdag nyid drin can gyis// zhes sogs slob dpon la sbyor dgos pa'i gtan tshig yang dag gzigs/ rje klu sgrub pas slob ma la sbyor ba de thugs kyis gtong ma bde ba'i sgrib zol du gnyis mi 'gal gyi gsung byon pa de yang rnam dpyod cung zad yod pa mtshon nus su cis kyang 'dug de 'phros kyi gsung rjes ma de tsho rkun rgyab rdzun gnon kho ka yang sleb pa'i rtags su 'dug cing lan rgyas bshad srid gsum du bkod pa de kas ma 'thus pa med pa 'dra/ 'on kyang*/ gnyis med ye shes 'di nyid ni// 'gro ba gzhan la yod ma yin// zhes pa'i ye shes de dpe'i ye shes ma yin te/ de ni gnyis chos can yin gyi gnyis med ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis med kyi ye shes de ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang mi gnyis pa'i rdo rje slob dpon khyed lta bu ma gtogs de las gzhan pa'i 'gro ba la yod pa ma yin no// zhes slob dpon gyi che ba brjod nas de lta bu'i gnyis med ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi de bdag gis kyang 'thung ba'i phyir bla ma mchog khyed la gsol ba 'debs/

zhes pa'i tha tshig ste/ gsung rab spyi'i grags tshod la'ang kho bo ni bdud rtsi thob bo zhes pas mtshon te/ rang rang gi thob bya mthar thug gang yin pa de la bdud rtsi zhes gdags shing*/ de dngos su stsol ba po de yang mchog ste dam pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ bla ma mchog la zhes smos so// ye shes grub par de ltar gsol btab kyi mthar 'jug yon phul nas/ dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kun dbang bskur// rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa ni// sangs rgyas kun dngos rnal 'byor ni// thams can yan lag bde ba bskyed// sems can kun gyis ma rtogs pas// 'jig rten mgon pos gsal ba ni// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi thugs// sku dang gsung ni thams cad 'dus// zhes sogs kyi tshig nus la brtag pas slob dpon kho na la sbyor bar gsal lo// de ltar rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang bskur 'di ni/ skal ba mchog ldan smin par byed pa'i dbang ste/ de las gzhan du gyur pa'i dbang mi dgos so zhes ston pa la/ de 'phros su/ da ni khyod kyi chos rnams la// som nyi dag ni mi bya'o// slar ni dbang bskur mi bya ste// gzhan du dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// yang dag chos mchog 'dzin pa ste// khams gsum gyis ni phyag byas pa// dbang bskur khyod kyis thob pas na// 'di las mchog gzhan yod ma yin// ces gsungs so// sngar gyi 'phro la 'jug ste/ nyid kyis dgos dbang gis sangs rgyas nang phan tshun gsol ba 'debs pa'i dper brjod bkod pa ltar bden cing*/ sems can dad pa can gyis ye shes kun ldan gyi sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs pa'ang bden mod kyi/ ye shes kun ldan gyi slob mas slob dpon su zhig la gsol ba gdab// ༈ srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes tsam la mchog gi sgra mi thob/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ khyed rang gzigs rgya chung pas lan pa ste/ 'phags pa lhas/ sgyu lus kyi skabs su/

rang gi sems yang dag pa bzhin du yongs su shes pa sogs drangs pa'i tshig zur gyi yang dag pa zhes bya bas thugs 'tshengs mdzad snang yang*/ gang zag rim gyis bkri dgos pa zhig gi dbang du mdzad nas/ rim pa lnga lam rim gcig tu mdzad pa dang*/ cig car dang thod rgal du bkri 'os pa 'ga' zhig gi dbang du byas nas rim pa re re lam rdzogs su mdzad pa'i dmigs bsal gnyis las/ 'di ni phyi ma slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis bshad pa ltar te/ sgyu lus 'ba' zhig gi thog tu rim lnga rdzogs par 'dod pas sgyu lus skabs su yang dag pa'i zur bzhag pa yin phyir mi 'gal bas gzigs rgya chung ba'i klan ka 'gro sa med lags/ yang kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de// de nyid dri za'i sems can 'gyur// rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin// zhes drangs pa 'dir ma 'brel te/ gzhi lam rnam gzhag ma 'chol bar dgos rgyu 'di lta bu gzhi'i skabs te/ dper na/ rgyud du/ 'chi ba stong pa chos sku la// bar ma do ni longs spyod rdzogs// skye ba sna tshogs sprul skur ston// gsung ba'i skabs dang mtshungs pas gzhan dang mi bsre'o// ༈ yang srid gsum du/ 'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// zhes pa'i tshig la skyabs su 'chol nas/ sngar ye shes skyes zin gyi dam tshig can la snyeg pa 'di'ang rigs pa song song mor bsgoms 'dug kyang snying pos dben te/ 'o na dbang ma thob pa'i gong*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dam bzhag skabs su/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// ces sogs mang du 'byung bas/ de gong du dam tshig gang thob soms dang*/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ rnam dpyod ci ltar long du song ba'i rtags mtshon pa ste/ dbang gi dam tshig gi skabs su/ khas blangs kyis thob pa'i dam tshig dang*/ cho gas thob pa'i dam tshig gnyis las/ phyi ma dngos gzhi'i skabs su thob par 'gyur la/

dngos gzhi/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga re re la ltos nas/ thad so thad so'i dam tshig re yod pa de la 'jog snying gar zla ba rdo rje sgom pa'i cho ga la ltos pa'i dam tshig gsang bar gdams pa la ltos pa/ dam bzhag bzhi la ltos pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom gzung la ltos pa'i dam tshig rnams yin la/ dper na/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// zhes sogs kyi gong du/ zla ba rdo rje dang*/ gsang bar gdams pa'i dam tshig rnams yod pas/ rtsod pa nus med du zhig ces smras so// dam tshig rnam dbye mang po yod kyang*/ dam bzhag bzhi'i skabs su bshad pa'i dam tshig ni/ rgyud las/ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste// rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /ces gsungs pa'i ye shes de la zer bas/ 'di ni zhes nye tshig sbyar la/ dam bzhag gi sngon du ye shes de 'bebs pa ma bshad pas na/ nged kyi lung rigs cer cer long ba min gyi mig 'bras shin tu gsal ba'o// yang nyid kyis/ spyir ni/ dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ ces pa'i dam tshig ni/ ma 'ongs pa sdun bsus pa'i tshul gyis/ dngos gzhi'i dam tshig la 'jog pa gtso che bar ni byed dgos so// zhes smras so/ zla ba rdo rje dang*/ gsang bar gdams pa'i dam tshig rnams/ dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// ces pa'i dam tshig gi khyu nas phud pa ste/ ma 'ongs pa sngon bsus pa'i tshul gyis dngos gzhi'i dam tshig la khyed kyis bzhag pa gang zhig de gnyis la gtso phal gyi khyad par 'jog mi rigs pas so// des na su'i khas blangs dang rtsod pa nus med du song gzigs shig/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rdo rje'i thig rnams gdab pa dang*// rdul tshon dag kyang bkye ba ni// sngags kyi sems dpas mi bya ste// byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka'// zhes pa'i don 'chad pa na/ rje klu sgrub kyis/ sngags kyi sems dpa' de ni/

las dang po pa ma yin par/ dbang gi ye shes skyes zin/ drod 'bring po tsam ma mtha' yang thob pa zhig la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa la/ srid gsum du/ 'o na de'i ya mtha' ji tsam la 'jog rtsis yod/ rgyud ma smin pa zhig la/ smin byed kyi dbang mi bskur na/ smin byed kyi sgra don ga la 'byor gzigs shig ces zer ba ni/ zer rgyu ci yang ma 'byor pa 'u rdug pa'i tshig ste/ sngags kyi sems dpa' de'i ya mtha' ni 'tshang rgya kha ma'i sngags kyi sems dpa' la 'jog rgyud ma smin pa la smin dbang bskur ba nged cis kyang 'dod mod/ 'di skabs kyi sngags kyi sems dpa' de rgyud smin zin zhig yin par/ klu sgrub rgya mtshos bzhed pas/ de la ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur mi dgos par grub na/ khyed kyi rtsod pa de brag cha tsam du zad do// zhes bris so// oṃ ha le ho le ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags la grangs bsnyen song ba'i gshis kyis thog mar lung khungs nor te/ rje klu sgrub kyis rtsod spong du drangs pa'i/ rdo rje'i thig rnams gdab pa dang*/ sogs kyi lung 'di ni ye shes grub pa'i lung yin par rtsod spong rang du gsal bar bshad cing*/ don du'ang de ka yin pa la/ khyed kyis dus 'khor las zhes bris pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang rtsod spong du de nyid kyi le'u bco lnga par yang zhes bris pa'ang cung zad nor ba ste/ tshig de pa le'u bcu bdun pa'i nang na yod mod/ lar mkhas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par bzhed na/ gang dang ci'i thad du ma nor zhing ma 'khrugs pa zhig gal che na'ang*/ bco lnga bcu bdun gyi ltag 'og nor ba tsam la 'gangs chung bas su zhig brtsi/ 'dir sngags kyi sems dpa' de'i ya mtha' drod 'bring tsam la klu sgrub gong mas ngos bzung*/ ma mtha' 'tshang rgya kha ma'i sems dpa' la klu sgrub phyi mas ngos bzung nas/ don du sbyor lam drod kyis/ rang sa nas rgyun mtha'i bar du khyab par mdzad pa'i gtam gsar 'di lta bus thub pa'i gsung rab la brgal tshe/

shākya'i bu rnams 'u mi rdug ka med du snang*/ de yang ye grub las/ rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang*// zhes nas/ rnyed par dka'/ zhes gsung te/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon rtsi bkye ba la sogs pa mi bya'o// sngags kyi sems dpa'i zhes bya ba ni yid skyob par gyur pa'i sngags kyi ye shes te/ yang dag pa'i ye shes mthong bar bya ba zhes bya ba'i don to// zhes pa'i tshig des rang gis dgongs bzhed la gnod pa'i srung 'khor du/ rtsod spong las/ ye shes mthong ba zhes bya ba'i don to zhes smras nas/ rgya gzhung gi tshig la/ ye shes mthong bar bya ba zhes mthong zin kho na ma yin pa'i tshig nus yod pa phri ba de ni 'brog lugs kyi zi rigs so// des na/ sngags kyi sems dpa' de smin zin kho nar mi 'grub pas/ brag cha'i dbyangs la da dung rna ba gtod dgos par 'gyur ro// ༈ srid gsum du/ theg chen sbyor lam pa mtha' dag las dang po par bsdus phyin khyed kyis ma mthar bzhag pa'i drod 'bring po ba de las dang po par ci'i phyir mi 'gro/ gal te 'gro ba zhig na/ de yang las dang po pa ma yin pa nan gyis sgrub pa'i lung rigs thams cad bden med du thal bas/ rnam dpyod gron du song ba ni de 'dra la zer ro// zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ tshig tsam la 'khrul pa ste/ zhes sogs dpe don mang por 'god par mdzad 'dug pa de ni/ thugs rab ho le ba des grub mtha'i gnad dgongs kyang*/ nged kyi bden rgyab mi skyong*/ gong ma'i rdzun rgyab skyor dgos stabs kyi ya ri ma ri ha ri tshu ri'o// ༈ yang rtsod spong las/ sngags kyi sems dpa' mthong lam la snyeg pa rtsa gzhung na med cing*/ kho bos kyang ma smras zhes dang*/ ci ste zer mkhan zhig yod na'ang*/ byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka' dang ci 'gal te/ bris sgrub sogs las dang po'i bya ba byas na/ de rnyed par dka' zhes bya ba'i don du snang ba'i phyir/

zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rang mdangs lha'i 'khor lor shar ba'i bris sgrub byas kyang dngos grub 'phrog pa de bden na/ theg chen 'phags pa sbubs 'thums su los song zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rang mdangs lha'i 'khor lor shar nas sgrub pa ni/ bris sgrub ma yin te/ bris sgrub kyi don ni rdul tshon ras bris sogs phyi rdul bcas su yod pa'i sku de/ ye shes kyi lhar sgrub par zer/ zhes sogs dang*/ khyed kyis ting nge 'dzin rang mdangs lha'i 'khor lor shar ba ces dang*/ bris sgrub zer ba de gnyis nang 'gal gyi tshig tu snang*/ zhes zer ro// nyid kyi thugs la/ bris zer ba byung phyin/ lag pas rdul tshon nam/ pir khyer nas bris pa zhig dgos so snyam mod/ ji skad du/ yid kyi 'khor lo cher bris la// mchod pa kun gyis yang dag mchod// ces pa'i rgyud tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di/ rgya gar ba'i dkyil chog khungs ma gsum tsam gyi nang du drangs pa dang gzhan yang 'di rigs kyi lung mang po zhig 'dug pa la ma gzigs pas/ gzhan la mthong rgya chung pas lan gsungs kyang rang gi mtshang ston pa'i tshig go /des na ting nge 'dzin gyi rang mdangs las shar/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bris/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bshams/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgrub zer ba mang po la hol spyod byas/ yang klan ka 'di dag ni nyams myong med par tshig la 'chol ba'i rang rtags so// zer ba byas 'dug pa/ nged la de 'dra'i nyams myong med pa rang gis 'chings par go lags// ༈ srid gsum du/ gong ma gong ma'i lam rgyud la skyes nas/ 'og ma 'og ma spong rgyu yin na/ zhes sogs rigs pa dang lung bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong shin tu mthar thug pa skyes pa'i tshe/ zhes nas/ sa lugs su zhig gis ma smras/ zhes pa'i bar du rgyas bshad mdzad 'dug pa/ sku skye sngon ma'i gsung gi rgyab skyor du bkod par snang yang 'phrod ldan gyi rnam pa tsam las de la dngos su ma phan kyang*/

spyi bab go ba bzang po byung 'dug pas/ da ni gtsang smyon dang dbus smyon la 'gran 'dzug pa'i byang smyon chen por mnga' gsol lo// de'i rjes su/ spyir btang dmigs bsal bshad pa'i skabs/ shing rag tu/ dus 'khor las sngags kyi sems dpas mi bya ste// byas na dngos grub rnyed par dka'// zhes pa'i sngags kyi sems dpa' yang*/ mchog gi dngos grub don gnyer gyi/ sngags kyi sems dpa' spyi la zer ba yin gyi/ zhes pa 'di ni khungs dang 'brel po 'dug pas/ 'di la dpag na ni/ smyon pa mi 'dra'o// 'on kyang sngags kyi sems dpa'i skor gyi lung 'di grub sde'i gzhung yin la/ dus 'khor du/ rdo rje'i thig rnams gdab pa dang*// rdul tshon dag kyang gdab pa ni// mi bya sngags kyi de nyid kyi// byed na byang chub thob par dka'// zhes pa ste/ 'dir gal te sngags kyi de nyid ni/ sngags zhes pa ye shes te yid skyob par gyur pa'i phyir ro// sngags kyi de nyid de yi gal te rdo rje slob dpon/ zhes sngags kyi skabs su sngags kyi de nyid ces gsungs pa'i khyad tsam gda' yang*/ snying 'grel gyi lung thog tu/ srid gsum las/ lung don lung gis bshad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyi gzhung dang sbyar ba'i smra sgo cung zad spros pa la/ shing rag gi sgra las/ srid gsum du mang po zhig bris pa'i snying po ni/ zhes dang*/ nged kyi ngag nyung ngu yang mang bar byas/ shing rag rang du bskyed rim mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyu yin min sogs 'dir mkho med bshad yams kyi spun pa dpyid dus kyi rlung tsam phyar ba nyung ba'i khul du mdzad snang yang*/ nged kyi zhe 'dod la gcig kyang ma gnod 'dug cing*// yi ges dub phyir lan ma byas mod/ gal te nged la gnod pa zhig na khyed kyi smra ba des chu thub pa ma yin no// ༈ rtsod spong du/ lam zab mo bla ma'i che brjod dang*/

gsang sngags zab mo'i che brjod byas/ chos ston nyan gyis 'bad rtsol cher ma dgos pa la dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba zhes mkhas pa la grags pa der snang*/ de ltar min na/ chos gang 'chad la che brjod de 'dra re snang bas/ rong ston lha dga' dang rje mi la'i dpe'o// zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ 'khrul pa'i dri bral bla ma sa skya pa chen po de nyid kyis gsungs pa'i chos don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po lags kyang*/ bu ru brdzus nas pha rabs gcod pa'i dpe ltar/ deng dus kyi lugs 'dzin kha cig gis zong mar btang zin 'dug pa 'di 'dra ya cha/ rong ston lha dgas rdzogs chen gyi che brjod byas pa rnams mi bden pa ci la yin/ mi las skal ldan du rloms nas ma bsgoms par nyal bsdad pas lan par gda' ba/ don du chos de zab kyang las 'brel med pa'i zhad du snang mod/ lam 'bras lta bu'i zab chos khyad par can yang*/ tshig tsam du bzhag nas ma bsgoms tsa na de nas bshad pa'i lam dang*/ che brjod rnams la/ 'di ni che brjod yin/ don la mi bden/ 'di yang che brjod tsam yin zhes re re nas log lta 'ba' zhig skye ba las 'os ci yod zhes sogs bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ 'di ni khyed rang la khas blangs nang 'gal gyi tshig ste/ rdzogs chen las ni/ skal ldan las 'phro can sgom mi dgos/ zhes bshad la/ de che brjod tsam ma yin par dngos gnas su khyod kyis khas blangs pa dang*/ mi las ma bsgoms par nyal bsdad pas lan zer ba nang 'gal ba dang*/ zhes dang*/ 'og tu bsgom mi dgos pa bden na/ mi las ma bsgoms par nyal yang ci zhig skyon zer/ rdzogs chen skal ldan las 'phro can la sgom mi dgos pas bden kyang*/ srid gsum du/ don du chos de zab kyang las 'brel med pa'i zhad du snang mod zer ba byas pas/ chos de'i las 'phro mi la la med ces par song*/ las 'phro yod na ma bsgoms kyang grol rgyu la/ de'i las med pa'i khar ma bsgoms pas ma grol bar dkar brgyud kyi lam du 'jug dgos byung gda'//

༈ yang khyed kyis/ slob mas thun gcig kyang ma bsgoms par grol ba/ ces pa 'di dngos bstan du bden na/ lam 'bras sgom ga la dgos/ rigs pa shes pa grags pa'i 'khor gsum zer ba de/ 'di 'dra ba thal ngag tu 'phangs pas 'byung ba yin/ zhes dpe med song rgyur bsgom pa'i krab krab mdzad do// 'o na/ khyed kyi bla ma sa chen de slob ma'i ngor rdzun kham po che smra ba po yin te/ slob mas thun gcig ma bsgoms kyang grol ba mi bden pa la de grol bar bshad pa'i phyir/ zer na ci gsungs/ blo tshad mdzod/ des na khyed kyi 'khor gsum de 'dra ba ni rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la sun 'byin cing lam gyi rgyud gcod pa'i 'khor gsum 'jigs su rung bar snang bas/ re zhig chos sde chen po'i them 'og tu sbos shig dang*/ rjes sor gter ston skyag rdzun gling pas 'don par 'gyur ro// spyir khyed rang gi gong 'og mang por/ sbyor lam pa las dang po pa dngos ma yin kyang de'i ming btags pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma sogs rgyud kyi zhu ba po rmongs pa ma yin kyang rmongs pa'i ming btags par smras pa bzhin du lam rim zab mo rnams la'ang ngo bo'i sgo nas/ sgom pa po med sgom pa'ang med// ces pa ltar yin la/ mi sgom pa de ka sgom pa'i ming btags par snang bas na lab lob lhag ma de tsho ni snag shog gron pa tsam du zad// ༈ srid gsum du/ las dang po pa bsod nams kyi mthu che ba zhig la/ rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang smin byed du bskur na/ rgyud las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes brjod par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don yongs rdzogs de la tshang ste/ zhes sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas bkod pa la/ mkhan rin po che'i shing rag tu/ khyod kyi bsam don la/ slob ma'i dri ma bzhi sbyangs pa dang*/ sku bzhi'i nus pa blugs pa'i sgra bshad du ci yod des smin dbang du 'gro'o snyam yang*/

de ltar ga la yin zer/ rang gi thugs dam rgyun khyer la/ bla med kyi lha'i mngon rtogs sgom zhing*/ dbang lha spyan drangs te/ a bhi ṣe ka sogs brjod cing*/ ces sogs dgong zhogs nyams su bzhes rgyu'i thugs dam gyi rim pa tsho'ang rtsod yig la 'debs pa'i log 'dren gnang zhing*/ de la'ang gtor blugs kyi sgra bshad du yod kyang don la de 'dra mi 'ong 'dug pa'i gsung rigs kyis rang gi zab chos la 'khu ba ltar snang mod/ kho bos ni/ las dang po pa bsod nams kyi mthu che ba zhig la zhes gzhi la sbyar/ de la rdo rje ye shes kyis dbang bskur bas/ dri ma bzhi gtor ba dang*/ nus pa bzhi blugs pa'i go don yongs rdzogs tshang zhes brjod pa yin pas/ bdag 'jug gi skabs kyi dbang dang mi 'dra bar grub/ skal ba mchog ldan gyi las dang po pa/ sngar sngags lam du 'jug ma myong ba zhig la dbang de smin byed du bskur bas chig chog tu grol ba'ang yod la/ gal te chig chog tu ma grol tshe/ zab gsal zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gi rgyun yang dag gi dran pas skyong zhing*/ a ba dhu ti'i spyod pa dang*/ gnyis med kyi dam tshig tsam grogs su bsten pas chog des na smin byed kyi smin lugs la/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pas smin pa/ sgom byung rang rang gi smin pa/ smin pa mtshan nyid pa gsum du byas pa'i/ dang po gnyis sngags kyi snod du rung tsam yin pas ji ltar gsung ba bzhin 'di skabs mos pa lam byed kyi sgo nas lam dus kyi thugs dam rnams bsgoms pa'i zol gyis zhal 'don mdzad dgos rgyur 'dug pas/ dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i// gang zag gzhan la sgom dgos so// zhes pa dang*/ smin pa mtshan nyid pa de la grol thob thams cad dbang dus de khar byung bas na/ des na gang zag dbang po rab// dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs// zhes pa der gda'o// 'on kyang khyed kyis gsung rigs la bltas na/

lha dbang bskur ba dang slob ma dbang bskur ba nor ba 'dra ste/ rgyud brtag gnyis na/ de gnyis ston byed kyi le'u so sor yod lags/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir/ bdag cag ni/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi gzhung lugs dang*/ tha na'ang rtsod yig snga phyi rnams la hob spyod ma yin par rtog dpyod zhib mos gtan la 'bebs pa zhig lags pas/ legs bshad kyis yongs su gang ba'i kha 'di las 'gal ba dang ma 'brel ba rgyu ba'i go skabs med la/ rtogs ldan gyi kha nas lung rigs rnam dag mi 'byung bar srid na'ang*/ nga la khyad par mi snang ngo*// ༈ srid gsum du/ dus kyi dbang gis/ gang zag dbang po ma smin pa deng sang mang zhing*/ de la khrid tshul rgyas pa dgos rgyu la/ phyag len sla bcos zor yang du songs dogs nas/ rab dbyer byin rlabs tsam gyi smin byed kyis go mi chod pa'i gsung sgros byung ba rnams skabs thob kyis 'grel ma shes par/ rnam pa kun tu de kho na'o snyam/ zhe la bzhag nas chos kyi gtam smra bar byed pa ni phyogs gcig pa'i blo ro yin la/ don rtsa slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang bstun nas/ smin byed dbang gi go rim rgyas bsdus mdzad pa ni 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub du ma'i gzhung las byung ba bzhin bya/ zhes sogs dang*/ phung po khams dang skye mched la// sogs drangs pa las/ byang smyon rin po ches/ nged kyi rab dbye'i gzhung khyed kyis 'dren par rang mtshang che snyam zhe la bzhag pa'i kha bun la/ shing rag tu/ phung po khams dang skye mched la// zhes sogs khyed rang gi 'dod thog tu ci nus drangs te/ don gyi snying po sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis/ sa paṇa gyi gsung 'grel ma shes pa ma gtogs/ sa paṇa rang gi dgongs pa byin rlabs smin byed yin par bzhed rgyu'i tshul du drangs pa ni/ bon pos bon chos dbyer med du 'dren pa dang khyad par ci zhig yod/ zhes snying khams bskyed nas smras so// rje sa paṇa gyis mtha' drug gi sgo nas gzhung 'chad dgos tshul mang du gsungs shing*/

khyed rang gis blo gros kyi rtsal yod rgyu'i khul gyis 'chor ngoms la/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang*/ rgyu'i gleng gzhi dang*/ rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang gis gsol ba btab don dpon slob gang la sbyar kyang song ba'i 'chad tshul shes par zhal gyis 'ches pa de stong bshad min na/ 'di thad du drangs pa'i rab dbye'i gzhung la'ang de 'dra ba'i 'chad tshul cis mi thob soms dang*/ gang zhig 'gro ba dag la nyi tshe ba// de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung ma yin// zhes pa'i khrod du sa paṇa yang khyed kyis 'dzud dam// deng sang rdo rje phag mo yis// zhes sogs kyi gzhung tshig 'di rnams rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang gi skabs su khyed kyis drangs pa'ang dgos med yin te/ dbang de phag mo'i byin rlabs ma yin pa'i phyir ro// ci ste phag mo'i byin rlabs smin dbang yin min la rtsod par bzod pa'i blo gros yod na slad kyi smra bar bya yi 'dir mi spro la/ phung po khams dang skye mched la// zhes sogs nged kyi phyogs su drangs pa ni kho bo rang gi dad stobs kyis yin cing*/ drangs pa tsam gyis kyang gzhung de don la 'byor song bas sa paṇa la zhabs tog chen po'o// bon chos bsres pa smin byed dang byin rlabs bsres pa dang 'dra na bon po'i tshab khyed lugs kyis gyis shig/ ༈ yang shing rag stong sgra las/ deng sang rang gzhan mang po dag byin rlabs smin byed yin pa sa paṇa gyis bkag snyam pa snang yang*/ sa lugs la thog mar/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen po rtse mos/ bod 'di na/ phub phra mo re'i steng du nas 'dra'i g.yung drung ris byas pa la dkyil 'khor du byed pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ rje btsun grags pas/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs tsam la brten nas/ gsang ba ston pa yod pa de ni nor ba ste/ zhes sogs drangs pa'i dgongs pa la brtag na/ sa paṇa du ma zad rje btsun sku mched kyis kyang bkag zer rgyu yin pa 'dra na/

byin rlabs smin byed yin pa sa paṇa kho nas bkag snyam pa snang yang zer dgos kyang*/ yi ge pas chad pa'am/ rtsom pa pos nor ram/ de ltar ma yin na ni brjod byas stongs so// yang zlos su byas zhes khyed kyis nged la kha zer ba des na/ khu dbon gsum gyis yang zlos su mdzad pa 'di la'ang smod dam/ des na sa paṇa byin rlabs smin byed yin pa dang min pa gang bzhed kyang 'dra ste/ de nan gyis sgrub pa'i ngal ba bsten don med pas khyed rang gi phyogs su brdzangs yod do// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ dus 'khor gyi dbang dang*/ grangs nges las 'phros pa'i dpyad pa cung zad/ rje klu sgrub pa dang*/ srid gsum mkhan po gnyis kas mdzad snang mod/ zhes sogs mang po bris pa'i don gyi snying po/ 'grel tshul gyis don sna tshogs su 'gyur rgyu'i khul gyis bya khral byung tshe byi so kho yang gcig ngom pa de bzhin du/ dus 'khor gyi dbang la grangs nges mdzad pa dang*/ byis dbang sngon du ma song ba'i mchog dbang tshad ldan mi bshad pa rnams ni/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams dang*/ dus 'khor gyi chos sku gcig tu sgrub pa'i skabs te/ zhes smos 'phral/ yang lugs 'di rgyud sde gzhan gyi 'jog mtshams dang bstun dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ des mtshon te jo bo mi 'jigs pa'i lugs kyang*/ 'phags yul gyi bka' srol logs pa zhig yin pas/ de dag rab dbye'i grub mtha' dang bstun dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang ba ni byi khral byung tshe bya gshog ngom pa de mi tshe gar phyid kyi gtam tsam yin gyi gzhung tshugs pa'i chos skad ma yin no// ci'i phyir na/ 'jigs med zhabs dang*/ dus 'khor gyi lugs rab dbye'i grub mtha' dang bstun mi dgos na/ dus 'khor lugs dang rgyud sde gzhan gcig tu bsgrub nas gang mdzad dang*/ rab dbye 'chad skabs de dag drangs nas ci mdzad soms shig/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ 'di dag la bshad pa byas na mang du yod kyang logs su 'chad par spro'o// zhes smras te/

rkang ma tshugs pa'i bshad nyog mang pos ci bya/ da dgos logs su mi 'chad pa zhu lags// ༈ yang shing rag las/ de las 'phros pa'i tshul du thabs shes rab gtan la dbab par/ gsang dbang tshig zin la gsal por ma byung ba tsam la 'khrul nas/ 'brug pa dang*/ srid gsum mkhan po gnyis kas/ gsang dbang ma bskur bar/ shes dbang bskur du rung*/ zhes dang*/ de'i shes byed du/ gzhung so so tha dad kyi 'jog mtshams mi gcig pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa ni/ dbang bzhi'i ming dang go rim tsam la'ang rmongs pa ste/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste// gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang*// bzhi pa de ni de bzhin nyid// ces dbang bzhi la/ dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams kyi ming mdzad la/ gsang dbang ma bskur bar sher dbang bskur na/ gsang dbang la gnyis pa dang*/ sher dbang la gsum pa'i ming ci la thob/ zhes sogs tshig spun mang du phyar ro// de ni rkyang pa'i grangs nyung ngu tsam gyi rnam bzhag la'ang rmongs pa ste/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i dbang dngos su nor 'dug pa'i phyir ro// zhes smras na/ ci gsung*/ rgyu mtshan/ thabs shes gtan dbab kyi rim phye gsum par/ tshogs dkyil sgrub pa der gsang dbang bskur/ dam tshig phog slob dpon du byed pa'i rjes gnang phyin/ sher dbang gi 'phros med par/ de'i mthar dbang bskur ba smin byed du bshad de/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bskur de dag blang bar bya// rjes su gnang ba thob nas 'jig rten gsum po yi// bya byed ngan pa'i dgra las rgyal ba'i blor ldan pas// dri ma med pa de nyid grub pa'i gnas der ni// 'jug pa'i sems kyis rgyal ba de nyid rnal 'byor bya'o// zhes don bsdus dang bcas pa gsol/ des na khyed kyis/ gsang dbang tshig zin la gsal po ma byung ba tsam la 'khrul nas/ zer ba de ni shes pa rnal du mi gnas pa'i gtam du shes par gyis shig
