yang khyed rang gi gong du bkod pa'i rigs pa de 'dir yang 'jug ste/ 'di'ang 'phags yul gyi bka' srol logs pa zhig yin pas/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste// sogs kyi lung dang bstun dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang zer na ci gsung*/ de'i phyir nged kyis/ gzhung so so tha dad kyi mtshams mi gcig pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ zhes ma smras sam// yang khyed kyis/ tshig zin la gsal po ma byung ba tsam la zer ba byas nas/ mi gsal ba ma gtogs dbang bzhi'i grangs dang go rim spyir btang bzhin yod rgyu'i khul byas 'dug pa/ 'o na/ dbang gzhan rnams gsal por bshad nas/ gcig kho na mi gsal bar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/ slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rje de yang khyed kyi so sor yang dag par rig pa thob zer ba bzhin rjed nges kyi mun pa 'thibs nas lus pa'am/ dbang bzhi'i ming dang go rim la rmongs pa gang zhig yin bsam dgos so// des na khyed rang gi gong du smos pa bzhin/ 'di yin gyis/ gzhan ni ma yin no zhes bsnyad par mi rung ba ltar ro zhes smras pa de e dran to// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ byis dbang sngon du ma song bar/ mchog dbang bzhi pa nyid smin dbang du 'gyur ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skad sgos tsam pa zhig ste/ lugs 'di rgyud sde gzhan gyi 'jog mtshams dang bstun dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ zhes smras pa'ang 'di dang mtshungs so// sher dbang dngos su ma bskur kyang*/ dbang bskur tshul 'di smin dbang du 'gro ba ni/ grub sde'i chos skad sgos tsam pa yin te/ lugs 'di gzhung lugs gzhan gyi 'jog mtshams dang bstun dgos pa ma yin no// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ dbang bzhi la dang po gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams kyi ming mdzad la/ zhes sogs dang*/ skabs kyi dpe dang*/ dga' ba'i dpe dang*/ rdo rje bzhi'i dpe sogs mang du gleng ba thams cad/ byis pa dar ma de nas rgan// sogs drangs pa'i dpe bden med du btang ste/

byis pa'i gnas skabs skyed byed kyi dbang ni chu sogs rjes gnang gi dbang bdun yin la/ dbang bdun sngon du ma song bar mchog dbang bskur ba smin byed du khyed kyis khas blangs pa gang zhig de ni byis pa'i gnas skabs sngon du ma song ba'i dar ma rgan po sogs yod pa bzhin sngar gyi go rim thams cad de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir// ༈ yang khyed kyi lab lob mang po'i mjug tu/ khyad par du khyod nā ro pa'i brgyud 'dzin gtsang mar bzhed na/ rnal 'byor pa dbang rnon la gsang dbang ma bskur bar sher dbang bskur zer ba'i grub mtha' 'di ni nā ro pa'i gsung dang nges par 'gal ba ste/ zhes smras mod/ da dung brtags gzhig ma tshud par gnyis pa dang gsum pa nor ba kho na rgyun mar 'dzer to// nged cag ni nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin gtsang rgyu gang yod gtsang ba lags pas gsung rgyu yod tshad gsungs shig khyed kyis nā ro 'grel chen gyi lung drangs par/ mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa la/ stong pa nyid ?mi bsgoms pa'i don dbang bzhi ka sbyin la/ zhes rnal 'byor pa dbang rnon mchog don gnyer la dbang bzhi ka bskur bar gsungs kyis/ 'ga' zhig mi bskur bar ma bshad ces khyed kyis smras te/ rje btsun nā ro pa ni/ spyir gsung rab mtha' dag dang*/ bye brag rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi mnga' bdag lags pa'i phyir/ gdul bya sna tshogs pa'i dbang po yi rjes su nye bar 'gro ba'i dbang gi rgyas bsdus dang go rim 'dra la 'dra min mang ba zhig bzhed kyi/ gdul bya mchog dman gang la'ang gti thug khrid gcig kho na'i khrid tshul mi mdzad pa rgya 'bag gi mig bzhin 'khrul chags par ston pa ni rdo rje theg pa la thabs mang ba zhes bsngags pa'i don de'o// nā ro 'grel chen gyi lung khungs der mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa la sogs bshad kyi dbang rnon 'phros mi snang yang*/ thugs 'dod zhal du 'tshangs pas dbang rnon zer ba zhig lhan par btab mod/

mchog don gnyer gyi dbang brtul yang yod pa yin no// des na/ lung de ni gsang sngags spyi mthun gyi dbang du mdzad la/ 'di lta bu ni dmigs bsal te/ spyir btang ba la dmigs kyis bsal// bstan bcos kun la rab tu gces// zhes pa'ang don la gnas pa'i phyir/ spyir rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams su dbang dang sgrub thabs las rab 'byams sogs kyi cho ga ma tshang ba rnams gzhan la zhal 'phangs mang du mdzad pa yod pa ni nges par bden mod kyi/ ye shes grub pa dang*/ thabs shes gtan dbab kyi zab dbang 'di gnyis la dbang chog gzhan nas kha 'gengs mi dgos pa'i steng du/ rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i// ye shes mchog dbang thob pa yis// rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur bas// dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya// yang dag ye shes kun ldan pas// bris pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs gzhan du// dbang bskur ba ni len byed na// 'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sems can kun gyis ma rtogs par// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi thugs// sku dang gsung ni thams cad 'dus// zhes sogs gsungs pas rang skya tshugs pa yin no// dkyil chog rdor 'phreng sogs slob dpon tshad mas mdzad pa phal mo cher yang*/ kha 'gengs dgos dang*/ 'khrugs sdeb dgos dang*/ go rim sgrigs dgos gang yod/ bsgrigs zin pa'i phyir slad bcos mdzad mi dgos pa ka shas che'o// spyi rgyud dang*/ snying 'grel gyi lung des 'di mi 'grub ste/ lung de pa'i bstan don rgyud ni rgyud gzhan dag gi shes dgos pa la dgongs la/ grub sde 'di dag ni rgyud kyi 'khrugs bsdebs nas mngon rtogs su bsgrigs grub pa yin pa'i phyir// ༈ yang srid gsum du rnal 'byor pa drod thob pa la dbang bzhi bskur mkhan gyi slob dpon de blo dang mi ldan gsung rgyu e yin/ ces bkod pa la/ nyid kyis de ni 'brel med do// drod thob pa'i slob ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba po de blo dang mi ldan par su zhig smra/

zhes bris so// de ni rje klu sgrub rgya mtshos smras te/ rtsod spong du/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gsang ba grub par/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba zhes bshad pa de gnyis ni rnal 'byor pa mngon spyod dang kun bzang gi spyod pa sogs spyod pa'i tshe bogs dbyung ba'i phyir bzhi pa rten can bskyar nas bskur ba lta bu yin gyi/ las dang po la bskur ba ma yin gyi zhes sogs smras pa des na/ gzhung de gnyis sogs las/ dbang gi go rim khrigs chags ma yin par thod brgal du rnal 'byor pa la bskur bar bshad pa gang zhig de ltar du bskur mkhan gyi slob dpon de blo dang mi ldan par khyed kyis lung gis bsgrubs 'dug pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rdo rje slob dpon blo dang ldan pas/ dbang la 'chol ba'i skyon spangs la/ dbang bzhi go rim bzhin du bskur bar bya'o// zhes drangs pa'i ldog zla'o// ༈ srid gsum du/ rgyu dbang bskur tshul de tsam la ha che mi dgos/ dus 'khor las/ 'jug pa'i byin dbab dus su sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje phebs par bshad pa'i ye shes rdo rje dngos su babs pa'i tshe/ de nyid du 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa ltar na/ dbang ma bskur bar mchog thob par song zhes bkod pa la/ khyed kyis/ bsdus rgyud kyi lung gi thog tu dgongs pa lung ston gyi khung drangs nas/ ye shes dbab pa'i stobs kyis slob ma de nyid du grol ba zhig yod pa kho bo cag kyang 'dod mod/ de'i tshe dbang ma bskur bar grol bar mi 'gro ste/ tshe snga ma la dbang bzhi dang*/ rim gnyis kyi sbyangs pa sngon du song nas/ nyams myong gi rgyun ma nyams pa'i las 'phro can zhig la tshe 'dir/ dngos gzhi'i dbang ma bskur yang*/ ye shes phab pas sad pa'i rkyen byas te grol ba lta bu yin gyi/ zhes sogs dang*/ mdo'i dper brjod bkod pa dang bcas pa ni/ thugs rab kyi klong las rdol ba'am/

stabs legs kyis 'grigs pa gang yin kyang 'dra/ legs bshad kyi grangs su gtogs pa tsam mo// 'on kyang nyams myong gi rgyun cung zad nyams pa zhes sam rjed pas byed rkyen la rag lus gda'o// des na/ bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i lung gnyis thun mong gi sgrub byed du 'gyur la/ 'on kyang yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na// sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*// zhes pa la 'bru gnyer tshul gyi gsang 'don lugs rgya 'grel las 'byung ba bzhin 'chad ma shes na smra ba po la skyon 'di 'jug ste/ rgyud kyi don ni zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin la/ sems can tshul bzhin du dbang ma thob pas mi shes pa'i phyir/ zhes smra bar 'gyur dgos/ 'di thad kyi don rtsa dbang bskur mu bzhi rtsi ba dang mi rtsi ba'i tshul la rag ste/ de rtsi ba dag gis 'dod pa phyogs gcig ltar na/ ji skad du/ tshe 'dir dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa zhig /med na sngags sdom sems rjes 'brang ba ci// zhes pa ni khyed kyi bzhed pa dang cha tsam mthun la/ yang phyogs gcig ltar na/ bshad rgyud sdom 'byung las/ sngon gyi dge rtsa la ltos nas// dbang po brtul 'bring rnon por 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ tshe 'dir sbyangs stobs ma yin par rang bzhin gyis dbang po ches rno zhing bsod nams kyi dpal ches cher 'bar ba dag kyang snang na/ de ni tshe rabs snga mar theg pa gsum gyi lam du ma zhugs kyang bsod nams kyi mthu chen po stobs su gyur pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi'i skye ba gang zhig la'ang*/ rtsa rlung thig le ches dwangs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu mtshan dpe rjes mthun pas brgyan la/ de la rag pa'i rtsa mdud med par bshad pa dang*/ de'i thig le sngon po dang*/ bu thu bo'i thig le ser por bshad pa lta bu/ gang la rtsa mdud rag pa med pa de ni bsod nams kyi stobs te/

sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe re la rgyu bsod nams brgya phrag mang po bshad pa dang rjes su mthun zhing*/ des na 'khor los bsgyur bar 'gyur ba'i gang zag la lam zhugs nges par mi dgos/ de lta bu'i gang zag sngags lam du gsar du 'jug na/ dang por dbang bskur/ de nas rim gnyis sogs kab kab krig krig rim 'jug pa'i khrid tshul de mi dgos par dbang bskur ba'i bya rtsol la ma ltos par rang bzhin gyis thob pa yod pa la bsam nas dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa'i gang zag gcig 'dod mod kyi/ des dbang rim las 'byung ba'i ye shes sogs thob byar gyur pa thams cad cig car du thob/ sad rmis gnyid 'thug bzhi pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa'i spangs byar gyur pa thams cad kyang dus gcig la dag pas na/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med// ces sogs dang*/ de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid// ces sogs kyi rgyud lung de dag gis de la mi gnod pa tsam la cha ma bzhag phan kho na'o// de ltar legs bshad kyi smra sgo mang po thal ba la mi dgyes pa ma mdzad cig gsol ba 'debs so// rtsa ltung gi skor 'di la sogs pa'i skabs mang por/ la lar dus 'khor gyi lung 'dren mdzad nas rgyud sde gzhan la rgyas 'gebs gang thub la 'bad/ la la'i thad du byed dka' byung tsa na/ dus 'khor dang rgyud sde gzhan snang mun bzhin lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba yin pa ltar smra ba de legs pa ma yin te/ mdor bsdus dang por/ 'di ni dpal ldan dus 'khor lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor thams cad nas// bden pa gnyis la gnas pa ni/ mngon par brjod de'i rjod byed 'gyur// zhes dang*/ theg pa kun don gsal byed de// pad+ma dkar po bdag gis ni// rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'jug cing*// gzhung ni stong phrag bcu gnyis te// rdo rje'i tshig 'byed dang bcas pa// bsdus pa'i rgyud la bri bar bya// zhes gsungs te/

sprul pa'i rigs ldan chen po de nyid rdzun mi gsung ba zhig na/ dus kyi 'khor lo 'di theg pa thams cad kyi gsal byed du bshad cing mi mthun par ma bshad do// rtsa ltung lnga pa sogs kyi thad du rnam pa tsam la 'gal ba ltar snang yang 'gal med du 'chad nus pa'i legs bshad kyi 'phrul dbyangs can lha mo'i rgyud mang gi sgra las mnyan par mdzod cig/ ༈ rab dbyer/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// chos drug bor nas lam 'bras dang*// phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa// gzhan gyi gdams ngag sgom bzhin du// nā ro'i brgyud pa 'ded byed pa// gzhan dang 'gal ba lta ci smos// rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin// zhes gsungs pa la/ rje 'brug pas/ phyag rgya chen po gzhan gyi gdams ngag yin pa dang*/ lam 'bras sgom bzhin pa gnyis ka ma grub pa/ dgag pa 'di ni/ phyogs chos ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs su snang*/ des na rgol ba nyid tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung ngo*// zhes gan mdzod du bris pa la/ rje klu sgrub kyis/ tshar bcad la rtsad pa'i lan rgya cher mdzad pa rnams/ sde bdun gyi dgongs pa bla na med pa yin la/ de la pha rol po'i lan gyis ci yang zlog ma nus mod/ smra ba'i lce chad zer ba'i grags pa'i sgrib zol tsam du/ srid gsum las/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag gi lo rgyus tsam zhig bris 'dug kyang*/ nus pa ci yang ma byung ste/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ mu stegs kun tu rgyu ma 'phrad kyang*/ kun tu rgyu tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung ngo*// zer ba'i lo rgyus yod na phyogs 'gro tsam srid mod/ shā ri'i bu ni/ nga dang de dag 'phrad na tshar bcad zin pa zhig na/ bdag gis ma tshor zhes de gnyis/ phrad na kun tu rgyu de tshar bcad kyi gnas su nges kyang*/ ma 'phrad pa'i stobs kyis de ltar ma byung*/ zhes pa'i don yin/ tshar bcad ma zin pa la tshar bcad pa'i gnas su lhung ngo*// zhes brjod na rdzun du yang cis mi 'gyur/

sde bdun las ni/ rgol ba gang smra ba'i spobs pa zlog pa'i dus der tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung bar bshad do// gal te rtsod pa mi zlog na/ tshar bcad pa'i gnas su gyur/ zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung yang*/ klu sgrub rgya mtshos rgya cher gsungs pa de kas dpyod ldan la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dir ched kyis smra ma dgos/ ci ste smras kyang bod skad mi shes pa'i a tsa ra la/ bod tshig gi gtam gleng ba dang mtshungs pas dgos pa med la/ 'dir blo rab 'bring kun gyi go byed du 'di tsam zhig brjod de/ sngon bram ze skar rgyal dang*/ bram ze gnas len gyi bu gnyis rtsod pas/ gnas len gyi bu mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pas/ de tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung bar bshad de/ 'dul ba lung las/ shes ldan dag rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor shoms shig ces pa nas/ bra ze gnas len gyi bu cang mi smra bar 'dug go /tshar bcad pa'i gnas rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste/ lan la spobs pa med pa 'di ni tha chad yin no// zhes pa'i bar thog mtha' bsdus nas drangs te/ mi bzang ba'i bzang mdog gtso bor ston nas byung ba la ngo so byas so// rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ ji skad du/ des na mkhas pas grub mtha'i skyon// gzu bor brjod pas tshar bcad kyis// gang zag skyon dang bdag bstod pa// ngan 'gro'i rgyu phyir mkhas pas spangs// zhes gsungs pa'i mi mthun phyogs su 'dug pa'i phyir/ de yang*/ pha rol gyi grub mtha' la skyon yon ci 'dug gzu bos brtags nas skyon nges par yin pa zhig na tshar bcad dgos par gsungs na/ khyed kyis ni rang blo 'khyog pos gzhan gyi legs bshad rnams kyang tshar gcod mi nus bzhin du gcod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston/ rgol bar ngos bzung ba la re zhig dmad par 'os kyang*/ bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin spyi khyab dang lhag par dkar brgyud pa thams cad la dmod mo mi bzad pa spros/

khyed rang gsung rab thams cad la dbang 'byor tshul dang*/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa thob tshul dang*/ thogs med kyi spobs pa mnga' tshul sogs gzhan gyi zer mkhan med kyang khyed rang gis yang dang yang du bsgrags pa 'di rnams/ ngan 'gro'i rgyur e 'gro drang po'i thugs ldan dag gis mkhyen par mdzod cig de yang gan mdzod du tshar gcod kyi 'phros gleng mdzad pa 'di dag rtog ge la grags pa'i tshar bcad dang bstun dgos pa'i nges pa'ang med mod/ ci ste de phyogs su zlog par bzhed na'ang*/ tshig rtsa zin par bya yi gya tshoms su smra ba ni legs pa ma yin no// dran pa nyer bzhag gi lung 'dir/ shā ri'i bu dang mu stegs dngos su 'dzom na shā ri'i bu'i rigs pas mu stegs de nyid tshar bcad nges pa la/ ma phrad pas ka de dag dang phrad na tshar bcad zin pa la/ zhes te/ dper na 'jig rten pa kha cig kyang*/ dgra de dang dngos su phrad na de dag bsad grub yod pa la ma phrad zer ba lta bu/ des tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung zhes pa'ang*/ lung rigs ngan pa de tshar bcad pa'i gnas yin pas na/ tshar bcad kyi 'os sam tshar bcad pa'i yul lam gnas su gyur pas lhung zhes smos kyi/ dngos su tshar bcad pa zhig na de 'dra ci smra/ khyed kyis shā ri'i bu dang mu stegs kun tu rgyu ma phrad kyang kun tu rgyu tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung ngo*// zer ba'i lo rgyus yod na phyogs 'gro tsam srid mod ces lhung zhes pa'i ming yod med la rtsod par snang mod/ 'o na khyed rang gis drangs pa'i lung*/ gal te rtsod pa mi zlog na// tshar bcad pa yi gnas su gyur/ zhes 'byung gi lhung zhes pa mi 'dug pas/ lung de ni khyed kyi rgyab skyor phyogs 'gro tsam yang ma yin te/ mkhas 'jug las/ mi smra bar gyur pa tsam gyis skabs don 'grub na/ mtshon dang me la sogs pas bsdigs pas mi smra ba yang der 'gyur bas ha cang thal lo// zhes gsungs pa de ci red/

de la gtan tshigs yang dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i smra sgo ji snyed mchis bzhin du/ smra ba'i lce chad zer ba rang mtshang che zhing*/ nus pa byung ma byung blo tshad rnams la dris shig/ ༈ yang khyed kyis/ ci ste smras kyang bod skad mi shes pa'i a tsa ra la bod tshig gis gtam gleng ba dang mtshungs pas dgos pa med la/ zer ba byas so// de'i zhe 'dod tshad ma shes rgyu'i khas len du snang mod/ spyir mu stegs dang*/ sgos grangs can pa bod 'di na pha tshan mi rtsa gang yang med pa'i khar/ rgya gar nas 'ongs pa dag kyang slob dpon chen po pad ma'i bka' ltar brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis bkag pa la brten/ bod pa'i tshad ma ba rnams kyis mu stegs pa rnams nya ngar 'og tu 'chos chog chog gi stabs kyis/ ji ltar gtor rgyab la chas pa'i dmag mi dag dgra mig lam du med kyang*/ phyogs der rngams rngams ltar rgyug pa bzhin du/ grangs can la sogs pa'i phag tu bzang bzang mo'i 'chor stangs byed par 'dug ste/ khong tshang gi rigs pa smra ba kha yar bod du lhags na/ tshar bcad sogs rigs pa'i 'jug sgo saṃskṛta'i skad du smra ba lta ci/ grong khyer ba'i phal skad tsam yang mi shes pas rmongs dus/ khyed rang tshos bslabs pa'i rnam 'grel gyi thal phreng spar mo gang pos gang du yang sleb pa ma yin// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus gnas len gyi bu mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pas/ de tshar bcad kyi gnas su lhung bar bshad/ 'dul ba lung las/ shes ldan dag rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor shoms shig ces pa nas/ bram ze gnas len gyi bu cang mi smra bar 'dug go /tshar bcad pa'i gnas rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste/ lan la spobs pa med pa ni tha chad yin no// zhes drangs mod/ 'dul ba lung du/ gnas len gyi bus bsam pa/ skar rgyal 'di gzhung gsar byed pa gsal bas/ bdag gi lhan cig smra bar mi nus kyi/ ji dang lhag gi tshig 'dred pa tsing cig bya'o snyam nas rgyun chags lnga brgya bzlas so// skar rgyal gyi bus phyir bzlas te/

khyed kyi 'di ni rig pa med pa yin no// 'di ni mi mthun pa yin no// 'di ni mi 'thad pa yin no// zhes skyon btags pa dang*/ bram ze gnas len gyi bu cang mi smra'o// tshar bcad pa rnams kyi nang nas lan la spobs pa med pa tha chad yin no// zhes gsungs la/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis mkhas 'jug tu/ 'dri na skabs su bab pa 'di// cig car rnam grangs mang po min// zhes pa'i rang 'grel las/ mu stegs byed dag rgol bas phyogs snga ma mi 'dra ba'i rgyun chags brgya la sogs ngag rgyun gcig la ston nas de phyir rgol gyi go rim ma 'khrugs par phyogs sngar rjes su brjod de/ de nas go rim phyogs phyi mas sun 'byin pa la/ de lta bu'i phyogs sngar brjod ma nus na rjes su mi brjod pa zhes bya ba tshar bcad kyi gnas su 'gyur ro zhes zer ro// rtsod pa'i rigs par skabs su bab pa'i phyogs snga re re nas sun dbyung bas chog mod/ skabs su ma bab pa'i phyogs snga rjes su brjod pa ni sgrub pa sun 'byin gyi yan lag ma yin pa nyid kyis tshar bcad du dgongs so// zhes gsungs te/ don gyi snying po/ bram ze gnyis rgyun chags lnga brgya bton pa dang*/ de sun phyung ba'i tshul gyis gtam de rang lugs 'thad ldan du byas nas ngom ngom yer yer du smras pa'i mgor/ sa paṇa gyi thog rgod de lhung ma thag ardza ka'i bdog pa ltar gas te/ lha bdud du babs pa ni de 'dra ba la zer ro// des na/ 'di rigs kyi gsung ci tsam mang gin sngo lo 'phyar ba las spros pa'i dgos nus gang yang med cing*/ lhag par chos sde chen po'i bstan pa la dgongs nas gsung tshad zin par mdzad du gsol// ༈ yang khong gi zhal nas/ gan mdzod du/ phyag rgya chen po gzhan gyi gdams ngag yin pa ma grub ces pa las 'phros nas/ srid gsum du/ gzhan zhes pa bka' gdams la zer bar grags kyang*/ zhes sogs bris mod/ 'di skabs gzhan zhes pa/

chos drug la bsre bslad bcug pa'i chos lugs thams cad la zer zhing*/ khyad par du rgya nag gi gdams ngag la zer bar dgongs nas/ rab dbyer da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni// phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin// zhes bshad pas/ gzhan zhes pa bka' gdams la zer bar grags pa ni/ bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin la/ sngon chad/ sa lugs kyi bla ma mang pos/ sdom gsum gyi yig cha ji snyed cig brtsams 'dug pa rnams la 'brel yod med sna tshogs snang bas/ de dag tu bshad pa tsam gyis go chod pa ma yin gyi/ gong ma lnga po rang gi dgongs pa gzhung 'dzug par rigs so// zhes smras so// gong ma lnga'i dgongs pa gzhung 'dzug pa zhig cis kyang dgos te/ de mkhas pa snga ma tshos ma tshugs phyin/ khyed kyis 'dzug pa'i thugs rloms gyis bka' drin bskyang kyang 'o brgyal ba las ci med cing*/ gzhan zhes pa chos drug la bsre bslad bcug pa'i chos lugs thams cad la zer zhes pa'ang ma bden pa 'dra ste/ de ltar na deng sang gi mkhas rloms smra kham can 'ga' dang mi 'dra bar/ rje sa paṇa de nyid mkhas pa'i nang nas mkhas pa dpe bral zhig yin pa'i stabs kyis/ de 'dra min pa'i tshig bcad rtsom rigs pa'i phyir/ chos drug gzhan dang bsre ba la chos drug bor zhes pa'i sgra ji ltar 'jug ste/ phye mar dang bsres pa la phye bor ba'i tha snyad mi 'jug pa 'dra'o// gal te chos drug chos gzhan dang bsres pa lta na/ chos drug gi rtsa ba'i gzhung ka dpe che chung*/ 'pho bsre che chung*/ chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur sogs gzhung khungs ma rnams na med pa'i lhad 'di dang 'di'o zhes bstan rgyu dgos kyang*/ de ni ri bong gi rwa rno brtul bzhin du gyur pas tshod 'jog gi smra lce brel ba tsam las snying po gzhan gar yod/ khyad par/ chos drug gzhan dang bsres pa la phyag rgya chen po zer mkhan khungs ma mi snang bas na/ da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni// phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin// gsung pa'i lung yang skabs 'dir cung mi 'gab lags//

༈ shing gi rang 'thag tu/ 'brug pa dpon slob gnyis kas/ lam 'bras sgom bzhin pa ma grub ces smras pa'ang*/ jo bo ngan pa tsam ste/ phag grus lam 'bras nyan sgom byas nas/ gzhung dang man ngag gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i yi ge mngon sum na snang ba dang*/ dkar brgyud ri chos skor gsum na/ lam 'bras kyi bshad pa dang*/ gdams ngag gnyis ka mang du bris pa dang*/ lam 'bras kyi gegs sel phal cher zhig dkar brgyud kyi yi ge dag tu legs par mdzad 'dug pas so// zhes bris so// sngar kho bo jo bo bzang po yin na'ang*/ shes rab dga' tshad yod pa la jo ngan khyed kyis bslabs pas 'phral du shes pa lags/ gan mdzod las/ sgom bzhin zhes pa sngar de la zhugs pa tsam min zhes rus bton pa'i lugs so// zhes pa'i tshig nus la ma brtags par/ phag grus lam 'bras nyan sgom gtan nas ma byas zhes smra bar 'dug go snyam du dgongs par snang ste/ de ni sngags 'bru brgyad la/ grangs bsnyen song ba'i sngags nus su go lags/ rje phag grus bla chen kun dga' snying po'i drung du lam 'bras gsan/ nyams su bzhes/ thun mong gi nyams myong mang po 'khrungs pa mthong lam du ngo sprod thems par thob nas/ gzhung bshad dpe mdzod ma sogs yig sna nyer gcig mdzad pa la bsnyon du ci yod kyang des thugs ma tshim par sgam por byon nas dkar brgyud kyi gdam pa gsan pas 'phags lam gyi mngon rtogs thugs la 'khrungs par gda'/ des na/ lam 'bras gsan kyang*/ phyis gtang snyoms su mdzad pas na lam 'bras sgom bzhin pa ma yin zer rgyu lags so// rje yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum gyi nang tshan rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad dang*/ gzhan yang sa lugs kyi man ngag zab khyad kha yar snang ba chos rje sa paṇa las gsan cing*/ de pa'i brgyud pa la'ang*/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen sa skya pa// zhes bkod/ zha ma lcam sring las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsan nas/

de skor gyi brgyud pa la/ sa gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i ko brag pa// zhes sogs bkod gda' na'ang*/ ri chos kyi lam gyi gzhung shing*/ chos rje rgod tshang pa dang*/ 'bri gung spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas las gsan pa'i phyag chen chos drug yin cing*/ gzhan yang rdzogs chen chos sna mang por glegs bam gcig tu 'thus par mdzad mod kyi/ dkar brgyud spyi dang cung mi 'dra'o// lam 'bras kyi gegs sel phal cher dkar brgyud kyi yi ge mang por blangs pa mi bden te/ bka' nges pa can gyi skabs su nad 'don zhi byed pa la ma ltos pas nad 'don gdams ngag zhi byed pa la mi re ba'i bka' rgya/ gegs sel lam 'bras pa la ma ltos pas gegs sel gyi gdams ngag lam 'bras pa la mi re ba'i bka' rgya/ zlog sgom gcod yul ba la ma ltos pas zlog sgom gyi gdams ngag gcod yul ba la mi re ba'i bka' rgya/ zhes sogs yod bzhin du/ snying yod su zhig de las 'da' bar nus snyam mo// ༈ yang shing gi rang 'thag tu/ de ltar na/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// ces pa'i don la/ sa skya pa phal mo che zhig mi la yan chad du chos drug gtsang ma de yod/ dwags po man chad chos drug bsre bslad can cig ma gtogs gtsang ma med ces 'chad la/ kho bo ni 'di ltar/ mi la yan chad la chos drug tshig brgyud dang don brgyud gnyis bsre slad med par yod/ dwags po rje'i zhabs tsam nas bzung ste/ chos drug gi tshig brgyud bsre slad med pa yod pa la don brgyud ma byung*/ don brgyud yod pa rnams la tshig brgyud bsre slad med pa de ma byung bar/ bsres bsres mang por song zhes pa'i don la/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// ces byung*/ de la tshig brgyud bsre slad med pa'i chos drug ni/ gtsang gzher/ rmog cog pa/ mes ston tshon po'i chos drug rnams yin/

de dag gi chos brgyud/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi tas kyang gsan mod nyams len ma mdzad pas/ rang 'bras thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong ma skyes pa la dgongs nas/ tshig brgyud gtsang mar yod kyang don brgyud med par bzhed/ phag gru gling sogs la chos drug sgom pa'i nyams rtogs mang du 'khrungs pa'i don brgyud yod na'ang*/ gdams ngag 'chad nyan bgyid tshe/ rgya gar phyag na las brgyud pa'i phyag chen dang*/ lam 'bras/ zhi byed la sogs pa'i gdams pa mkho btus su bshad/ res 'ga' rang rang gi rtogs pa las gsar 'khrungs su byung ba'i nyams su myong ba'i tshul du gsungs pas/ tshig brgyud bsre slad med pa de la ma byung*/ zhes bya'o// zhib par na/ dwags po rang la chos drug bsre slad med pa'i tshig don brgyud pa gnyis ldan byung ba gzhir bzhag mod/ slob mar 'chad tshe/ bka' gdams kyi gdam ngag 'ga' dang*/ ti phu pa'i man ngag dang*/ rang gi myong ba dang ji ltar mthun pa sogs 'chad sgom sna tshogs pa'i bkri tshul mdzad nas/ gsung nges med du byon pas/ mi la yan chad de las med// ces gsungs la/ rmog cog pa sogs la'ang bla ma rang thog tu chos drug bsre slad med pa'i don brgyud yod srid mod/ slob ma la rgyun chags su de ltar ma byung bas/ mi la yan chad de las med// ces dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba'i skabs kyang yin ces pa dang dpe dang bcas a zlos ko zlos su smras so// sa paṇ+ḍi tas phyogs sngar bzhed pa ni/ dwags po lugs kyi phyag chen du grags pa 'di yin la/ de 'gog pa'i phyir/ nā ro chos drug zhes bya'i khrid// ces sogs kyi gzhung tshogs 'di dag byung ba yin mod na'ang*/ chos drug gi 'phros byung ba tsam gyis chos drug bkag par gdon mi za'o snyam nas/ chos drug la bsre slad yod med dang*/ dag ma dag dang*/ 'brel ma 'brel sogs dgos med kyi tshig nyog mang pos dus dang blo gros gron du btang mod kyi/

sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa lon pa'i smra ba po dkon no// rgyu mtshan rje btsun gyis/ nā ro chos drug dag pa'i khrid// ces gsungs na der 'gyur kyang*/ zhes bya'i khrid ces gsungs nas bsre bslad yod med dang*/ dag ma dag gi 'phros ma mdzad 'dug pa la lab lob mang pos ci zhig bya/ gong du smos pa bzhin/ chos drug gi rtsa ba rdo rje 'chang gi gsung ngo ma bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma/ nā ro'i rdo rje'i mgur chos drug dril ba zhes bya ba/ rje mar pa'i ka dpe che chung sogs dang*/ deng sang gi chos drug la don gyi khyad par ci zhig 'dug gang gi thad du bsre slad ci 'dra bcug ltos la de nas smra bar gyis shig gal te tshig rgyas bsdus 'dug pas der 'gyur ro snyam na/ 'o na lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi thog tu/ sa chen yab sras nas brtsams te/ deng sang bar gyi khrid 'grel mkha' spyod sogs yi ge rgyas bsdus shin tu mang po 'dug pa 'di pa'ang bsre slad can gyi ma dag pa khyed rnams kyis zungs shig des na/ bshes gnyen kha cig sdom gsum la yig cha rtsom par ni 'dod/ gzhung don snying po ni ma mthong*/ 'bru har kongs su bzhag pas ni ngo tshar ci bya tshang rlag gi skabs su gzhan gzhung la rtog dpyod gang yang mi gtong bar/ ji skad du/ gang phyir lug dang rmongs pa'i 'phreng*// gcig song gcig rjes rgyug pa nyid// ces gsungs pa dang cha 'dra bar sngon mas bris pa de la cung zad 'dra min gyi gzu lum btags nas long ba'i 'khar stabs bzhin du tshod dpags kyi 'dor 'jog kho na lhur byed pa 'ba' zhig tu snang bas yid brtan du rung ba ma yin no// ci ste de dag sa paṇa gyi dgongs par 'gro mi 'gro sus shes/ zhe na/ sdom gsum gyi yig cha ji snyed bsags kyang don 'bras mi gcig pa de snyed cig ma gtogs skyel khungs gcig tu 'bab pa ni cher mi snang*/ de dag las su zhig dag la su zhig mi dag ces sa paṇa spyan sngar zan ril brtag pa mdzad dgos par yang 'gyur ro// de ltar sdom gsum rab dbye'i skor la 'chad rtsom gyi khur bzhes pa spyi la thun mong du gsol nas/

da ni mkhan chen rin po che byang smyon pa'i snyan du 'di ltar 'bul te/ rje sa paṇa gyi rtsod ngag 'phen yul gyi gtso bo ni dwags po lha rje yin pas/ mi la yan chad de las med// chos drug bor nas/ zhes gsungs la/ khyed kyis/ dwags po rang la chos drug bsre bslad med pa'i tshig don brgyud pa gnyis ldan du byung ba gzhir bcas mod ces dgongs pa 'grel ba'i zol gyis rtsa ba sun phyung ste/ gzhung du dwags pos chos drug bor ba bshad pa la/ khyed kyis/ chos drug tshig don gyi brgyud pa gnyis ldan du bshad pa'i phyir/ yang*/ dwags po rje'i zhabs tsam nas/ chos drug gi tshig dang don gyi brgyud pa so sor song rgyu'i khul mdzad 'dug pa la shes byed tshad ldan ga re/ rje sa paṇa gyi gsung des ni khyed kyi thugs 'dod mi bsgrub pa gda'o// gtsang bzher ba sogs gsum gyi chos drug de don brgyud dang 'brel ba'i chos drug min kyang bsre slad med pa'i tshig brgyud yin cing*/ de 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis kyang gsan pa ltar na/ bla ma gsum pos chos rje paṇa chen la btsun chung dpe rgyugs sprod pa ltar gsungs pa e yin/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa de dag kun// stong pa nyid la gzhol zhing 'bab// zhes gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ zab khrid tshad ldan cig nyams su bzhes pas zab khrid mtha' dag nyams su bzhes par 'gro bas theg chen gyi chos thams cad lam gcig pa/ 'jug pa gcig pa/ 'bras bu gcig pa zhes gsungs pa de 'ong zhing*/ de'i phyir/ chos rje'i thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i lam 'bras kyi nyams myong de ka las/ logs su gyur pa'i chos drug gi rang 'bras ci zhig dgos/ lhag par chos rjes nyams len ma mdzad zer ba dang*/ don brgyud med zer ba'i tshig 'di tsam yang snying la shin tu mi 'bab pas/

chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta la zhe rus mdzad nas phyin chad de rigs mi gsung ba zhu lags// ༈ srid gsum du/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa las brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po brda' rtsa dang*/ bsam gtan thun 'jog sogs yig skor shin tu mang po yod kyang*/ de'i bshad lung 'doms pa'i tshe/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung pa sogs brgyud pa 'ded kyi/ nā ro brgyud par mi 'dren pas na/ gzhan gyi gdams ngag sgom bzhin du// nā ro brgyud par 'ded byed pa sogs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gsung du snang yang klan ka de'i 'gro dmigs 'di na mi gda'/ zhes bkod pa la/ mkhan chen pas de ni phyogs snga ma rtogs pa'i dgag pa ste/ rab dbyer/ mai tri pa'i phyag chen la brgyud pa nā ro pa 'ded pa dgag pa ma yin gyi/ nā ro pa'i bsre 'pho'i cha shas su grags pa phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ba'i brgyud pa nā ro pa la 'ded pa 'gog pa yin/ de 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi lta ba stong 'ur 'ur la zhen nas dge med sdig med kyi spyod pa ham po cher byed pa ni/ rgya nag gi lugs yin la/ de la nā ro'i phyag chen du sgrub pa dang*/ brgyud pa nā ro par 'ded pa ni/ nā ro pa rang gi lugs dang 'gal ba yin te/ nā ro pa ni lta ba spros bral gyi ye shes tsam phyag chen du mi bzhed kyi/ rgyud sde las byung ba'i las/ chos dam tshig phyag rgya chen po rnams la phyag chen du bzhed pas so zhes ston pa la/ rab dbyer/ da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni// phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin// nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po zhes sogs drangs nas/ chos rgyus cher med pa'i gsung ci yang zhig byon to// nyid rang gi sku snga mas rtsod spong du/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa sogs brgyud pa gzhan nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen sogs dang*/ lam 'bras sogs dang bsres pa'i chos drug sgom bzhin du/

brgyud pa gzhan de dag gi mtshan ma smos par gcig kho na'i brgyud pa 'ded pa mi rigs te/ brgyud pa gnyis char gyi gdam ngag bsgom par song ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs dang*/ rang mchan du grags pa'i lung 'dren yang mdzad byas mod de las ci 'gyur zhe na/ shing rag tu/ mai tri pa'i phyag chen la brgyud pa nā ro pa 'ded pa dgag pa ma yin gyi zer ba 'di rtsod spong dang 'gal te/ gzhan de dag gi mtshan mi smos par gcig kho na'i brgyud pa 'ded zhes pa'i gcig ni nā ro ste/ gzhan gyi gdams ngag sgom bzhin du// nā ro brgyud par 'ded byed pa// zhes sogs dang 'brel ba gang zhig khyod kyis de ma yin par smras pa'i phyir/ de ni bgres shing 'chal gyi/ nged gzhon nur gyur pas de 'dra mi zer ro gsungs na/ 'dod na de la ngas ci bya/ zer bar snang bas bya thabs med do// ༈ yang*/ nā ro'i bsre 'pho'i cha shas lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi brgyud pa nā ro pa la 'ded pa 'gog pa yin zer ba ni ha cang thal ba'i tshig ste/ de ltar na lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa bir wa pa la 'ded pa dang*/ zhi byed kyi brgyud pa dam pa la 'ded pa dang*/ bka' gdams kyi brgyud pa jo bo la 'ded pa dang*/ shang chos kyi brgyud pa ni gu la 'ded pa sogs kyang mtshungs pas dgag dgos par 'gyur ro// ༈ yang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi lta ba stong skad 'ur 'ur la song nas dge med sdig med kyi spyod pa ham po cher byed pa ni rgya nag gi lugs la zer mod/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid ni til+lis nā ro la chu bo gaṅgā'i ngogs su gsung pa'i phyag chen gaṅgā mar grags pa'i lam rim dang mthun/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan por sgrub rjes so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad pas/ chos thams cad zung 'jug rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa zhig yin la mnyam bzhag tu de lta bu rtogs kyang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsal rgyu 'bras phra zhib kyi blang dor nyams len du mdzad pa ni dpal dwags po'i dkar brgyud bzang po 'di nyid kyi bgo skal du thob pa lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khyad chos yin te dkar brgyud rin po che'i rnam thar dang gsung rab la gzigs dang dgongs par 'gyur ro// stong skad 'ur 'ur dang*/

dge med sdig med kyi spyod pa ham po cher byed pa ni rdzogs chen pa'i khrod na mang ste/ 'tshang rgya ma myong*/ 'khor bar 'khyams ma myong*/ sdig pas gnod ma bskyal/ dge bas phan ma btags/ ra rog gi khong par lag pa bcug pa dang*/ phad nag nang du lag pa bcug pa la khyad par med zer mkhan gda' yi/ stong skad spyod pa ham can la mi dgyes na/ re zhig de pa'i khrod du ma theg par lam 'bras kyis tshims gang thub mdzod dang khyed la legs par 'gyur ro// ༈ yang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi lta ba zung 'jug gi lam du khyer thub pa zhig byung yang mdo lugs dbu ma'i lta ba yin gyi/ sngags lugs phyag rgya chen po ma yin pas zhes sogs ni dbang po ches ral gri gnas skyur gyi tshig lta bu ste/ gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus kyang ka ba ma yin gyi bum pa yin/ smra shes shing don go yang spyang po ma yin lkugs pa yin zer bsnyon brdung ba dang 'dra'o// ༈ yang*/ nā ro pa ni lta ba spros bral gyi ye shes tsam phyag chen du mi bzhed kyi zhes pa ni 'brel med kyi tshig chen po ste/ spros bral gyi ye shes tsam phyag chen yin zer mkhan khungs ma yin snang ba'i phyir/ ༈ yang*/ rgyud sde las byung ba'i/ las chos/ dam tshig phyag rgya chen po rnams la phyag chen du bzhed pas so// zer ba ni gong ma de las kyang lod de/ las dang chos phyag chen ma yin par khyed rang yang nges par 'dod dgos pa'i phyir// ༈ yang shing gi rang 'thag las/ spyir deng sang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi khyab na yang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gzhung lugs rgya gar nas byon pa dang*/ bod kyi lo paṇa chen po rnams kyi gsung rab la mi blta bar phyis byung ba rang rang thad so'i bla ma'i dpe hrul mang po'i tshig sna btus nas/ rang 'dod 'chor ngoms su bgyis pa'i yig cha re la yid brton par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bshad nyan rnal ma rnams nyams dma' ba'i rtags su mthong la/

zhes deng sang gi bstan 'dzin yongs la smra bar byed do// mkhan chen rin po che khyed ni/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam mtha' dag la sdang ba zhig snang ste/ bka' mdo rgyud/ bstan bcos rgya gar nas 'gyur ba rnams khungs su drangs pa la ni dpe hrul mang po'i thun tshags bsdus zhes bka' bkyon/ phyis byon gyi mkhas pas bka' bstan gyi dgongs 'grel mdzad pa tsho la ni/ dpe cha gsar pa rnams la cag khas ma thon pa zhig yin nam brtsams 'phral la dpe hrul du song nas stod smad kyi 'dug pa'i phyir/ dgongs 'grel rnams la thugs gzu bos 'thad mi 'thad dpyad brdar mdzad pa zhig na mkhas pa'i las yin pas legs kyi/ gzhan ni bla ma'i bla ma bla med dkon mchog gsum// yi ge gnyis 'brel dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan// zhes sogs skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang yang 'gal ba 'dra zhing*/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces sogs gzhung gi chos spong gi las rnams mtshams med lnga las kyang lci bar bshad pas 'a rdzig bag tu snang ngo*// ༈ gzhan yang*/ khyed kyi yig cha 'di'i kha 'phangs la/ kho bos che ge zhes bya ba byas yod pas de la ltos shig ga ge mo la ltos shig nyog ge mo la ltos shig ces pa la dpags na yi ge mang po mdzad yod tshod du 'dug pa/ de dag kyang shing rag 'di dang mtshungs pa'i rang 'dod 'chor ngom cig yod kyi dogs pa dang*/ de rnams phyis byung gi bla mas sbyar bar 'dug pas de dag la'ang mi lta zhing yid rton par mi byed de/ gal te de dag mi lta mi nyan cing yid brtan mi rung na ni brtsams pa la'ang dgos pa ci zhig yod ces thugs bsam thun cig mdzad du gsol// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ khyad par dkar brgyud du grags pa 'di la/ chen por rlom pa ji snyed cig byon yang chos kyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā ba'i chos lugs yin nges pa khyad par can rnams la rtsol ba dor te/ sgom chen phyogs re ba'i glu dang mgur ma la skyabs su bcol nas sdug sgom byed pa ni/

bu ru brdzus nas pha yi rabs gcod pa dngos gnas te/ mtshon tsam smos na/ rje btsun mar pa'i chos lugs yin nges pa ma hā mā ya dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud bshad/ dbang khrid shog dril khyad par can sogs/ rtsod pa med cing*/ rgyal ba'i lam phyin ci ma log pa/ chos shin tu mchog tu gyur pa de dag phyis kyi dkar brgyud pa rnams kyis/ bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin rgyang du bsrings nas/ mar pa siṅgā lar byon pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa zhus/ zhes pa'i tshig gcig la/ man ngag snyan rgyud zhus dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma zhus sogs rang 'dod kyi chos dang bstun pa'i lo rgyus gsar rtsom byed pa dang*/ chos kyang mar pa dang*/ nā ro pa'i gsung ngag yin min the tshom za ba'i man ngag sna tshogs la don gnyer byed pa ni/ mar pa lo tsā ba'i bstan pa la zhabs 'degs su mdzes pa ma yin/ 'dir gtam du gleng ba gzhan yang yod mod chags sdang gi kun spyod rtsub mor song dogs pas/ re zhig btang snyoms su bgyis so// zhes rtsod ngag gi lan snying po med pa zhig las ma thebs pa la cung zad gnong dgos rgyu la/ tshig pa yab la zos nas brdung brtags bu la gtong ba'i dpe bzhin/ bstan 'dzin spyi dang*/ sgos dkar brgyud pa la dpe med dmad zin nas/ da dung rme gtsang rgyu lugs gang yang byed rgyu yod na'ang*/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i kha bzang mdzad pa sogs dgos med mang po'i gsung byung ba la dgos pa dang ldan pa'i lan cung zad brjod par bya'o// de yang*/ rje lo tsā ba chen po chos kyi blo gros de nyid kyis/ rgyud 'grel brgya rtsa/ rdzogs rim brgya rtsa/ khyad chos brgya rtsa/ bstan srung brgya rtsa sogs brgya phrag du ma mkhyen par 'dug kyang*/ phal mo che bod kyi skal bar ma shong bas ma dar/ chos zab rgyas can mang po chig brgyud kyi bka' rgyas bcings nas sras mdo sde la gnang 'dug kyang*/

de sku tshe mthar ma phyin pas chos bka' mang po nub pa 'dra/ dbang rgyud man ngag gi rgyun ding sang gi bar du ma nyams par bzhugs pa yang rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba rnams 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ bshad brgyud dang sgrub brgyud gnyis su byung ba'i/ dang po la bka' babs gsum dang*/ phyi ma la gcig ste/ bka' babs kyi slob ma mchog bzhi byung ba'i rngog chos sku rdo rje la dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud gur/ gdan bzhi rtsa bshad/ ma hā mā ya/ de dag gi 'grel bshad/ man ngag bsre 'pho gtso bor gyur pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i bka' babs/ mes ston tshon po la bde dgyes gsang gsum/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mā ya/ de dag gi man ngag 'grel bshad dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la gsang 'dus lugs gsum/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ de gsum la bshad rgyun mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu zhes grags/ de re re la'ang*/ slob ma/ yang slob/ nying slob sogs brgyud 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ de rnams kyis brtsams pa'i yig cha'ang brjod kyis mi lang*/ de las rngog chos kyi dbang khrid rgyud bshad rnams/ chos rje rgya ras kyis rngog rdo rje seng ge dang*/ rngog thogs med pa las gsan pa'i rgyun dang*/ phyis rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor bas/ rngog bdun brgyud kyi phyi ma rngog byang chub dpal la rdzogs par gsan pas rgyun nyams med du thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs nges shes pa pad+ma dkar po'i zhal nas dang*/ de'i rgyun bshad kyi bka' babs paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros sogs las/ 'khos med kyi sgom chen bdag 'dra bas kyang*/ thos shing sbyangs na/ dkar brgyud kyi chen po rnams kyis gsan zhing mkhyen pa smos ci dgos/ mes ston tshon po'i chos skor rnams kyang mkhar yang ston las rim gyis brgyud pa dang*/ mtshur ston gyi chos skor rnams 'khon gad pa kirti sogs las rim gyis brgyud pa/

mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lo tsā ba nas brgyud de/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po dang rdo rje 'chang lha rtse ba chen po'i zhal las kho bos kyang thos na gzhan gyis lta ci/ shog dril bzhi pa dang*/ dgu pa dang*/ bco lnga pa sogs kyang legs par thos shing 'dris par byas zin gyi de la klan ka ci yod/ des na khyed kyis/ mar pa'i chos lugs yin nges la rtsol ba dor te/ zhes pa dang*/ bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin rgyang du bsrings nas zhes pa de cha med kyis rgyus gtam dang*/ kun slong gi gzhan dbang du e song gzigs dang*/ sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pas/ rje mar pa'i spyan sngar/ bde dgyes/ gdan thod/ gsang 'dus/ mā ya sogs kyi dbang rgyud sgrub thabs sna tshogs gsan/ khyad par bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud/ grub pa dang snying po'i skor sogs thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu byon na'ang*/ khong gi mgur du/ rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bar// bu sgrub pa snying por longs shig gsungs// mi ngas kyang le lo ma byas par// pha bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams su blangs// zhes sogs mar pa'i bka' chems bzhin/ spong ba bsam gtan gyi ngang nas dka' spyad snying rus kyi go cha bzhes te sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs pa'i gtam 'di ni kun la thun mong nyid du gsal lo// rgyu mtshan des bshad bshad zhung zhung cher mdzad pa ma shar yang*/ brtag gnyis dang bde mchog nyung ngu'i bshad rgyun snying por dril ba re slob ma rnams la mdzad pa ni/ rgyud de gnyis la grub thob gling gi ṭīk+ka yod pas shes so// der ma zad/ mar pa mgo legs sogs slob tshogs rgya mtsho lta bus zab chos de rnams nyan bshad bsgoms pas/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// nying slob nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// zhes lung bstan pa de kho na ltar gyur to// rje mi la'i slob rgyun dwags po'i dkar brgyud grags pa 'di rnams/

snyan rgyud kyi chu bo bzhi 'dus pa'i chos kyi rgya mtsho nā ro paṇa chen gyi chos drug dang*/ mdo rgyud kun gyi yang snying phyag rgya chen po las brtsams te/ zab chos thams cad thugs rgyud rnal ma'i steng du phab nas nyams su blangs pa la/ khyed kyis/ sdug sgom byed pa ni zhes kha 'dzer to// 'di pas dka' thub sdug khur gyi nyams len byas pas grub thob kyis bod khams gang bar mdzad pa gda' yis/ gzhan tshan cig gis skyid nyal mdzad pas chos dang gang zag ltag gyes su song ste srid pa'i ra ba dog por btang bar gda'o// ༈ yang khyed kyis shing rag tu/ mar pa siṅgā lar byon pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ zhes byas gda' ba/ gtam ma dag pa de 'dra su las gsan/ rje mar pa'i bla ma dpal siṅgā gling pa zhes bya ba cig yod kyang*/ rje mar pa siṅgā lar byon pa des mi grub ste/ dper na/ sa paṇa kha cher ma byon kyang kha che paṇa chen dang mjal/ rgya gar shar nub tu ma byon kyang*/ shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la dang*/ nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shī dang mjal/ bal por ma byon kyang bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta saṅgha shrī dang mjal ba bzhin no// don du rje mar pa spyir rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ sgos nub tu la k+ṣi ṭa/ lho dug mtsho'i gling*/ puṣ+pa ha ri/ ri bo me ltar 'bar ba sogs su bla ma so sor mjal bar byon yang byon la/ de kha'i lo rgyus kyang khungs ma yod mod/ gang zhig yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba// 'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa 'di gang zhig /ces gsungs pa bzhin mar pa siṅgā lar byon pa'i gtam rgyud gsan pa'ang de dang mtshungs pa yin no// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ sgom chen phyogs re ba'i glu dang mgur ma la skyabs su bcol nas/ zhes smra mod/ grub thob kyi spyi mes sa ra has/ rgyal po/ btsun mo/ dmangs dang bcas pa la do ha skor gsum glur blangs pa sogs/ rgya gar gyi grub chen gyi mgur dang*/

rje mar pa'i mgur chen brgyad dang*/ mi la sogs dkar brgyud kyi nyams mgur rnams ni gdams ngag glur blangs pa don shin tu bzang ba yin pas brnyas par ga la rigs/ de ltar bas na/ gtan tshigs yang dag gis lan brgyar grub pa'i brgyud pa bzang po 'di la su zhig gus pa de ni mkhas pa yin no zhes shes par byos shig/ ༈ srid gsum du/ rje mi la yan chad du/ chos drug ma gtogs chos gzhan med gsungs pa 'dra na/ zhes dang*/ nā ros gsungs tshad chos drug yin gsung rgyu yin tshe zhes bris pa la/ phyogs snga ci yang med pa'i dgag pa ste/ khyed kyis phyogs sngar bkod pa'i lugs de gnyis po gang yang khas len pa'i sa lugs kyi mkhas pa su yang mi snang ba'i phyir/ zhes khyed kyis smras pa de ni rloms tshod kho na ste/ de gnyis khas len byed pa'i sa lugs kyi mkhas pa sngar byon pa gnyis dang*/ da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa gcig nges par snang mod kyi/ thams cad dgrar slong ba ni cha ma yin pas da lam res mi smra la/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min// de phyir long bas mthong ba med// ces pa bzhin/ khyed kyis ma gzigs pa tsam gyis med pa sgrub pa ni ha cang spyi brtol ches pa'i skyon/ gan mdzod du/ dbang las byung ba dang*/ rdzogs rim las byung ba gnyis ka dpe'i ye shes su 'dod par snang ste/ zhes bris pa la/ rje klu sgrub kyis/ dbang las byung ba'i ye shes yin na dpe'i ye shes yin min gyi khyab pa khas len pa'i don ma yin/ zhes dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la dpe'i ye shes yin pas khyab pa bstan pa ma yin/ zhes lan rnal ma btab pa la/ srid gsum du/ dbang dus kyi ye shes la dpe'i ye shes yin min gyi khyab mtha' rab dbye'i gzhung la med kyang*/ zol gyi smra ba'i sgrib g.yogs so// zhes bris mod/ shes rab shin tu gu dog pa'i rnam 'gyur te/ mdo lugs kyi gzhung sde bdun/ byams chos lnga/

rigs bstod gtam gsum la sogs pa'i gzhung rnams na/ khyab mtha'i tshig zin cig kyang mi snang mod/ de'i don mtha' dpyod du gtan la 'bebs pa na/ yin min gyi khyab mtha' la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'chad pa bod kyi mkhas pa spyi'i lugs yin la/ gzhung lugs gzhan la'ang des mtshon pa ni/ dper na/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces pa'i don ni mtha' dpyod 'debs pa na/ sems can dang*/ sangs rgyas gnyis kyi ngo bo chos nyid dbyer med/ ces pa'i don yin gyi/ sems can yin na sangs rgyas yin pas khyab ces/ khyab mtha' ston pa ma yin zhes 'chad dgos pa bzhin no// zhes smras so// mi mthad de/ srid mtha' 'gog pa'i gsung rigs/ de yod na de yin dgos zhes dang*/ ga la srid zhes dang*/ srid pa ma yin zhes dang*/ nges par zhes dang*/ gdon mi za zhes pa lta bu sogs so so'i skabs thob kyi tshig phrad dang sbyar ba de kha khyab mtha' yin la/ de 'dra ba ni 'phags yul nas 'gyur ba'i glegs bam chen po rnams na mang po snang gi bod kyi mtshan nyid pa la grags pa'i brda chad khyab ces pa dang*/ bud ces pa lta bu'i tshig med kyang*/ don gcig pas go chod na ni de ka'o// bod kyi mkhas pa spyi'i lugs la khyed kyis mi rtsi bar khas blangs zin nas/ yang de la skyabs 'tshol lam ci/ 'di thad kyi phyogs snga phyi'i don la dpyad pa'i 'bel gtam/ srid gsum du rgyas par bkod pa des gtan la phebs pa yod mod kyi/ slar khyed kyi gsungs pa 'dis rtsod spong gi gegs ma sel la bogs kyang ma thon 'dug pas lan smra mi dgos/ khyad par du/ mi ngad can de 'dra'i 'khrungs yul yin phyir lung pa lhag ngar che ba'i khar/ dgun zla ba'i grang reg gis gtsub pas/ snag tshas gong bu gcig pa'i brtul zhugs blangs par brten rgyas par 'bri ma thub/ 'on kyang*/ khyed kyi gsung las/ gan mdzod dang*/ srid gsum gnyis ka na/ sa skya pas dbang dus kyi ye shes dang*/

rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la dpe'i ye shes yin pa'i khyab pa khas blangs/ zhes yang yang bris pa 'di shes bzhin du/ mi dkar la zhwa nag bskon pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i rtags mtshan du snang ngo*// de tsam gyis mkhas pa'i mgo bo 'khor bar mi nus te/ sogs bris pa ni mtshan dang mthun par thugs la mtho dman cung zad la nges pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mi dkar la zhwa nag tshur la bskon pa ste/ gan mdzod du ni/ de'i dbang las byung ba dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa las byung ba gnyis ka dpe'i ye shes su 'dod par snang ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ srid gsum du'ang*/ dbang dus kyi ye shes la dpe'i ye shes yin min gyi khyab mtha' rab dbye'i gzhung la med kyang zol gyi smra ba'i sgrib g.yogs so zhes smras kyis khyab mtha' yod par ma smras la/ khyab khyab kyi 'phros mdzad mkhan rtsod spong mkhan po yin pas mkhas pa'i dbu 'khor mi 'khor ji ltar yang ba'i sha ma glang la mi dkri bar dag gsol// ༈ srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam gyi ming btags pa la dgos pa med bzhin du btags nas ci bya zhes smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ rang nyid gzigs rgya chung ba'i mtshon byed de/ theg chen sbyor lam pa la chos nyid snang mched thob gsum gyi rtogs pa nam skyes pa na chos nyid mthong ba'i ming 'dogs dang*/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis sogs drangs nas/ 'dis ni rang gzhan mang po dag /sa bcu'i ming btags pa thams cad 'phags pa'i sa bcu kho nar 'dod pa'i blo gros phyogs re rnams bden med du btang ngo*// zhes sogs gang yang zhig gsungs snang ngo*/ nged mthong rgya chung pas mthong bar 'os pa tsam las ma mthong la/ khyed gzigs rgya ha cang ches pas gang min bco brgyad gzigs par 'dug ste/ de la ngo mtshar rgyu ci yod/ theg chen sbyor lam pas mthong ba'i snang mched thob pa'i stong pa gsum po de la chos can zer gyi chos nyid mi zer la/

chos nyid ni thams cad stong pa 'od gsal gyi ming*/ yang*/ rgyu la 'bras ming btags pa'ang shes bya la srid pas/ de'i tshe ni thad so'i dgos pa re yang 'byung ste khyed rang gi mtshan sprul skur bod pa bzhin no// zhes smras pa kho nas khron chung sbal chung dang nya chung dang*/ mi chung thams cad rang rang gi rnam thar las nyams pa yin tshod du gda' zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi blo gros bden med du gtong ba la khyed mkhas par gda' na'ang kho bos ni/ sa dang lam dang*/ bden don dang*/ de nyid sogs la/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i lam gyi gnyis// zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad tshul gnyis su byas te/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur gyi so so skye bo nyid yin yang*// gal te chos mthun tsam rtsi yi// 'on te 'phags pa nyid yin pa'i// bden pa'i sa la dngos su byed// ces gsungs pa'i lan du phul grub pas khyed kyi ngo so khur dgos med lags// ༈ rab dbyer/ 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus su// zhes sogs dang*/ rtsod spong du de'i lung 'dren mdzad pa sogs kyi dpe'i ye shes la bden mthong gi ming btags pa la/ srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes tsam rtogs pa de ni/ gnyis chos las ma grol bas/ yang dag pa'i don mthong ba'i tha snyad ci la thob/ de bzhin du rtag chad dang*/ 'pho ba la sogs pa'i lta ngan 'gags par ci ste gsungs/ thugs gtad kyi drag shos las mtha' la chags par bshad pa der snang yang mi 'gal te/ don dam chos nyid de mthong 'phral bag chags de 'dag par ma bshad pas/ bag chags de sbyong ba'i phyir/ sgom lam du mngon byang las ldang 'jug yang yang byed dgos zhes bkod pa la/ sku skye snga phyi gnyis ka sgril rgyag mdzad de lan btab pa ni/ spyod bsdus las/ gal te sgrub pa po bden pa mthong yang*/ zhes sogs drangs nas/ dri ba'i don gyi gtso bo yang*/ sems dben mthar thug dpe'i 'od gsal thob pa dang*/ sgyu lus thob pa la bden pa mthong ba ces pa'i ming btags nas/

zhes rang gi thugs 'dod yongs rdzogs zhal du 'tshangs te/ gzhung thad kar mi 'jog par rang gi 'dod thog tu 'bad pa chen pos gcus shing skyog pa ni ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams khrel ba'i rgyu'o// ji ltar gcus zhe na/ spyod bsdus sgron mar/ rdo rje slob mas gsol pa/ gal te sgrub pa po bden pa mthong yang*/ zhes pa tsam ma gtogs/ sgrub pa po des sems dben mthar thug thob zer ba dang*/ dpe'i 'od gsal thob zer ba dang*/ sgyu lus thob zer ba dang*/ de rnams thob pa la bden mthong gi ming btags zer ba rnams gzhung 'di'i dngos shugs gang la'ang med bzhin du rtog rtags 'dzem med du smra ba 'di 'dras ci zhig gtub// sems dben la sogs pa de rnams brtag par mi bzod pa med bzhin du snang ba'i chos rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu yin mod/ de'i phyir rdzun pa mthong ba la bden pa mthong zhes ma smyo ba'i skyes bu su zhig smra ste/ ji skad du/ mgo bo bcad nas mjug ma'i rgyan// smyon pa min pa su zhig byed// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gong gi 'phros las/ sngon gyi bag chags la goms pa'i stobs kyis/ zhing las dang*/ tshong dang*/ bsnyen bkur la sogs pas g.yengs nas/ spyod pa rnam pa gsum spyod pa mi byed ces sogs/ dris pa'i lan du/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ 'di la bsal ba gang yang med// bzhag par bya ba ci yang med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa'i tshig ste/ 'di ltar ste yang dag pa mthong ba'o// zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa mthong bas/ rtag pa dang*/ chad pa dang*/ 'pho ba la sogs pa'i lta ba ngan pa 'gag par 'gyur ro// 'on kyang tha snyad la brten nas/ 'pho ba rnam par dag pa nges spyad par bya/ 'di ni phung po la sogs pa ni 'jig rten pha rol tu 'pho bar mi byed/ rtag pa'i skyon du thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

'jig rten pha rol 'chi ba las gzhan pa nyid las kyang 'byung ba ma yin no// rgyu med pa'i nges pa'i thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ mar me las mar me dang*/ rgya las rgya dang*/ sgra las brag cha dag ni/ de nyid de las gzhan pa zhes brjod par mi nus so// de bas na gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro// sems can rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir// mya ngan 'das par bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang*/ 'di las gang yang rkyen rnams kyis// skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// btags pa'i rkyen rnams kho na ni// skye zhing 'gag par 'gyur ba yin// zhes gsungs so// rigs pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas mdzad pa thams cad mdzad nas mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar ston par mdzad pa yin no// de bzhin du/ rdzogs rim pa rtogs par gyur pas kyang thams cad byas nas 'jig rten du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba 'di la som nyi mi bya'o// de bas na/ de kho na nyid shes pa ni rkyen ma tshang bas/ ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa la spyad du zin kyang*/ lta ba thams cad rnam par spangs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin/ skye ba ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o// zhes yang dag par mngon par rtogs nas rgya lam na/ 'od gsal bar zhugs nas tha mal pa'i phung po bor nas/ bdag la byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim gyis ldang bar bya'o// zhes brten pa'i sems bskyed de/ de yid la byed pas gnas par byed na/ de skye ba gzhan du yid la byed pa de 'dor bar mi 'gyur te/ de bas na thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i lung 'di snag tsha kha dbugs kyi sros kyin bris so// lung de'i don snying por dril ba zhig bshad par bya ste/ dri ba'i skabs su/ gal te sgrub pa po bden pa mthong yang*/ zhes pa'i dri lan du/

'di la bsal bya gang yang med// ces sogs gsungs te/ 'di la nye tshig sbyar/ de yang gsung rab spyi lugs la rang rang gi mthong lam thob pa la bden pa mthong ba zhes bya yi gzhan ma yin la/ lung don la dpyad na/ bsal bzhag med pa dang*/ yang dag nyid la yang dag lta ba dang*/ de bzhin du mthong na grol ba sogs bden mthong mtshan nyid pa'i nyams len kho na bshad pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa'i tshig ste/ zhes pas kyang*/ de bzhin du bstan/ rgya gzhung gi dpe hrul kha cig las/ rdzogs pa ni zung du 'jug pa'i lha ye shes kyi sku'i ming can/ rim pa ni de nyid dngos su sgrub par byed pa'i thabs te/ zhes rdzogs rim gyi mtshan don bshad la/ zung 'jug de dngos su sgrub pa'i lam de ma thag pa ni 'od gsal yin pas na/ skabs 'di'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang 'od gsal la 'dod dgos sam/ mngon byang de mthong ba'i yon tan gang rung ba bzhed nas/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag par mthong ba'o// zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa mthong bas/ rtag pa dang*/ chad pa dang*/ 'pho ba la sogs pa'i lta ba ngan pa 'gag par 'gyur ro// zhes pas/ dbu ma'i gzhung rnams su lta ba kun zlog zhes bshad pa bzhin 'dir yang*/ de bzhin ma yin par/ khyed kyis sgyu lus thob pa la bden pa mthong ba ces pa'i ming btags nas/ zhes sogs yang yang smras pa la snying po med de/ gzhung zhal gsal can 'di lta bu dang mi bstun par/ btsun gsar la ming 'dogs pa bzhin sgyu lus sogs thob pa tsam la'ang bden mthong gi ming gsar pa btags pa des go ci la chod soms dang*/ smra ba de kun rang 'dod sgrub pa'i g.yo thabs 'ba' zhig go /ces te/ rje sa paṇa gyi bzhed pa 'di tshig zin ltar 'grel bar 'dod na/ dpe'i ye shes nyid la dgongs/ zhes gsungs pa'i sngar gyi sgrub byed ltar snang mngon mtshan can de 'dra ma yin pa'i legs bshad 'god rgyu yod na lta khyed mkhas pa yin te/

smra kham che ba tsam dpung du khyer ba'i 'o dod lan brgyar bos kyang wa skyes thang stong du brgyal ba dang 'dra'o// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud 'grel 'di par/ dbang rnon brtson 'grus can tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya ba/ dbang 'bring le lo can bar ma dor 'tshang rgya ba/ dbang brtul shin tu le lo can skye ba brgyud nas 'tshang rgya ba gsum bshad pa las/ spyod bsdus su dogs gcod bkod pa/ 'di na bar pa de nyid yin la/ sgrub pa po gang dag bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon par byang chub pa'i ming can de rnal 'byor gyis mngon sum du byas kyang*/ sngon gyi bag chags kyi nad ro ma dag pas/ zhing las/ nyo tshong bsnyen bkur sogs bdag gir byed pa rnam par g.yengs pas/ spyod pa gsum gang rung la ma spyad pa dang*/ 'byor pa ma 'dzom pas tshogs rdzogs par byed ma nus pa'i gang zag de tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya bar ma nus kyi/ de 'chi ba'i dus na srid par skye ba gzhan len nam/ rdo rje 'chang thob par 'gyur zhes pa ni dri ba'o// lan ni/ 'di la bsal ba gang yang med// ces sogs tshigs bcad kyi bstan don/ rdzogs rim 'od gsal don dam bden pa'i dbang du yin pas de ni phyin ci log gi cig shos yang dag pa ste bden pa mthong ba yin la/ de'i mthus/ rtag chad dang*/ 'pho ba sogs lta ba ngan pa 'gag par 'gyur mod/ 'on kyang rnam smin las gyur pa'i lus 'di nyid/ tha snyad tsam la brten nas 'chi 'pho ba de'i tshe/ zhes sogs mtha' dpyod dang bcas bkod nas/ ngag don bsdu ba la/ rigs pa 'dis ni bcom ldan shākya thub pas mdzad pa thams cad mdzad nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar ston pa mdzad pa yin no// de bzhin du rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs par gyur pas kyang thams cad byas nas/ 'jig rten du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba 'di la som nyi mi bya'o// zhes srid pa bar dor zung 'jug gi sku mngon du byed ces pa'i tha tshig go

/'o na som nyi mi bya'o/ zhes tshig zur ci'i phyir smos zhe na/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i rtogs pa ma thob kyi bar du snang ba gsum rnam par ma dag pa rnam shes kyi kun tu rtog pa yod cing*/ des nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi rgyun gyis yang srid len pas 'khor bar phyir zlog par 'gyur ram 'on te min som nyi dang bcas la/ 'od gsal don dam bden pa mngon du byas pas snang gsum rnam par dag nas snang med 'od gsal de las langs te zung 'jug tu gnas pa'i rim gyis bya ba mngon sum du byas te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan nas gnas par 'gyur ba ni zhes pa'i don du 'chad/ slar yang de dag gi sgrub byed 'god par bzhed nas/ de bas na de kho na nyid shes pa ni rkyen ma tshang bas/ ji skad du bshad pa'i spyod pa ma spyad du zin kyang*/ lta ba thams cad rnam par spangs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ skye ba ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o// zhes yang dag par mngon par rtogs nas/ zhes sogs lung 'dren dang bcas gsungs te/ gang zhig skye ba kun rdzob bden pa ste// 'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa yin// rim gnyis de dag bla ma'i drin gyis ni// brnyed pa 'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin// bden gnyis de la zung du 'jug pa ni// mi phyed bzhin du de dag khyad par med// ming gnyis tha ma gcig pu kho nar ni// shes pa de 'dir bcings las grol ba yin// ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhing lhung gyur na// ltung bar mi 'dod kyang ni ltung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'dod kyang ni grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan de dag la gzu bo'i thugs ldan kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod cig dang*/ dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bye bar 'gyur ro// ༈ srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes tsam rtogs pa ni/

gnyis chos las ma grol bas yang dag pa'i don mthong ba'i tha snyad ci la thob/ ces bris pa la shing rag tu/ rang gi sems yang dag pa zhes sogs zlos shing zhe skyor gyi lung drangs shing*/ snang gsum ngos 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi lung*/ rang bzhin gyis gsal ba'i rnam pa dngos po ma lus pa thams cad la dmigs pas na snang ba ste/ 'di ni don dam byang chub kyi sems shes pa'i snang ba stong pa dang po ste/ zhes dpe'i 'od gsal snang ba thob pa la don dam byang chub sems mthong ba'i ming btags pa dang*/ snang ba mched pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po gnyis pa ste/ rim pa gnyis pa shin tu stong pa'i mtshan can/ zhes dpe'i 'od gsal mched pa la kun tu bzang po'i ming 'dogs mdzad la zhes bris so// de ni bal por 'bras sā lu smin pa'i sgrub byed du/ kong por nas rgan skyes zhes smras pa dang mtshungs par/ sgyu lus thob pa la yang dag pa'i don mthong ba'i ming 'dogs pa ma yin te/ snang ba nyer thob la don dam byang chub kyi sems shes pa'i snang ba zhes dang*/ snang ba mched pa la kun tu bzang po'i ming btags pa'i phyir ro// zhes par song*/ gzhung las sems shes pa'i snang ba zhes pa byung ba la/ skyon btags sa don dam byang chub kyi sems mthong ba'i shes pa zhes lhan chung kha gang btab mod/ 'jig rten grags tshod la'ang*/ shes rab can kha cig gis bzo'i gnas kyi byed pa ma mthong kyang rang gi shes pa mngon sum la snang la/ de bzhin du/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i zag pa med pa'i chos kyi sde tshan rnams lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas rang gi legs par shes shing gzhan la 'chad shes na'ang ma mthong ba lta bu/ gzhan yang mdo phal po cher/ dper na dmus long ri mo mkhan// tshong 'dus dbus su legs phyin nas// skye bo mang po dga' byas kyang*// rang gi skad cig mthong ba med// ma bsgoms chos kyang de 'dra'o// zhes pas kyang mtshon nus te/

don du skabs 'dir shes pa dang mthong ba mi gcig go/ ༈ yang shing rag las/ skabs 'dir ltar snang dang*/ rdzun pa/ mi bden pa/ kun rdzob/ 'dus byas rnams/ rnam grangs phyogs gcig pa dang*/ yang dag pa dang*/ bden pa/ don dam/ chos nyid/ kun tu bzang po/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ dpal mchog dang po rnams/ rnam grangs phyogs gcig tu 'jog pa ni/ nges don gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa kun gyi spyi lugs yin cing*/ zhes sogs bris so// ltar snang dang*/ yang dag rdzun pa/ bden pa sogs sde tshan so sor 'jog pa ni lung rigs don ltar smra ba spyi la grags pa la/ skabs 'dir zhes nges gzung smos nas ci mdzad/ nges don 'khrul med 'chad pa rnams/ gnyis kyi rnam grangs de tsho tha dad du mi 'chad de/ mda' bsnun dbang pos/ mi bya gnyis su mi bya gcig tu bya ba ste// rigs dang bye brag dag tu ma byed cig /ces gsungs pa la nyan dgos pa'i phyir ro// yang*/ rnam grangs phyogs gnyis po de tha dad yin na/ khyed la gnod par 'gyur te/ sgyu lus man gyi 'jig rten pa'i lam rnams phyogs gong mas bsdus shing*/ 'od gsal yan gyi 'das lam phyogs rjes mas bsdus par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ kho bo cag rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas dngos su gyur pa/ zhes sogs/ bstod yul de bzang po yin srid kyang*/ 'dir ni a pha lags kyi zhal shul kyi dpe ltar yin la/ 'bum phrag gsum po de skyon gyi grangs yin nam/ yon tan gyi grangs ci yin kyang mang po ni yin par gda' lags/ rim lnga'i lung*/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i man ngag dag /gang gi bla ma las ma bsgrubs// rtag dang chad pa la dmigs pas// mi de phyir zlog 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa'i lung don ni/ sems dben mthar phyin pa de la/ bla mas sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag bstan de sgom pa ni sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku mthong bar 'gyur la/ de nyid sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon te/

bslab pa mthar phyin pa na rtag chad la sogs pa'i gnyis chos snang tsam du mi 'gal kyang*/ dmigs par zhen pa'i bden par lta ba'i mod la sgyu lus kyi gdams pa nyams su ma myong na dmigs zhen can yin pas phyir zlog srid do zhes pa'i don yin lags/ 'di thad du/ khyi snying phru ba la chags pa bzhin/ khyed kyis yang skyor/ zhes skyor skyor mdzad kyang*/ rang bzhin la ni phyin log gis// 'bad du zin kyang mi zlog ste// blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro// zhes pa'i skabs su sleb gda'/ blo gros rtsing hral du 'gro lugs kyis/ shing gi rang 'thag har har de la btags pas lan tam snyam/ srid gsum du thugs gtad kyi drag shod las mtha' la chags par bshad pa der snang yang zhes sogs bris kyang*/ kho bo ni/ las mtha' la chags pa/ zhes pa'i tshig tsam la thugs gtad ci zhig byed/ 'chi ba don gyi 'od gsal gyi lam rim la thugs gtad byed pa yin ces bris so// da lta blo gros cung ma smin pa 'dra yang*/ thugs sbyong mdzad na phugs su mkhas pa chen po zhig 'ong du re bas/ re zhig 'chi ba don gyi 'od gsal la thugs mi gtad zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags so// des na khyed kyis nad grol dang gdon grol du song zhes sbad gog smras pa'i kha mtshul ni de kar 'dus gda'o// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ spyod bsdus kyi dgongs don mthar thug pa/ sngon gyi 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi srol 'dzin chen po 'gas kyang ji bzhin du rtogs pa nyung zhing*/ khyad par/ sa lugs kyi mkhas pa chen po go shā ka la sogs pa shin tu grags pa dang ldan pa de dag gis kyang*/ don 'di dag phul du phyin pa ma dgongs pas sngon chad byon zin pa'i sdom gsum gyi yig cha phal cher zhig la/ nges pa om tig pa mi snang*/ rje klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ rgan po'i zer zlos yang skyor tsam ma gtogs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa gting tshugs par mkhyen pa'i gsung ris ma mchis la/

srid gsum mkhan po dang*/ rje 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po sogs kyi yig cha na yang*/ dpe hrul sna tshogs kyi tshig skam la blo phugs bcol te/ tshod dpags kyi mi 'dra gra sgrig mdzad pa ma gtogs gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs dang bcas pa la/ rnam dpyod kyi nges pa rnyed nas smras pa'i gtam mi snang ngo*// kho bos ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras las byung ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhung lugs la shin tu 'dris par byas te/ bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi yig cha nges med rnams la skyabs ma bcol bar 'phags pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa'i dpyid dang*/ lam gyi zhe phugs gang yin pa rtogs par bgyis nas/ gang du mtshon pa tsam smos pa ste/ gzhan yang bshad par bya ba mang du yod mod kyis/ yi ger 'jigs te re zhig de tsam mo// zhes pa ni bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi nga ro chen po dkon mchog gsum la'ang 'dzem med du sgrags so// 'phags lugs kyi 'dus pa 'chad pa po snga rabs pa phal cher ni rgyud sde rin po che'i tshig don la mnga' brnyes shing*/ rgyud sde rin po che'i tshig don dang*/ bskyed rdzogs la dbang thob pa/ lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su gzung ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa sha stag yin pa tsho mi shes pa'i gral du bzhag ham spyod kyi ha ra hu ras bab chol du smra ba tshos dpyis phyin shes pa'i khungs bzod pa khyed nas/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la gshe ba 'di lta bu ni lugs gnyis ka'i bka' khrims rdog rdzis su byas par snang yang*/ dus kyi dbang las tshe 'dir rnam smin mthong chos su snang ba dka' mod/ tshar bcad gshin rje'i rgyal pos byed par 'gyur/ mkhas pa yin nges shes pa go shāka dang klu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs kyis ma shes la/ khyed kyis dpe med shes par khas 'che ba'i gtam 'di 'dra ni/ sa skya pa spyi sgos la sog po thengs gsum rgyug pa'i steng du ?ba ma rim brdungs par gyur pa na blo 'di lta bu gtam ngan thos par gyur pa ni de ka ma yin pas sa skya pa la zhen rus can dag

lung rigs shes na tshar chod/ nus ldan yod na mthu rdegs/ de lta min kyang thu lud 'debs par rigs so// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen pad+ma dkar po mkhyen gnyis kyi 'dab brgya ci dgar bzhad pa la/ g.yer ma'i me tog gis 'gran brdzus pa ni/ khrel bgad kyi gnas su 'dug pa la smos ma dgos/ spyir dkar brgyud dang sgos 'brug pa'i khrod na/ rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag du ma dang*/ lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas pa ji snyed mchis kyang*/ khyed sku skye snga phyi'i khas len par phangs pas dbyings su bzhugs par gsol/ dkar brgyud kyi grwa pa'i tha shal kho bo tsam gyis kyang*/ khyed kyi smra ngan rnams lung dang rigs pas btsod bzhin du brdungs/ til bzhin du btsir/ rdul phran bzhin du gsil ba mngon sum pa 'di la su zhig bsnyon/ des na sa skya pa'i drag shos su khas blangs pa de/ 'brug pa'i lod shos kyis cham la phob/ zhes grags pa'i dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbyangs kyis sa gsum gang bar gyur to// ༈ rab dbyer/ jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skyes// zhes gsungs pa'i don la 'brug pa dpon slob gnyis kas nā ro pa dbang dus su mthong lam skye zhing de mi rtag par 'gag pa zhig bzhed par sa paṇa gyis gsungs so snyam nas smra ba mang du bris shing*/ sa lugs pa phal mo che yang rab dbye'i dgongs don de ka yin par smra la/ zhes shing rag gi sgra las byung ngo*// nged dpon slob kyis sun 'byin smra yul/ khyed ma 'khrungs gong gi sa lugs smra ba kha cig yin pas/ de la de 'os su brjod pa yin gyi/ shing rag tu/ kho bo ni/ zhes sogs bon lugs bzhin gsar byung gi grub mtha' smra ba yin 'dug pas/ dang po khyed rang gsar rnying 'drongs par mdzod la/ de nas phyogs gzhan gyi dgag pa srung bar mdzod cig/ ༈ srid gsum du/ dbang dus kyi mthong lam de yang*/ mthong lam ma yin par bsgrubs/

zhes sogs smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ phyogs snga'i nam ma langs par dgag pa'i nyi ma shar ba ste/ dbang dus skyes pa'i dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam dang bden mthong gi ming btags pa rnams/ mthong lam mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa dang*/ bden mthong mtshan nyid pa ma yin par ni cis kyang 'dod la sogs bris te/ kho bos ni srid gsum du bris pa ltar ro// dpe dang don gyi ye shes/ bden mthong dang bden mthong ma yin pa sogs la rang sa rang sa'i bab dang mthun pa'i ming re snang ba de ltar 'dod pa 'thad kyi/ dgos med du ma yin pa la yin pa'i ming btags pa la rgyu mtshan med de/ bdag tu lta ba la bdag med kyi ming dang*/ mun pa la snang ba'i ming dang*/ nub la shar gyi ming*/ 'og la steng gi ming btags pa sogs brda dang tha snyad las 'gongs pa'i gtam yin pas skabs 'di dag tu mdzes pa ma yin no// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ grub thob kyang*/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa grub thob tu ming btags pa rnams skabs thob/ sgos tsam pa'i dmigs bsal la grub thob tu rung yang*/ zhes sogs smras pa 'dis/ rje sa paṇa kyang sun phyung ste/ de nyid kyis/ 'phags pa min la grub thob med// ces gsungs pa nyid kyis/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa'i grub thob yod par khas blangs pas so// srid gsum du/ dbang las byung ba'i ye shes de rang byung ma yin te/ las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i spros pa la ltos pas so// zhes dang*/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i ye shes de yang rang byung ma yin te/ rim gnyis sgom pa'i 'bad rtsol la ltos pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ rten gzhi/ rje 'gyur med kyi 'chal gtam ngom 'chor du byas pa la skyabs su bcol nas/ srid gsum du bris pa de bshus par snang yang zer ro// rang byung gi don ni rgyu rkyen gyi rtsol ba la ma ltos par lhun gyis grub pa cig dgos rgyu la/

rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i rang byung de 'dra ngo mtshar ba mthong nas smras pa lags kyis/ rje rin po che 'gyur med zhabs de nyid mkhas pa la grub pas khyad par du byas pa zhig yin par khums pas 'chal gtam mi gsung ba thag chod cing*/ dag snang che bar yod kyang*/ dkar brgyud rin po che'i legs bshad kyis tshim pas de 'dra la skyabs 'chol dgos pa'i rigs de min pas bka' bkyon med pa zhu'o// ༈ shing rag tu/ don gyi lan rnal ma ni/ sdom 'byung gi rgyud du/ 'di ni rang byung 'char ba'o// zhes rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa la rang byung gi ming btags kyang*/ de thob par/ snang ba med cing thogs pa med// ces sogs las byung bas bde stong gi lam sgom pa la ltos par bshad cing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// gcig pu bdag nyid che ba'i lha// zhes dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud du/ 'khor ba dag pa'i bdag nyid de// rang 'byung nga nyid kho na yin// zhes chos sku thams cad rang byung du bshad kyang*/ de thob pa la/ lam phar phyin bcu dang*/ rim gnyis sgom pa sogs la ltos dgos par bshad pa ltar/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes sogs/ rdzogs rim rang byung gi ye shes rnams/ rang byung yin yang de thob pa/ dbang dang lam sgom pa la ltos pa ni 'gal ba med la/ mdor na/ chos sku thams cad rang byung yin yang*/ de thob pa lam sgom pa la ltos dgos pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mdo rgyud thams cad du/ chos sku thob pa'i thabs kyi rim pa gnyis gtso bor gsungs pa bzhin no// zhes rnal ma'i lan shin tu ring ba zhig gsungs so// tshig rtsa ye rang mi zin pa 'di khyed la lhan skyes su snang ste/ mkhas pa'i zhal bzhes mthon por mdzad nas de 'dra gsung bar ga la rigs/ rang byung zhes pa'i tshig yod tshad 'dir lung du drangs kyang sgrub byed du mi 'gyur ba lags/ rgyu mtshan/ rtsod gzhir/

nged kyi phyag chen dbang las byung*/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin las byung zhes rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi sgra byung ba la 'khris nas rtsod 'dug pa la/ nged ra'i lung 'dren rnams na de 'dra med par/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs de rang byung yin par ston pa tsam las/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i gtam gang yang mi gda' ba/ rtsod pa 'di rigs la bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed dod mi mnyam na legs po mi 'ong bas zhib po mdzad dgos lags/ don du chos sku de rgyu rkyen la ma ltos pa'i rang byung yin cing de rtogs pa'i thabs su lam sgom dgos kyang*/ de lam sgom pa las byung ba ma yin pa la/ gzhung du/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni// dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*// rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las// byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin// zhes dbang dang sgom stobs las byung bar bshad pa la sku rtsed phran bu zhus pa'o// ༈ yang srid gsum du mthong lam skye ba'i rten du/ 'phags pa nges par dgos zhes gsung ba 'dra na/ de yang snying pos dben zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ 'di rab dbyer/ des na nged kyi mthong lam ni// 'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid// ces pa la zur za bar snang yang*// phyogs 'gro tsam du'ang ma phyin pa ste/ gzhung de'i don mthong lam skye ba'i rten du 'phags pa nges par dgos zer ba ma yin gyis/ mthong lam 'phags pa kho na'i rgyud la yod/ so so'i skye bo'i rgyud la med/ ces pa'i don yin zhes smras so// rab dbye la zur za ba tsam la cha ma bzhag dngos bstan rang du zhus pa yin na'ang*/ gzhung de'i don tshul bzhin 'chad na khyed rang gsungs pa bzhin zer dgos shas kha mod de/ de bzhin gsung mkhan cher mi snang bas brtsad pa'o// ༈ shing rag las 'brug pa'i gan mdzod du/ rkang pa phyi ma des ni/ des na gang zag dbang po rab// dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs// zhes pa'ang bden med du btang la/

zhes dang*/ de'i rdzun rgyab rdzun gyis gnon pa'i thabs su/ srid gsum las/ dbang dus su grol ba zhig yod na lta/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni// dbang las byung ba'i ye shes yin// gsung pas chog pa la/ des ma grol bas ka /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las// byung ba'i zhes smos 'dug pas/ dbang dus su grol ba med par bsgrubs zin nas/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ lan 'di 'dra skabs su babs pas nyon cig 'o na dus 'khor du/ ye shes phebs pas/ sangs rgyas bla ma yi yang bla ma rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i ston pa gcig pur 'gyur/ zhes ye shes dbab pa'i dus su grol bar bshad pa mi bden te/ ye shes dbab pa'i dus su grol ba zhig yod na/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi'i cho ga bshad pas/ gsungs nas ci zhig byed/ ye shes dbab pa'i dus su ma grol bas ka dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ lam ston pa sogs dgos pa byung ba yin/ des na rgyud sde rnams su rim gnyis sgom pa'i man ngag dang*/ dbang bzhi dngos gzhi'i cho ga bshad pas/ ye shes dbab pa'i dus su grol ba'ang bden med du btang ngo*/ zhes rnam pa kun tu khyed la mtshungs so// 'di ni 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po dang*/ srid gsum dge mtshan rtsom pa po gnyis la/ mgo bor gnam lcags kyi thog babs pa ltar gyur/ zhes zha nye'i phur bu gnam lcags kyi thog ltar bcos nas phab pa de ni sdig mdzub kyi phyag rgya 'dis bzlog par bya'o// 'di la zhib dpyad byas na/ skal ldan sbyangs pa can dbang dus su grol ba dang*/ der grol ma thub pas rim gnyis sgom/ des kyang grol bar dka' na spyod pa spyad nas tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba brgyud nas thob pa zhig yod par ni gnyis ka 'dod mod/ 'on kyang rab dbyer/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni// dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*// rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las// byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin// ces pa'i dngos bstan ltar na/

su la'ang dbang dang rim gnyis can du dgos pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa dang*/ yang*/ des na gang zag dbang po rab// dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs// zhes pa de 'gal ba ltar snang ba la 'khris nas rtsod par snang la/ gal te tshig de dag ltar snang du'ang 'gal med du 'char bar bzhed na/ dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi zhes ma gsungs na rtsod pa 'di 'byung ba'i go skabs med do// 'di nged kyi rtog btags min te/ paṇa chen shāka mchog pa'i gser thur las/ tshad thub 'grel chen bzhi dang gzhung nyid du// tshig zur ji bzhin ma phyin 'dir dpyad kyi// zhes gzhung la'ang*/ yig mkhan dang par mkhan dang zhus ma dag pas tshig zur 'chug pa yod par bshad cing*/ khong la mi shes pa'i bka' bkyon phog 'dug kyang*/ deng sang gi mkhas pa las ches mkhas pas na de ni nges par bden pa nyid do// des na gzhung don la thog mar gzhigs/ de nas gzhung lugs gzhan dang bstun/ snga phyi'i 'brel bsams/ de nas 'bru gnyer ram/ rgol bzlog gam/ slob ma la 'doms shes na legs rgyu la de bzhin ma byung tsa na/ da lta'i 'di dang 'dra bar/ gzhung snga phyi las 'gal 'grel sdeb nas/ rtsod spong mkhan chen gnyis ka 'o thug sbrang rtsi can gsol dgos par gyur to// cis kyang de rigs la da dung thugs dgyes pa zhig na 'di zhu ste/ 'o na dus 'khor du/ ye shes rdo rje phebs pa'i dus su grol bar bshad pa mi bden te/ dbang ma bskur bar grol ba ni shes bya 'di la mi srid pa gang zhig byin rlabs dbab dus su grol ba'i gang zag de ni dbang ma bskur ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ de la 'dod mi nus pa ni/ gong du khyed rang gi ye shes dbab pa'i stobs kyis slob ma de nyid du grol ba yod pa kho bo cag kyang 'dod ces smras pas so// dbang ma bskur bar grol ba med de/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na// sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*// slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni// mi bzad dmyal ba chen por 'gro// zhes sogs khyed rang gis ma drangs sam/

de lta bu'i gang zag de la dbang ma bskur ba yin te/ de la dkyil 'khor gang yang ma bstan cing*/ dbang bzhi gang yang ma bskur bas so// rgyu mtshan/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir na'o// des na thog kho ni rang yul dran nas 'khyog song bas dbu la zon mdzod cig/ ༈ yang shing rag las/ 'o na dbang bskur ba'i dus su grol ba yod na/ phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba min/ zhes pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ dbang ni lam phyogs re ba min gyi/ sngags lam ye shes kyi chu bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa la dgongs nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// sogs dang*/ mkhas rnams ci nas dbang bskur las// zhes sogs drangs pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'di thad du smra ba mang zhig mdzad 'dug par 'di 'dra zhig zhu ste/ dbang phyogs re ba min na/ rim gnyis kyang phyogs re ba min te/ mtshungs pa 'dir/ de'i shes byed/ dbang zhes pa spyi tshig spom pa yin la/ de la bzhi yod pa bzhin/ de dang 'brel ba'i rim gnyis kyang dbang dang dgos nus mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// zhes brjod nas/ slar yang 'di skad ces/ 'o na bum dbang tsam gyis grol nas lam sgom mi dgos pa'i gang zag de 'dra srid dam mi srid/ mi srid na dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i byin dbab tsam gyis grol nus la/ bstod bsngags dpe med byas pa'i dbang gi nang tshan bum dbang tsam gyis grol mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/ dbang gi dngos gzhi las 'jug pa zab pa'i khyad par 'thon cing*/ de bzhin du/ gsang dbang yan tsam dang sher dbang yan chad tsam gyis grol ba sogs kyang sbyor/ byin dbab tsam gyis grol ba'i gang zag de/ des na gang zag dbang po rab// dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs// zhes pa'i gnad du bstun e nus/ nus na byin dbab de dbang yin nam/ yin na khyed kyi bzhed pa'i thog tu gnod byed kyi char 'di dang 'di babs te zhes 'phro 'thud nas cham la 'bebs so// yang gal te dbang tsam gyis grol ba'i gang zag srid na/
