dbang bzhi rim par nges can du bskur dgos pa'i lab lob brgya tshar bgrangs pa tsho dang 'gal zhing*/ lhag par dpa' bo sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud lung khyed rang gis sngar drangs par/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ba tsam gyis stong pa nyid// de bzhin dbang dang bral na yang*// ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid// ces pa gsang dbang dang sbyar// dper na pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral na yang*// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes pa sher dbang dang sbyar/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ji ltar sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// zhes dbang bzhi pa dang sbyar te rgyud de'i 'grel bshad/ bka' 'grel ye shes ldan ces pa'i dpe hrul dpal sa ra ha chen pos mdzad pa de na 'dug pa de dang 'gal bas/ khyed kyi bshad bshad zhung zhung thams cad bye ma'i changs bu bzhin du zhig pa kho na'o/ des na/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do// zhes bya ba grub mtha' bzang po yin pas/ 'di la phyin ci ma log pa'i go don gang lon mdzod dang khyed la sman yon du 'gyur ro// shing rag 'khor ba'i stong sgra can// jo bo mi bzang ston pa ngan// tshig nyog rlung lha'i ba dan de// 'gal ba'i thal phung rtse la 'phyar// legs par bshad dang nyes par smras// 'khyog po'i blo can gyis mi rtogs// blo tshad 'brel ba shar nas slar// drangs po'i srang la bteg na mngon// ༈ yang*/ nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// sogs kyi skabs su/ phyag rgya bzhi'i dam rgya gsum par bzhed pa dang bzhi par bshad pa las 'phros nas/ shing rag tu/ kha sbyor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lung drangs kyang ma 'brel te/ nged kyi dam rgya gsum par bzhag pa mi bden ces pa'am/

dam rgya bzhi par bzhag pa mi bden zer ba lta bu byas na/ sam+bu ṭi las dam rgya bzhi par bzhag mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las gsum par bzhag ste ces lung de 'dren pa yin mod kyang*/ nā ro mai tri'i dam rgya bzhag pa'i rang gzhung dang mi bstun/ sa paṇa gyis dam rgya gsum par bzhag pa de nā ro mai tri'i gzhung yin pa ltar mdzad pa la brtsad par 'dug yang skyor zhe skyor gyi gtam gag lhog srung ba'i bzlas brjod ltar/ gong 'og mang por khyed kyis byas rjes/ nged la de'i nyes pa dkri ba 'di nan ltar mi 'tsham pa'i gtam snang yang*/ lha bka' babs pa'i rtags su snang bas bya thabs ma brnyed// ༈ shing rag tu rab dbyer/ dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen la dgag pa mang du mdzad pa'i grub don ni/ da lta'i dkar brgyud pa rnams gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po tsam phyag chen dngos dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang gi bzhi pa mthar thug gi phyag chen du 'dod cing*/ de thob pa las rgya la ltos mi dgos par/ lta ba gnas lugs kyi gdams ngag bsgom pas thob par 'dod pa de nges par mi 'thad/ ces pa ni rnam bcad kyi don no// zhes bris so// rje sa paṇa gyis dgag pa mdzad yul gyi dkar brgyud pa ni/ rje dwags po dang phag 'bri sogs gong ma rnams yin mod/ da lta'i dkar brgyud pa la ma 'ongs lung bstan mdzad na ma gtogs ci ltar byed des na de ni phyogs snga ma smin par e 'gyur soms dang hob spyod kyi skyon du go bar 'gyur ro// dkar brgyud lugs la thabs lam dang grol lam gnyis mdzad pa'i dang po la/ phyag rgya bzhir dbye ba'i dam rgya de dang*/ grol lam gyi gnas lugs phyag chen de gnyis/ ngo bo sa mtshams dgos pa thams cad gcig tu bzhed/ don mngon du byed thabs la/ dbang po'i bye brag mtha' gcig tu ma nges par/ tha ma las rgya sogs la rim gyis brten pa dang*/ 'bring yid rig sogs la brten pa dang*/ rab stong gzugs la brten pa'i mu gang yang bzhed pa las/

thabs lam pa rnams dang po gnyis la gtso bor brten cing grol lam pa rnams mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas kyi sgrub pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan nas mngon du byed pa lags te/ drung pas gzhan gzhung gi dpe hrul ma mthong ba'i skyon du gda' yi/ dgag sgrub mdzad bzhed na rang gzhan la sbyangs pa dgos/ rnam pa gzhan du na/ khyed rang gsungs pa bzhin/ phyogs snga'i nam ma langs sa nas/ dgag pa'i nyi ma kho yang yang shar ba der gda'o// srid gsum du dus 'khor gyi lung*/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs dor zhing*// ye shes phyag rgya rnam par spangs// phyag rgya che las yang dag skyes// lhan skyes gzhan dang 'grog pas min// ces drangs nas/ phyag rgya dang po gnyis la ma brten par/ sems rnam par dben pa las byung ba'i phyag chen de stong nyid kyi gzugs brnyan bsgrub/ 'od gsal du zhugs pa'i zung 'jug bstan pa nyid kyis don gnyis 'grub bo// ces pa dang de'i 'og tsam du/ lam 'bras bkag pa yin te/ 'tshang rgya ba'i nye rgyur/ rang dang spangs rtogs mtshungs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya nges par dgos zhes pa la/ 'dir las kyi phyag rgya bcos ma 'ba' zhig las/ ma bcos pa'i lhan cig skyes pa mi 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag las/ srid gsum du/ sa lugs la dgag pa mang du bris 'dug pa gzhan rnams ni/ byis pa'i tshig tsam las/ mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu 'os su mi snang mod/ skabs 'di'i rtsod pa 'di gnyis/ rtsod khyer shin tu legs shing*/ rgyud sde la sbyangs pa byas pa'i rnam dpyod can nang phan tshun lhan cig 'dzom pa na mkhas pas dpyad pa bya ba'i dka' gnad du gtogs pa zhig snang la/ 'on kyang des rje btsun sa skya pas lam 'bras su/ sangs rgya ba las kyi phyag rgya la nges par ltos dgos par bshad pa la ni/ gnod mi nus pa'i lung rigs rnal ma kho bos bshad par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams/

bzhi pa don gyi phyag rgya chen po/ nges par las rgya la ltos par bzhed pa 'di/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin par bsgrub pa dang*/ de la dus kyi 'khor lo'i lung gis gnod pa med pa'i tshul gyis srid gsum gyi rtsod pa spangs pa gnyis so// zhes bris so// kho bo rang ni so skye 'ching ba kun ldan zhig lags kyis/ dam pa dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang*/ grub thob sogs ming snyan snyan rnams gzhan tshang gis bdag gir mdzad pas ma thob/ rgyu mtshan des 'brug pa'i khrod du'ang thabs brdugs mkhos med cig las ma byung mod/ 'on kyang*/ mkhas pa'i 'dun sar sbyangs/ grub pa'i khrod du bsgoms/ blo gros zhib mos dpyad par brten/ kha 'di las 'chal gtam mi 'byung ba'i dpang por rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pas/ srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos na byis pa'i tshig dang 'dra ba'i 'brel med yod pa min yang*/ de ltar du dgongs pa ni 'phags pa nyan thos pa dag theg pa chen po la ma dad pas 'khu ba bzhin no// de ltar na'ang*/ nyid rang mkhas pa chen por zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ de'i zhal las tshig 'di dag gang yang rgyu bzhin du/ mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu bar mi 'os zhes 'gal bar gsungs nas ci zhig mdzad/ des na btang snyoms su bzhag par 'os so// rtsod pa 'di gnyis rgyud sde la sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod can nang phan tshun lhan cig tu 'dzom pa na/ mkhas pas dpyad par bya ba'i dka' gnad du gtogs pa zhes sogs gsungs pa de'ang 'gal ba'i phung po ste/ rgyud sde la sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod can lhan cig 'dzom pa ?ma rtsod grub thob gnyis las ma byung zhes smras so// las rgya la nges par ltos dgos pa 'di rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin par grub zer ba'ang 'brel med yin te/ rgyud sde phyi ma gnyis nas de 'dra bshad pa med pas so// kha sbyor dang*/ rdor phreng sogs rgyud kyi lung de'ang*/

klog pa dang*/ 'bri ba sogs byas pa la ni phan yon chen po yod de/ rgyud chen bklag pas 'grub pa nyid// ces brtag gnyis las gsungs shing*/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi mar yang*/ gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyan pa dang*// 'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang*// mchod pa byed pa 'bri'am 'brir 'jug pa// byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs mod kyang*/ rgyud kyi lung des rtsod pa 'di la phan gnod ma byung*/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ rgyud kyi rgyal po de dag gi lung don ni/ gang zag chags can 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam la 'jug pa de'i tshe/ phyag rgya bzhi po snga phyi rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du mthar chags slob pa'i dbang du mdzad/ de bzhin dus 'khor du'ang*/ me ni dngul chu'i dgra nyid yin te sogs dpe dang bcas gsungs shing*/ de'i go rim yang*/ rgyal ba'i lhan skyes bde ba 'di ni 'phel ba'i don slad dang por las kyi phyag rgya bsten par bya/ sogs gsungs kyi rnam pa kun tu lam rim de ka ma gtogs khrid tshul gzhan byed pa med pa'i mtha' bkag pa ma yin no// gzhan yang*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i sngon du las rgya bsten nas dbang po gnyis mnyam sbyor zhig nges par dgos so snyam pa de la/ 'o na nyan rang dgra bcom lhag med du zhugs pa rnams kyang*/ spyir theg chen dang*/ sgos sngags lam du 'jug pa de'i tshe yid lus de nyid 'jug dgos la/ yid lus pas las rgya la ji ltar spyod sems dang*/ gal te de dag theg chen du 'jug khar rdul phran tshogs pa'i rags lus len no snyam na/ de ni dgra bcom thob pa na/ bdag gi skye ba zad do/ 'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so// zhes pa dang 'gal bas na legs bshad ma yin no// de'i phyir/ rgya 'grel kha cig tu rgyud kyi lung drangs par/ 'di la spang ba gnyis yod de/ yon tan med nas spangs pa dang*/

khyad par 'phags nas spangs pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ lta ba'am rlung gi nus pas kham 'dzag med du 'ching tshugs pa'i yon tan med pa dang*/ stong gzugs phyag chen la bsten nas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen mngon du byed nus pas khyad par du 'phags pa/ de gnyis pos las rgya la bsten pa'i lam 'di spangs kyang chog go /zhes 'chad pa la/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis don dam bsnyen par/ bud med sbyor bas dman la srid me'i sdug bsngal med// bud med sbyor bas dman la mchog gi bde ba'ang med// de bas rang gi blo yis legs par brtags nas ni// sngags pas gang la 'dod pa yang ni blangs par gyis// gsungs so// de'i phyir lam 'bras kyi dgongs pa yin rgyur bsgoms nas/ las rgya la bsten pa'i lam rim rnam pa kun tu dgos par 'bad pas bsgrub kyang thang chad pa tsam las snying po med par zad la/ gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag sbyor ba'i lam ston pa ni thabs la mkhas shing thabs cig kho na la brdugs pa ste/ de'i phyir/ rdo rje'i theg pa la thabs mang ba zhes bsngags pa'i don kyang de kho na'o// gang ltar yang*/ las kyi phyag rgya la gzab bshad rus 'don dpe med mdzad lugs kyis dgongs yul du gang bzhugs mi shes pa snang yang*/ mchog gi dngos grub cung zad 'gyang pa ni sla yi bstan pa la chu sbur byung ba ni de lta ma yin pas/ mkhan thog tu bzhugs ring khrims sam mi khas mi slad pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen/ ces gsol to// ༈ 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*/ phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsungs/ zhes sogs la/ srid gsum du/ bka' brdzus lhan thabs kyis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos de dang por su zhig gis brtsams snyam du bsams so// de ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis so zhe na/ de des ma mdzad par a bhā ya kā ras man ngag snye mar bshad do// zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ de ni nus pa med pa ste/

a bhā ya kā ras bshad pa tsam/ sgrub byed tshad mar ci zhig tu 'gyur/ zhes sogs bris te/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa chen po dag gi tshig tshad mar mi rung na/ bod rgan rnams la ni mi brtsi bar khyed kyis khas blangs zin/ da ni tshad thub bstan bcos mi srid par khas longs shig/ ༈ shing rag tu/ 'brug phyogs pa rnams/ las kyi phyag rgya bcos ma 'ba' zhig las/ ma bcos pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes sogs kyi tshig 'di rigs yod pa de 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung dngos su khas len par snang la/ kho bo ni/ tshig rigs de ltar yod pa de klu sgrub kyi ma yin te/ bstan bcos de'i nang na/ lhan skyes gsum pa dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba bzhi par byas pa dang*/ rje btsun gong ma'i rgyud 'grel rnams na dgag pa mdzad pa'i phyogs snga 'ga' zhig bstan bcos de'i nang na snang bas/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ma mdzad bzhin du/ mdzad pa'i kha 'phangs byas pa ni/ khyed rnams 'dod pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa'i bstan bcos de nyid do// zhes dang*/ slob dpon mai tri pa'i gzhung rnams dang grub mtha' gcig kho nar snang bas/ khyed rnams tshad mar rtsi ba'i gzhung 'di mai tri pa'i phyogs mthun zhig gis byas par nges kyi/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ma yin no// zhes sogs myog myog mang po bris so// a bhā yas bshad pa sgrub byed du mi rung ba bzhin/ gong ma'i rgyud 'grel kyang mtshungs la/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ mchog mtha' dga' bral dang por ni// mun pa la ni mar me ltar// de bzhin sus kyang yid ches bgyis// zhes te/ mchog dga'i mtha'/ dga' bral ma byung ba'i gong der mar mes mtshon pa'i lhan cig skyes dga' mngon du byed par/ rdo rje 'chang gis bshad/ mar rngog yab sras kyis bkral ba bzhin yin pas na/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung 'khrul med du nges shing mai tri pa'ang klu sgrub kyi rjes 'jug yin pas/

grub mtha' phal cher mthun mod/ de tsam gyis mai tri pa'i phyogs mthun gyis brtsams pa'ang mi 'grub bo// ༈ srid gsum du/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung drangs nas phyag chen gyi 'phros gleng phul ba la/ shing rag tu/ dug sbrul gyi gla rtsi'i dri tshor ba bzhin du thugs cher 'khrugs te/ lkug pa'i spyang chos byas zer gshe ba zhig snang mod kyang*/ de gsum phyag rgya chen po yin tshul sa skya'i bka' 'bum na yod pa la yod zer dbang 'ong thang la/ dgos don med na'ang de 'dra zhig mthong*// ༈ srid gsum du/ mdo dang rgyud sde gong ma las gsungs pa'i phyag chen gyi ming can thams cad phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i shes byed la/ mu dra zhes pa la phyag dang rgya so sor phral ba'i bshad pa dang*/ gcig tu bsdams nas 'chad pa sogs byung mod/ gang ltar yang 'dra/ rdo rje 'dis ni gdab pa nyid// des na phyag rgyar brjod par bya// zhes phyag rgya'i don mi 'da' bar rgyas btab pa zhig la zer la/ des na mi 'da' ba zhig la/ phyag rgya'i sgra btags na dngos por gnas pa ste/ zhes sogs bkod pa la/ shing rag tu de ni nus pas dben te/ mi 'da' ba zhig gis phyag rgyar 'gyur na/ 'dul ba'i dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa rnams kyang*/ rang rang gi bslab pa las mi 'da' bas de dag phyag rgyar 'gro ba sogs ha cang thal ches pas so// zhes bris so// kho bos dbang ma bskur bar mchog thob pa yod pa'i sgrub byed rtsed mo'i tshul du/ dbang bskur med par zab mo bsgoms pas sangs rgyas thob snyam na/ dbang bskur med par lam zab mo// sgom pa ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs// zhes drangs nas/ mdo lugs zab mo stong pa nyid sgom mkhan tsho ngan song gsum po gar skyes yod ces bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ khyed kyi dbang ma bskur bar mchog thob pa zhes pa 'di mdo lugs la rung yang*/ de ni skabs kyi don ma yin la/ zer ba byas nas yang 'dir 'dul ba'i dper brjod byas pa 'di skabs su ji ltar bab soms dang*/

jo bo ngan pa tsam la snying po ma bzung zhig 'on kyang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal zhes sogs bzhi la bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhir bod pa'ang*/ de dang de las mi 'da' ba'i don yin/ des na ha cang thal ba'i skyon ci 'dug/ ༈ srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes phyag chen btags pa bar mdzad dgos pa la/ da lam phyag chen dpe'i ye shes zer ba byas nas/ dpe'i ye shes de yang phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin rgyu'i khul gyis sbubs 'dren mdzad nas/ gzhan la gshe ba'ang mi 'os zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ de dang mtshungs par/ phyis byung ba'i sa lugs pa mngon rloms can kha cig kyang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin zer mod/ 'di bsre bslad can gyi grub mtha' rang dgar smras pa ma gtogs/ rje gong ma'i dgongs pa gtan nas ma yin te/ zhes chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta'i lung 'dren dang bcas bris 'dug pas/ de ltar na/ phyis byung gi sa lugs pa mngon rloms can phan tshun dgag sgrub mdzod dang kho thag chod par 'gyur ro// ༈ shing rag tu/ sor sdud dang*/ sgyu lus/ sems dben sogs phyag chen du bshad pa rnams phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin zer shes byed bkod/ rje gser pas/ mi blun po dang ba glang gi dpe mdzad nas/ de pa phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa'i shes byed bkod 'dug pa 'gal mod kyi/ sku skye bzhes nas thugs bskyed thob pa'am lod du song ba gang yin brtag par rigs so// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ 'brug pa rnams la khas blangs nang 'gal gyi nyes pa yang 'byung ste/ 'brug pas/ sgyu lus gtum mo sogs phyag chen du bzhag nas/ yang srid gsum du/ dpe'i ye shes phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ma yin par byas pa shin tu 'gal/ zhes 'dzer mod/ gan mdzod du/ phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i sgra ni/ spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang bshad la/ de dag cam zhog rnal 'byor chen po nyid kyi 'dus par/

rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che// sogs lung 'dren mdzad pa'i mthar/ sgyu lus phyag chen du bzhag pa sogs ma phyed pas so// zhes gsungs kyi mtshan nyid pa yin ma gsungs pa dang*/ srid gsum du/ don gyi ye shes phyag chen dngos dang*/ dpe'i ye shes btags pa bar byas pa la nang 'gal rgyu ci yod/ 'gal ba'i 'khur po yongs rdzogs/ khyed dbang chen tshos hab shar khyer nas bdag cag 'brug pas ma thob lags// ༈ shing rag tu/ rab dbyer/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /bshad pa la/ 'brug pa'i gan mdzod dang*/ srid gsum du yang zlos skyor gyi tshig mang po bris kyang*/ yig tshogs che la don chung ngur snang*/ ngas snying po 'di ltar/ srid gsum du de bkag pa'i gzhung tshad ldan rnyed na lta/ rtsod pa kho nad grol dang gdon grol la 'gro ste/ de ma byung zhes dang*/ dgag byed kyi lung gis shin tu dbul bar gyur nas/ de la dbang dgos pa'i sgrub byed ji tsam bkod kyang*/ rtsa ba'i gnod byed du ma song bas sha go mar gyis ma chod ces dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dang ni// bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang*// dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces lung mang po yod rgyu'i khul gyis shog ral gzi brjid can mdzad pa la dbu 'khor nas mang du glengs kyang*/ lag yod du phyogs snga'i rtsa bar gnod nges kyi lung tshig rkang gcig kyang ma 'byor/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ de la dkar brgyud pa rnams/ gnas lugs ?zung 'jug gi ye shes la/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi ngos 'dzin pa de 'gog pa'i bar du/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi tas rab dbyer/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /zhes spyir bstan nas/ dmigs bsal/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan gyi mchog tu gyur pa'i bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po ste/ dbang bzhi ma thob par/ dbang gsum man chad ci thob kyang*/

de mi skye zhing sgom du'ang mi rung ngo*// zhes ston pa la/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgom dang*// zhes pa nas/ rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru byas// zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ zhes bris so// rab tu dbye ba'i gzhung tshan gnyis por/ dbang bzhi pa ma thob par/ phyag rgya chen po mi sgom gsung ba tsam zhig ma gtogs/ phyag rgya bzhi'i mchog tu gyur ma 'gyur gyi brjod gleng ma mdzad kyang*/ khyed kyis btsan du btang ba'i khul byas mod de/ gong ltar/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par phyag rgya chen po sgom rung ste/ sor sdud/ sems dben/ sgyu lus rnams/ phyag chen dpe'i ye shes su khas blangs shing*/ de phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ma yin par khyed 'dod pa gang zhig de dag ni dbang bzhi pa ma thob kyang*/ gsang dbang dang sher dbang tsam thob pas kyang sgom du rung ba la ni rtsod pa med pa'i phyir/ zer na ci gsungs// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa'i lung khungs dus 'khor yin par/ rang mchan dang*/ dmar mchan gnyis kar gsungs pa ltar/ 'grel chen dri med 'od du/ phyag rgya chen po dbang dang 'brel pa zhig dgos pa'i lung dngos shugs shin tu mang zhing*/ zhes sogs/ khyed rang gsung ba bzhin/ yig tshogs che la don chung ba mang du bris so// khyed rang gis gong du 'di smras te/ byis dbang sngon du ma song yang*/ mchog dbang bzhi po nyid smin dbang du 'gyur bas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skad sgos tsam pa zhig ste/ lugs 'di rgyud sde gzhan gyi 'jog mtshams dang*/ bstun dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ zhes smras pa dran nam/ gal te dran tshe 'dir yang de bzhin smras na ci gsungs/ blo tshad 'di skya ser kun la thun mong du mkho ba zhig yin pas/ skabs rer khyed kyis kyang mdzod cig/ ༈ yang khyed kyis/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa ma thob pa'i phyir/ dbang gzhan thams cad don med par 'gyur ro// zhes drangs pa'i lung 'di/

sgra ji bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes na ni/ dbang bzhi pa ma thob gong du bskur rgyu'i dbang*/ bum gsang sher gsum yod pa de/ don med bzhin du bla mas bskur zhing*/ don med du slob mas zhu ba yin nam/ sgra ji bzhin du zhal gyis mi bzhes na ni khyed kyi sgrub byed du mi 'gyur ro// dus 'khor rtsa 'grel gyi bshad srol gzhung ji bzhin du 'jug na/ dpe hrul gyi tshig sna bsdus pa rang gi mi phan pas slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal las rtogs par bya dgos so// de lta bas na/ 'brug phyogs pa'i rtsod pa rang yal du song ngam/ shing rag pa'i rtsod pa rang yal du song*/ drang po'i thugs ldan rnams kyis dgongs shing mkhyen par mdzad du gsol// ༈ gan mdzod las/ mdo rang rkang gis 'tshang rgya bar khas blangs pa dang nang 'gal/ zhes dang*/ de'i rdzun rgyab tu/ srid gsum las/ pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs nas// grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes sogs kyi gzhung zhal gsal can bzhugs shing*/ de'i lugs 'dzin du'ang khas blangs nas/ slar mdo rang rkang gis 'tshang rgya ba khas mi len zer ba de ni/ 'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung la brgal ba ste/ zhes pa der snang bas gang yang mi btub la/ rab dbye la mi rtsi na ni/ 'dod na de la ngas ci bya zer ba der gda'o// zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ rtsod khyer 'di dag gis nus pa ni/ rab dbyer/ phyag rgya chen po dbang la ltos par bshad pa la/ de la ltos mi dgos te/ mdo lam la bsten nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dam pa thob par yod pas so// zer rgyu snang mod/ phyogs snga'i skya rengs tsam yang ma shar ba'i dgag pa ste/ nged rnams mdo lam las sa dang po thob pa zhig 'dod kyang*/ zhes sogs mang du glengs so// mdo lugs kyis 'tshang rgya ba khas blangs/ zhes dang*/ grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes pa'i gzhung 'don bzhin tu/ shing rag tu/ sa dang po thob pa yod pas so// zer rgyur snang mod ces smra ba 'di smyon gtam zad ma rang yin pa snang la/

de ni phyogs snga'i skya rengs tsam yang ma shar ba'i dgag pa ngo ma'o// de min gyi lab lob nged la dgos byed mi gda'/ gzhung gsal po snga phyi gnyis kyi 'thus pa bdog sdom gsum gyi lung de pa dang*/ bdag med bstod 'grel mi mthun la/ rje btsun rtse mo la gang yang zhu sa med pas/ kho rang mkha' spyod kyi go sar bzhugs su chugs/ sa lugs pa phyis byon la ngan smras kyi mchod pa'ang de tsam gyis chog mod/ da ma 'bul mdzod// ༈ yang shing rag las/ srid gsum du/ mdo lam gyis sangs rgyas thob pa/ sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa yin pa ji tsam zhig sgrub kyang*/ dgos pa gzhan ma mthong bas khyed rang 'o brgyal ba tsam mo zer ro// nged kyi rtsod gleng gi 'phros su/ sa paṇa 'di bden pa gsung mkhan cig yin nam snyam nas sdom gsum gyi gzhung la 'khris pa lags kyis/ khyed thugs rgyus che bas de bzhin phebs sgo byung phyin 'o brgyal byed don mi gda'o// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ 'brug phyogs pas mdo sngags khyad med pa dang*/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad yin zer ba de yang rdul phran bzhin du phye mar sun dbyung ba'i lung rigs kyi phung po grangs las 'das so// kho bo'i spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa'i rgyu rtsol med du 'char mod kyi/ chos rje 'brug pa rin po che/ deng sang mkhas tshul cher mi ston par zab bzhes la thugs gzhol bar mdzad snang ba la/ thugs dam sad du song dogs pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ zhes zer ro// 'brug phyogs kyi grub pa'i mtha' bzang po/ mkhas pa su zhig gis chos bzhin du brgal bar mi spobs pa de la/ khyed kyis spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa'i ming gis bsnyad pa'i ham lab des bskal par brtsad kyang rngo mi thogs pas smra tshod zin par mdzod/ yang gal srid de 'dra ba bden pa zhig na ni/ ri bong gi mgo la rwa 'dug smras kyang bden par 'gyur ro// ji skad du/

ha cang rlom pa ches pa yis// sdug bsngal du mar thob par 'gyur// gsung ba ltar yin pas stod 'tshangs la gzobs shig rgya la mthun pa'i chos kyi gtam glengs na thugs dam la bogs thon pa yin te/ khyed kyi ca co 'dis thugs dam sad du 'gro shas che bas btang snyoms su bzhag na cis kyang legs pas de bzhin mdzod cig/ ༈ shing rag las/ gan mdzod du/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po yul ci nas mi thon/ zhes gsungs pa de srid gsum du zlos skyor mdzad pa ni/ phyogs snga thugs su ma tshud pas lan par 'dug pa/ 'dir snying po'i ngag don bsdus pa 'di tsam zhig zhu ste/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po khas len yang*/ de phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa dang*/ sogs snying po'i ngag don ring por brkyangs 'dug ste/ phyogs snga'i 'dod pa ka khyed snga phyi gnyis kyi thugs su ma tshud pas lan 'dug kyang*/ da dung*/ gzhi phyag chen/ gzhi dus kyi sdom pa/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas gsum mtshan nyid pa ma yin ces sgrub byed ltar snang 'god pas brel 'dug pa'i phyir/ des na/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi gzhi phyag chen de/ bde mchog kyai rdor sogs su thal ba dang*/ zhes 'phangs pa la/ srid gsum du/ lham dpe zhwa la 'gebs phul ches byas pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan 'dir/ gzhi lam dbyer med dang*/ lam 'bras dbyer med sogs nges don gyi chos skad bzang po zhwa lta bu la/ tha dad der 'dzin gyis chos skad lham lta bu'i rgyas 'gebs mdzad 'dug tshul srid gsum du smras pa de la thugs gzhig bcug pas go ba yod lags so// ༈ shing rag las/ rtsod spong du/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ces sogs dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa cung zad mdzad pa la/ srid gsum du/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po kho na re/ de la nga la ni khyad par med zer gyin gda'o// zhes bris pa ni/ phyogs snga'i nam ma langs pa ste/ zhes sogs nyag nyog mang zhig bris pa ni/ yang tshig rtsa mi zin pa'i nad ro kho ka langs pa yin/

rgyu mtshan/ gzhung lam dag la de'i sgra/ zhes pas/ gzhung sher phyin dang lam sher phyin gnyis sher phyin spyi tsam yin gsungs pa la/ gzhi sher phyin nam gzhi phyag chen la khyad par med de/ gzhi phyag chen gzhung sa lam gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir zer rgyu gda' ba la/ de thog tu mi 'bab pa'i lab lob mang po ni kha na ba tsam mo// ༈ shing rag las/ gan mdzod du/ drang don/ nges don/ mthar thug gsum phye ba la/ rje klu sgrub kyis dgag pa mdzad pa yang*/ spyi ldog nas drang nges gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i nges don mthar thug 'gog pa yin gyi/ rim pa de gsum rtsa ba nas 'gog pa ma yin te/ drang ba'i don/ gnas skabs nges don/ mthar thug nges don zhes sa lugs kyi man ngag 'gar yang snang ba'i phyir ro// zhes bris mod/ rim pa de gsum rtsa ba nas sus kyang 'gog mi thub na/ mkhan pos lta ci smos/ mkhan chen snga mas sa lugs kyi man ngag de 'dra yod pa ma dgongs pa 'dra yang*/ nyid kyi rtsad chod 'dug pa cis kyang legs gda'// ༈ srid gsum las/ rab dbyer/ rtog pa kha tshom nyid bsgom gyi// zhes pa la/ rtog pa kha tshom zhes pa/ rnam rtog lam khyer la zer na ni/ zhes brtag dpyad dang po dang*/ yang rtog pa kha tshom ni/ rnam rtog 'gog pa yin la/ de sngags kyi phyag chen ma yin zer na ni/ zhes brtag dpyad gnyis pa zhig byas nas/ de'i phyogs su brtag pa'i mtha' de gnyis ma yin pa gzhan zhig ston rgyu yod na legs kyang*/ de med pa'i cha rgyus nga la yod do// zhes bris so// de la shing rag tu/ rtog pa kha tshom gyi don sa lugs pa'i nang du'ang ngos 'dzin mi gcig pa ci rigs snang yang*/ kho bo ni/ dran 'gyu'i rtog pa mngon 'gyur ba 'gag pa tsam la/ rig pa'i dwangs cha ma shar ba/ dpe gnyid 'thug po dang mtshungs pa'i mi rtogs sam 'thug po zhig la zer/ srid gsum pa'i bsam pa la/ rnam rtog 'gog pa tsam zhig gnas lugs phyag chen yin snyam pa dang*/

dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen dang*/ sa lugs kyi phyag chen yi ge med pa sogs la khyad par med snyam pa yang snang*/ thugs bsam rnal du ma phab pa'i rang skyon te/ zhes bris so// de ni phyogs snga'i gzhung la go ba gang yang ma shar bzhin du/ tshod 'jog gis smras par zad de/ rnam rtog 'gog pa tsam gnas lugs phyag chen yin snyam mkhan 'dug na de ni sog po'i phyogs su bzlog cing bsgyur la/ mi dkar la zhwa nag g.yog mkhan de'i rjes su rdzongs shig/ ༈ des na khyed kyis 'bod mkhan med pa'i lhang lhang kho'i sgrub byed du/ med dgag dang phung po rnam dpyad sogs smras pa ni/ dgos med byung rgyal du shor ba kho na'o// mchod rten drung thob dang yi ge med pa'i don tshul bzhin du go ba dag gi ngor/ de dag dkar brgyud kyi dgongs pa dang gcig tu babs kyang*/ spyang ku'i hab skad sbre rtses mi go bas mu kha bhe sha /do ha sogs kyi gzhung rnams nged phyag rgya chen po bas legs par bslabs shing legs par shes pa yin pas/ mdzo bdag gi mdun du mdzo rgyus 'chad pa la ma rings shig/ ༈ rab dbyer/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ sogs la/ gan mdzod pas dgag pa byas pa'i lan/ mgo sgre ba'i tshul du rje klu sgrub pas gsungs pa la/ srid gsum du/ dgag pa mang du byas pa rnams/ tshig ro mang la don nyung bar snang mod/ zhes shing rag pas zer ro// skabs 'di la sogs pa'i gong 'og mang por/ srid gsum du smras pa mang po zom la skyur nas lan med du bzhag 'ga' zhig gi thad du tshig mang la don nyung zer ba dang*/ tshig ro mang zer ba sogs lan thebs par dka' ba'i sgrib zol du rdzun gyi yol bar rim pa mang po sbrel zhing bris te rnam par mi 'tshams pa'i gtam gyis/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la mtho 'tshams par snang gis/ dgos med kyi tshig skam nus med kyi tshig 'dug na 'di dang 'di zhes smos shig dang lan gdab par bya'o//

༈ shing rag gi 'phro de las/ srid gsum du/ blun pos phyag chen sgom pa'i rgyu gcig pu las/ 'bras bu dud 'gro'am/ gzugs med dam/ 'gog pa'am/ dbu ma'i sgom gang rung 'byung ba ste/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung bar bshad la/ khyed kyis dper bkod pa de la/ stong nyid la blta ma shes na/ shes rab chung ba rnams phung zhes pa tsam las ma byung bas/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu rigs gcig pa 'byung*/ zhes sogs bris kyang*/ ma dgongs pa ste/ 'bras bu gcig kho na yin na/ shes rab chung ba rnams zhes rnams kyi mang tshig smos pa dgos med du cis ma song*/ zhes smras te/ khyed rang gsungs pa bzhin ma dgongs pa yin nyen 'dug rnams zhes mang tshig gi sbyor bas de yin tshe/ dbu ma'i sgom du lhung ba de yang phung ba yin nam/ rab dbyer/ dbu ma'i sgom de bzang mod kyis// zhes bzang por bshad pa la/ khyed kyi phung pa dang ngan par 'jog pa ci/ gzhan yang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la mnyam par 'jog pa'i dbu ma'i sgom de ni/ dam chos kun gyi yang snying yin la/ de ltar du smra ba de yang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dam pa yin pa la phung ba'i gral du ci'i phyir 'jog soms la/ de nas gzhung 'chad par gyis shig/ ༈ shing rag tu/ stong nyid bsgoms kyang sgom ma shes na/ rkyen gyi bye brag gis 'bras bu ngan pa ci rigs su 'gyur te/ sogs mang du bris so// 'o na/ nged kyi srid gsum du mtshungs 'dra bkod pa bzhin/ nas kyi sa bon btab kyang 'debs ma shes na/ rkyen gyi bye brag gis 'bras bu ngan pa ci rigs su gyur te/ nas kyi sa bon/ lug lud dang phu chu'i rkyen gyi bra bor smin/ rta lud dang gzhung chu'i rkyen gyi sran mar smin/ zhes sogs dang cis mi mtshungs/ klu sgrub kyi lung don ni/ gang gi stong nyid mi shes pas// zhes pa'i stong nyid ni/

sems nyid kyi bzhugs tshul lo// de mi shes pa ni rtsa ba'i ma rig pa/ de nyid rang bzhin med par ma rtogs pas 'khor bar rmongs zhes pa ste/ dkar brgyud pa tsho 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang rig pa'i 'jug ldog la mdzad pas nged dang mthun no// mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ 'jig rten dag dang stong nyid bsgom na yang*// de ni bdag tu 'du shes 'jig mi 'gyur// zhes dpe rul rnams su tshig dag par 'ong yang*/ dpe ma rul ba'i gser chos kha cig tu khyed gsungs pa ltar yod srid pas 'gyur bcos 'phral du mdzad lags sam/ de ltar bas na/ de'i thad du kho bos mtha' dpyad dang dgongs pa 'grel tshul rnam dbye rgyas pa srid gsum rnam rgyal du bkod pa de ni gzur gnas rnam dpyod kyi spyan 'byed pa'i gser thur mar sbrang gis byugs pa'o// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ 'brug phyogs pas theg pa chen po so skye ba'i skabs bden gnyis so sor bzhag pa dang*/ rje klu sgrub kyis theg chen skabs su/ bden gnyis khas len pa de srid du/ dbyer med du khas len gsungs te/ phyogs gnyis ka dgag sgrub mdzad pa ni/ drang po smras na/ 'brug pas/ theg chen so skye rgyud tshod song tshod kyi grub mtha' bzhag klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ sgra rtog rlom tshod kyi grub mtha' bzhag pas/ phyogs gnyis ka la phan gnod mi snang la/ zhes sogs bris kyang*/ khyed drang po dang*/ thugs tshad dang*/ gzu bo mkhyen pa'i rigs de min 'dra bas drang gtam mi zhu la/ gan mdzod dang*/ rtsod spong du bshad pa rnams srid gsum gyi bkral ba de kas 'thus par yod/ ༈ yang rtsod spong dang*/ shing rag tu/ sgom mnyam 'jog pa'i lugs mkhas pas zer mi rigs zhus pa dang*/ rnam rtog chos skur smra ba'i glen sgom 'di dag ces sogs kha ngan mang du zer mod/ glen sgom dang spyang sgom gang yin yang 'dra/ kho bos srid gsum du/ mdo sde mang po dang*/

rgyud sde mang po dang*/ grub brnyes kyi gzhung mang po'i lung drangs nas/ gnas tshul la/ gnyis chos thams cad ro mnyam du gcig pa'i legs bshad kyi gter kha phye ba la/ mdo tshig 'di'i dgongs pa ni 'di'o zhes re re nas lan gyis bzlog par ma nus pa'i zol du/ tshig mang la don nyung zer mod/ tshig don mang nyung ci yin kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs dang thugs kyi dgongs pa yin par gda'o// 'khor 'das srid zhi/ bden gnyis sogs phan tshul 'gal ba ltar lta ba'i skabs yod mod kyang*/ de'i rgyas 'gebs rnal 'byor gyi stobs rgyas pa'i nus pas/ spang gnyen gyi rnam pa med par gnyis med ye shes kyi rnam rol du bshad pa'i skabs la sbyar ba 'di 'dra la lham dpe zhwar bkab pa dang*/ lkug ma'i rigs 'dre sogs kyis ming 'dogs pa lags/ gang ltar 'di thad du lung rigs ji snyed cig smra rgyu yod kyang*/ ?mi shes pa'i rmongs pa tshul chen bstan par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang du blangs shing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ltung bdun pas 'jigs te ma spros so// ༈ shing rag gi stong sgra las/ rnam rtog chos skur 'dod pa rnams la kho bo'i rigs pa 'di ni gnam lcags kyi thog lta bu cis ma yin zer ba 'di ni/ kho bo'i lung rigs kyi nyi ma legs par shar ba'i 'od zer 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i mdun du/ log smra'i mun sprul gyis sdod ma tshugs pa'i zol sgrib spyi brtol tsam du/ mi shes pa dag gi ngor rbad rbad byas par mngon no// dpal ldan sa skya pa la ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ 'di lta bu'i rjes 'jug kyang 'byung bar dgongs nas chos kyi rjes/ gting nas nyams pa'i khrel 'das 'ga'// rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor 'khyer// kañtsa'i yul gyi rgyal rigs 'ga'// pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga brdung*// zhes pa'i lung bstan gyis zin pa'i skyes bu ngo mtshar che/ lo tsā ba byang grags sogs la'ang don med du bsnyon nas ci mdzad/

khyad par sems dpa' chen po chos rdzong pa ma ṇi 'dren pa la gze ma ra mgo mi 'dzug pa zhu// ༈ shing rag tu/ kha cig dkar po chig thub las// 'bras bu sku gsum 'byung zhes zer// zhes sogs la/ 'brug pas dgag pa byas pa'i lan/ mgo bsgre'i tshul gyis// rje klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa la/ srid gsum du/ gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// ces pa'i du yig ni/ rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi'i don te/ zhes sogs bris pa ni/ 'ben ngos ma zin pa'i mda' ste/ klu sgrub rgya mtshos ni/ gang du yang ni mi rnyed pa'i/ mi shes pa'i ming can de dang*/ 'og tu/ rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes shes pa'i ming can de gnyis don mi 'gal yang*/ tshig 'gal la/ snyan ngag pa'i 'gal rgyan lta bu de la/ mgo bsgre bar mdzad pa yin gyi/ du yig rnam dbye bdun pa dang*/ las yig rnam dbye lnga pa la dpyad pa ma yin pas/ rtsod pa'i shugs bskyed kyang 'ben la phog pa'i rigs can ma yin pa'o// zhes pa ni zhal cung zad 'tshal to// rje gser pa'i rtsod spong du/ rgyud lung de'i bstan don spyir btang dmigs bsal du brjod kyi/ de bzhin du khyed kyis kyang snyed ces dang*/ mi shes zhes pa spyir btang dmigs bsal du mdzad e nus/ mi shes pa'i ming can dang*/ shes pa'i ming can de gnyis don mi 'gal zer ba byas 'dug pa/ de ltar na/ gong du khyed rang gis rnam rtog chos sku bkag pa'i dus su/ bslu ba yang mi bslu ba/ kun rdzob kyang don dam/ mi bden pa yang bden pa/ dri bcas kyang dri bral yin pa sogs mi rigs rgyu'i 'o ro kha re re rgyab pa rnams dang 'di la khyad par ci zhig yod de/ shes pa dang mi shes pa don gcig na/ bslu ba dang mi bslu ba don ci'i phyir mi gcig mtshan nyid pa'i dngos 'gal dang sngags pa'i dam tshig 'di bsrung dgos pa rang cig lags so// ji skad du/ pha rol blun por 'dug na yang mi srong*// mkhas pa yin na rigs pa'i lam drang por// dgag dang rang lugs bzhag ste rtsod pa spong*/

?/smra ba'i mgrin nas dgos pa yin ces gsungs pa ltar/ rje gser pa de'ang tshig rkang gnyis pas bstan pa bzhin yin grang snyam pa dang*/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i rgya dpe gnyis tsam mthong ba la'ang*/ 'di thad du rnam dbye la rus 'don mdzad 'dug pa ltar zhus pa yin te/ da ko mkhan snga phyi gnyis ka tshig rkang dang po'i bstan don du dang blangs kyis phebs pa la/ rnam dbye sogs kyi mda' 'phen 'os min pa thugs bden gyis bdag gi nongs par gzung du gsol// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ de la 'di skad ces zer te mdo yi gleng gzhi'i 'gyur la 'gyur nyes so// zhes bris pa ni/ rgya gzhung rnams la spyir btang dang dmigs bsal gyi dbang gis/ gong 'og mi mthun pa lta bu dang*/ tshig gi go rim dang*/ 'bru don gyi go rim/ go ba blangs dgos pa shin tu mang bar yod pa rnams ma go bar/ tshig tsam la a 'thas su byed pa'i rnam dpyod shin tu gu dog po des lan te/ lo tsā ba ka cog la sogs pa gangs ri'i zhing 'dir/ ston pa sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad med pa de dag la 'gyur nyes so// zhes 'phyas 'dog par snang bas kho bo ni cang mi smra ste/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas tshig gsal du/ kho bo cag gi smyon pa dang lhan cig tu rtsod pa yang ma yin no// zhes bshad pa bzhin no// zer ro/ kho bos ni/ srid gsum du/ rgya dpe thad sgrigs ltar bsgyur na/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes sogs 'ongs kyang*/ de 'gyur mi bde zhing zer ba byas pa la skyon ci zhig yod/ ka cog gi dus bsgyur ba'i mdo 'grel mang po la/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi dus lo tsā ba ye shes sde sogs kyis 'gyur skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ phyin chad kyang dam pa'i chos bsgyur tshul gyi bca' yig sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa sogs/ mdzod nag po thung ba de 'gyur sngon mas cung ma 'thus pa'i skad du 'dug cing*/

des kyang ma chog par/ lo chen rin chen bzang po dang*/ rngog lo chen lo tsā ba phyi ma du mas 'gyur bcos shing*/ phyis kyang*/ yar klung ba grags rgyal dang*/ chag khu dbon dang*/ thar lo bu ston sogs kyis kyang de thog tu bcos mang po mdzad cing*/ rgyud sde la'ang*/ dper na dus 'khor la deng sang man chad du 'gyur mdzad nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam byung ba las/ gzhi 'gyur las 'gyur bcos ches mang snang zhing*/ lhag par tshig la a 'thas su byed pa chos kyi rje sa paṇa gyis/ kha che paṇa chen dpon slob dang lhan cig tu/ sngar 'gyur zin gyi gzhung bshad mang po la 'gyur bcos kyi sgo nas gtan la phab cing*/ don 'grel bzang du btang ba yin kyang*/ lo tsā ba sngon mas 'gyur ma bde ba rnams phyin chad 'di ltar bsgyur dgos tshul gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa ji tsam 'dug ma gzigs sam/ gzigs pa zhig na snga ma'i 'gyur de cung ma bde ba rnams phyi ma tshos 'gyur ba de dag la dad pa sgom pa lags/ khyed cang mi smra bar bzhugs na lta chos sde chen po'i dbu 'don zhabs 'degs su 'gro zhing*/ blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes// zhes gdams pa la'ang nyan par 'gro ba gda' ste de ka ma mdzad pa'i skyon cung zad gda'o// nyid rang gis byang phyogs kyi smyon pa klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan du mtshan btags 'dug pa/ ma smyo na ni mtshan de 'dras ci rang mdzad/ smyo nges shes pa yin tshe tshig gsal gyi lung de kho bo'i mgrin pa las kyang rgyu bas soms/ ༈ shing rag tu/ rje 'brug pa dang srid gsum mkhan po gnyis kyi dpyad pa mang du bris kyang*/ sdom gsum gyi dgongs pa ma shes pa dgag pa spyi brtol du byas shing*/ rje klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ 'di skabs na rab dbye'i dgongs don sgra ji bzhin ma mkhyen par cung zad 'khyog pa zhig snang bas 'dir snying po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta'i dgongs pa gzhungs bsrangs na/ 'di skad ces/ kha cig dkar po chig thub las// 'bras bu sku gsum 'byung zhes zer// zhes phyogs snga brjod nas de 'gog pa ni/

dkar po chig thub ces bya ba/ thabs shes yan gar ba'i rgyu gcig las/ 'bras bu yon tan gyi tshogs gang yang 'byung ba mi srid/ ces spyir btang gi tshul du ston pa la/ gcig las 'bras bu 'byung mi srid// ces so// gal te'am/ ci ste de las 'bras bu zhig 'byung yang*/ nyan thos 'gog pa bzhin du shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i 'bras bu'i yon tan nyi tshe ba'i yan lag gcig 'byung gis/ 'bras bu sku gsum mi 'byung ngo*// zhes ston pa la/ gal te gcig las 'bras bu gcig /byung yang nyan thos 'gog pa bzhin// 'bras bu de yang gcig tu 'gyur// zhes bshad pa ni dmigs bsal lo// zhes 'dzer to// dkar brgyud pas zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po la dkar po chig thub tu ngos gzung ba la/ thabs shes yan gar ba'i rgyu gcig las/ zhes sogs bkod pa ni rgod bro ste/ zung 'jug de thabs shes yan gar ba yin nam ci phyogs snga ma longs pa ni de rigs la zer ro// yang*/ gcig las 'bras bu mi 'byung bar bshad pa spyir btang dang*/ gcig las 'bras bu 'byung bar bshad pa dmigs bsal yin/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya sogs spyir btang dmigs bsal mang por bshad pa'i skabs rnams su/ spyir btang la mtha' ma bcad par 'jog pa sha stag 'ongs 'dug pa dper na/ gcig las 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs na bden du chugs kyang*/ 'dir gcig las 'bras bu 'byung mi srid/ ces bcad pas na spyir btang dmigs bsal ma yin pa grub pas/ rje klu sgrub pas ma mkhyen pa'i legs bshad khyed kyi smra rgyu zhal bzhes bzang yang che bgres chen mo ka cung drag par go lags/ ༈ shing rag tu/ sdom gsum gyi ṭik+kā mang por snang yang*/ gzhung 'di dag gi go ba mthil phyin ma shes par 'phyang mo nyug mang la/ snying po ni/ 'di skabs kyi rgyu 'bras rnams/ 'thob bya thob byed kyi rgyu 'bras tsam yin gyis/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras ma yin/

gnad de go na/ rtsod pa'i ngal ba thams cad ci bder bzhag chog ces gu yangs dpe med yin rgyur smras mod/ sdom gsum gyi ṭik+kā mdzad mkhan mang po'i brgyud 'dzin da lta yang gra rgyas par gda' yi/ khyed kyis gsung de la khong rnams nyan na lta/ rtsod pa ci bde bar 'jog chog kyang khong tshos gang zer ci shes/ ༈ srid gsum du/ nyan thos 'gog pa'i ngos 'dzin kyang*/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa la bzhed na ni/ 'bras bu gcig kyang mi 'byin pas mtshungs pa brjod du med la/ nyan thos slob mi slob kyi 'gog pa la sbyor na/ de dag stong rkyang bsgoms pa las 'byung bar bshad pa'i khungs gang na bdog ces sogs bkod pa la shing rag tu/ phyis kyi sa skya pa rnams/ yang na nyan thos 'gog pa lta bu/ zhes pa de/ nyan thos slob mi slob kyi 'gog pa gang yang ma yin par/ chad pa'i stong pa rgya yan zhig la nyan thos 'gog pa'i ming 'dogs par bshad pa mang du byung mod/ rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa de ltar ma yin te/ zhes rje btsun rtse mo'i gsung dang bcas pa drangs nas/ skabs 'di'i 'gog pa nyan thos dgra bcom la 'jog ces pa ni brtag par bya ba'i gnas so// ༈ srid gsum du/ nyan thos slob mi slob kyi 'gog pa la sbyor na/ de dag stong rkyang bsgoms pa las 'byung bar bshad pa'i khungs gang na bdog ces bris pa la/ khyed kyis/ de'i khungs ni rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ thabs dang mi ldan shes rab dang*// bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni// dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams// de la gzhug pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes pa 'di yan theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud thams cad du/ nyan thos la dgag cing*/ dmad pa'i tshig kho na gsungs pa thams cad 'di'i dpung gnyen no// zhes bris so// rnam snang mngon byang gi lung khyed kyis drangs pa ni tshig ma dag ste/ dpe cha ma rul ba gsar bcos la gzigs pa'i skyon no// ji ltar ma dag snyam na sngon gyi dpe rul dag pa tsho na/

thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*// zhes 'byung gi shes rab ces pa med/ dpa' bo chen po zhes 'byung gi chen pos zhes pa med cing*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas kyang de bzhin du bkral lo// khyed kyis thugs bshad la/ thabs bral gyi shes rab rkyang pa de gsungs pa ni/ dpa' bo chen po shākya thub pas nyan thos rnams 'gog pa'i dgra bcom de la 'jug pa'i phyir gsungs so snyam pa'o// de ni mi rigs te/ bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni// zhes pa'i bslab pa de thabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*// zhes pa'i don gang yin na// theg chen gyi mdo rgyud rnams su gsungs pa bzhin gyi thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer med pa'i ye shes de la ldan pa'i sgra don tshang pa de 'dir med pa'i don yin gyis gzhan du mi bsam mo// de la gzud pa'i phyir zhes sam/ de la gzhug pa'i phyir zhes pa'i snyeg pa yang tshigs bcad de'i gong de ma thag tu/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la// bslab nas bla med byang chub ni// 'dus ma byas pa de thob bo// zhes gsungs pa de nyid yin pas/ de la zhes pa bla na med pa'i byang chub la snyegs par lhun gyis grub/ de lta na grub don/ dpa' bo chen po zhes pa'i skabs su 'brel pa med pa'i tshig snang na/ de ni bod sgra yin zhes bshad pa ltar rgyud zhu mos la bod nas nyan thos rnams bla med byang chub tu rim gyis zhugs pa'i phyir du thabs tha dad kyi lam dang bslab pa'i rim pa dang por gsungs zhes pa'i don du song bas na/ khyed kyi lung khungs su drangs kyang slebs pa med do// yid ma ches na rgya 'grel la gzigs shig de lta ma yin na/ sems can sangs rgyas kyis bslus par yang 'gyur te/ thabs dang mi ldan pa'i shes rab stong rkyang gcig la kha drangs nas/ mthar nyan thos 'gog pa zhig la sbyar bas so// de la skyon ci yod snyam na/

khyed rang gis theg chen gyi mdo rgyud thams cad du nyan thos la dgag cing dmad par khas blangs shing*/ stong nyid sgom ma shes pa'i gol sar yang bshad pa'i phyir ro// ༈ srid gsum du/ stes dbang gis dmyal bar skye yang srid na 'gog pa kho nas ci nyes sogs bkod pa la shing rag tu/ rang nyid theg pa dman pa la zhen nas theg chen gyi gtam khong du ma shong ba'i rnam 'gyur te/ theg pa chen po mchog gi skabs 'dir nyan thos dang dmyal ba gnyis la ltos te/ dmyal ba'i lus rten la bsngags shing*/ nyan thos la shin tu dmad pa'i tshig nyid gsungs/ zhes sogs tshig rtsa ma zin pa'i tshig nyog byung rgyal du smras so// nged kyis nyan thos 'gog pa bzang*/ dmyal ba ngan zer na/ khyed kyi lung rigs 'jug sgo 'ong srid na'ang*/ de 'dra ma smras pas lung 'dren de rnams spyir btang don dang tshig 'bru bzang yang*/ rtsod pa 'di la phan gnod spu tsam yang med pas gtam byung rgyal du smra ba la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa tsam mo// 'on kyang*/ rang gzhan gyi lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa phal cher/ dmad lugs dang rdzun gyis bdag bstod yang yang 'dzems med smras/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams las 'da' lugs dang*/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnam la bstod ra che lugs kyis/ rten 'brel ci 'dra 'grigs things dka' ba zhig snang ngo*// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// zhes pa dang*/ gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do// zhes pa'i gcig pu zhes pa gtso che ba'i don yin/ zhes rje klu sgrub pas gsungs pa rnams 'khor 'das kyi gnas so sor 'phro ba la/ grogs kyi rkyen ci yang mi dgos pa sems gcig pus 'khor 'das su 'gro snyam pa'i log rtog skye ba'i skabs srid pas/ de bzlog pa'i phyir/ mtha' gzhan bkag pa'i rigs pa dang mthun par gsungs pas/ skyon du mi 'gyur la/ zhes zer mod/

de 'dra skyon du los 'gyur te/ rtsod spong du/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa la grogs las nyon/ 'tshang rgya ba la grogs lta sgom spyod pa rnams sems ma yin pa'i khul du smras 'dug pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung rnams su yang 'khor 'das thams cad sems yin par khas blangs na theg pa mchog 'di las nyan thos lta sgom sogs sems min par smra na de las skyon che ba gang zhig yod/ yang khyed kyis/ don la brten pa'i tshe/ gzhi gshis kyi sems nyid gcig pu 'di nyid 'khor 'das thams cad kyi sa bon yin par kho bo cag 'dod de/ zhes brtag gnyis sogs kyi lung dang bcas bshad pa ni de de bzhin no// zhes gsol to// ༈ srid gsum du/ sems nyid gcig pu gang las/ ma shes na srid pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag 'phro bar 'gyur la/ zhes bris pa ni dpyad na mi bden te/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin yongs su ma shes pa las srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'phro bar 'gyur gyi/ mi shes pa'i grogs med par/ sems nyid gcig pu kho rang las srid pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ gal te ma shes na zhes smras so snyam na/ de tsam gyis go mi chod de/ gang las zhes pa'i tshig bton na rung mod kyi/ de ltar ma byung bas go don nus med du song zhes zer ro// skabs 'dir sems nyid dang rdzas tha dad du gyur pa'i chos khas mi len pas na/ 'ching grol kun gyi gzhi sems nyid gcig pur grub la de yang*/ bdag gam/ rang ngam/ nga zhes pa 'di rang gis rang yongs su shes sam mthong na rnam par grol ba dang*/ de ngo ma shes na 'ching ba la dgongs nas/ do ha zer ba'i dpe hrul der/ nga mthong bas ni grol 'gyur te// nga ma mthong bas 'ching bar 'gyur// zer ba byas gda'/ kho bo'i tshig nus med du cis kyang sgrub par bzhed na/ khyed la de'i sgrub byed kyi lung rigs med kyi/ srid gsum pa'i tshig nus med du 'gro bar gyur cig ces bsngo ba dang*/

smon lam mdzad par zhu/ srid gsum du/ de phan rkyen/ nyid sgra sbyor ma sbyor gyi lab brjod skor rnams/ sems 'od gsal dag pa gangs kyi ri// zhes pa'i skabs su rgyas par smras zin pa de khas/ nyid sgra sbyor ba dang mi sbyor ba'i rnam dbye phu grol mda' grol du btang yod lags pas/ de yi zla skyor dgos pa med lags// ༈ gan mdzod du/ mdo lugs la yang mi 'thad de/ zhes sogs kyi lan rje klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa la/ srid gsum du lan cung zad smras pa des/ shing rag tu mi 'thad pa'i ku co dpe med bsgrags pa 'di la/ lan nyung ngus don mi phigs pas/ shing gi rang 'thag cha tshang lung rigs me dpung 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab pa'i cho ga slad kyi bri bar bya yi ngang ma thung zhig/ ༈ rab dbyer/ kha cig chig thub bsgoms pa yi// rjes la bsngo ba bya dgos zer// 'o na chig thub gnyis su 'gyur// zhes sogs bshad pa la/ srid gsum du/ rjes su byed pa'i bsngo ba de yang zung 'jug la chig thub tu btags pa de ka yin pas chig thub gnyis su 'gyur ba'i skyon med/ sngon du byed rgyu'i sems bskyed sogs kyang zung 'jug la chig thub tu btags pa de ka yin pas chig thub du mar 'gyur ba'i skyon med de/ bu ram la dbyibs mi gcig pa lnga bzos kyang*/ thams cad kyang ro mngar ba'i ngo bor gcig pa bzhin no// zhes sogs go bde khyer bde'i dpe dang bcas bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ 'di dpyad na mi 'thad de/ dngos gzhi yang chig thub/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems/ rjes bsngo ba yang chig thub yin na/ sngon 'gro las logs su dngos gzhi dang de las logs su rjes zhes bshad pa dgos med du song*/ rgyu mtshan/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes thams cad chig thub gcig yin par khyed kyis smras so// 'gog byed rig pa'i snying po ni/ chig thub la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi byed pa mi 'thad de/ chig thub ni 'dus ma byas yin la 'dus ma byas la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i tha snyad nam yang byed mi rung ba'i phyir ces pa ste/

chig thub rang 'dus ma byas yin pas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi dbyer med kyang*/ sogs bris so// 'o na/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ zer yang mi rung bar 'gyur te/ gsum ka dge ba'i ngo bor gcig pas dang por dge ba las logs su gyur pa'i bar du dge ba dang*/ bar du dge ba las logs su gyur pa'i tha mar dge ba mi dgos pa'i phyir/ yang*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga zhes bya ba yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ rnam snang nas don 'grub kyi bar lnga ka rkyal ba'i ngo bor gcig pas/ rnam snang las logs su gyur pa'i mi bskyod pa dang*/ de las logs su gyur pa'i rin 'byung sogs tha dad du mi dgos pa'i phyir/ yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa thams cad zag pa med pa 'ba' zhig yin na/ zag med kyi chos la sde tshan du mar byas nas ci bya/ de lta bas na/ zung 'jug de ka gnas skabs kyi dbye bas de ltar byas pa yin/ rgyud las/ rigs ni lnga po 'di nyid las// stong phrag tu ni skye ba nyid// de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig /bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid// 'dod chags la sogs sems lnga yis// phye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes mthar thug ltar bshad pa dang mtshungs so// 'di lta bu thugs su mi shong ba de ka stong pa nyid kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis skrag par 'gyur pa'i lo rgyus gong du khyed rang gis bris pa lta bu'i mtshan gzhir 'di 'dra ba bzung zhig/ ༈ srid gsum du/ stong nyid de med dgag zhig la thugs rtse gtad pa 'dra yang*/ zhes sogs cung zad smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ sa skya pas stong nyid med dgag tu khas blangs snyam mod/ ces sogs med dgag tu khas ma blangs pa'i shes byed mdzad 'dug pa de ltar na legs mod/ kho bos ni/ thub pas stong nyid bsngags pa ni// dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog phyir yin// zhes pa'i skabs su/ lugs 'dzin 'ga' zhig gi gsung thos nas/

thugs gtad yod pa 'dra yang zhes the tshom gyis smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ stong nyid don dam sems bskyed ma yin zhes dang*/ 'brug pas/ de de yin par smras pas ma mthun mod/ 'brug pa ni/ sems bskyed ces pa'i ming tsam la yang rmongs pa ste/ sems bskyed ces pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi bzhed pa sems byung dang*/ seng ge bzang po'i 'dod pa sems yin la/ stong nyid ni sems sems byung gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs smras so// ji ltar blangs pa'i sems bskyed sems pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems yul khyad par can du snang bar skye bas/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba zhes gsungs kyi/ sems byung du ston pa'i phyir ni ma yin la/ de bas na mkhas pa dbyig gnyen gyis sems bskyed sems byung du 'dod zer ba yang*/ de'i mdo sde rgyan 'grel la brtags na mi bden par go nus so// klu sgrub kyi lung de dang*/ gzhan yang rim lngar/ thog ma tha ma med zhi ba// dngos dang dngos med zab khyab bdag /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas// byang chub sems zhes bya bar dran// zhes don dam byang sems dang por gzung*/ de so sor rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis rang dbang du byed pa ni bskyed pa ste don du de nyid mnyam par bzhag pas 'gal ba med lags pas 'brug pa dpon slob kyi rtsod tshig rjes med du song ngo snyam na yang mi 'gro bar gda'o// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ gnad de dag ma go bar/ bod kyi mkhas pa mang po zhig dang*/ rang lugs kyi'ang*/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba la sogs pa'i dbu ma'i yig char 'chal te gti thug mang du bris pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bstod tshig gi gzhung rnams dang byang chub sems 'grel/ gsang 'dus rim lnga/ 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me/ gzhan yang bdag byin brlabs/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong sogs la ma gzigs pa'i skyon du snang mod/ rgyas par gzhan du 'chad do// zhes smras so// mkhas pa spyi la sdang smras byed pa ni/

nyid rang gi khyad chos su 'dug pas bya thabs gang yod/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba zhes bka' bkyon gnang yul de/ rang lugs kyi zhes dang*/ dbu ma'i yig cha zer lugs sogs gang sa nas rjes su dpags na/ khyed rang bla ma mkhan byams phrug pa la zer rgyu yin pa 'dra/ de lta yin tshe/ ji skad du/ dam tshig klog pa sbyin pa dang*// 'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang*// dbang bskur ba dang las byed dang*// de rnams slob dpon zhes bshad do// zhes drug byung ba phal cher khong la tshang ba 'dra bas/ dper na thub pa'i skyes rabs las/ byas mi bzod la phan pa dang*// gya gyu dag la yid gcugs dang*// ngan pa rnams la gdams ngag ni// byed po'i skyon ni 'ba' zhig yin// ces pa ltar phan 'dogs pa po'i skyon du rtsi na ma gtogs/ gzhan ni lugs gnyis ka nas bka' drin chen pos bskyangs pa'i bla ma zhig yin tshul rags pa kho bos kyang thos kyi/ khyed kyis klu sgrub kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa'i sbad gog tsho bden na/ de nyid kyis/ byas pa shes shing byas pa bzo// byas pa chud zos mi gtong ba'i// mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas// zhes pa dang mi 'gal lam/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang bcas par/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul ji snyed bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam/ lhag par/ rab dbyer/ bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing gsungs pa la/ khyed kyi gze ma ra mgo ltar na/ gong ma lnga rdzogs mtshams nas/ khyed rang gi bar la bla ma rmongs pa kha 'chal bong sha'i mgo tsam smra ba'i blun po 'ba' zhig byung bar smras 'dug pa bden na ni/ bla ma brgyud pa nyams par e 'gro soms dang*/ gsung rab las bshad pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid kun ldan cig yin na ni/ des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ zhes pa ltar yin pas kha 'chal 'ong don ga la yod/ gal te skyon ltar snang ba cung zad mthong na'ang*/ ji skad du/ bla ma'i yon tan gzung bya zhing*// skyon ni nam yang gzung ma yin// ces gsungs pa ltar btang snyoms tsam du 'jog mi dgos sam/

gzhan ni lnga bcu par/ de 'dra'i mgon la bsams byas nas// slob mar gyur nas brnyas na ni// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na// des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob// ces pa nas/ gdon dang log 'dren rnams kyis kyang*// bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro// ces pa'i bar du gsungs pa'i nyes pa la bsam nas shin tu 'jigs par rigs te/ de lta bu la/ la stod lho tshom ni ji 'dra'ang byas so 'ba' zer gyin gda'/ ༈ yang*/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba de khyed rang tsho'i grwa pa gzhan dkyus ma zhig yin na cung drag kyang*/ 'chal gtam smra ba dang*/ de la gshe ba gnyis ka 'bras 'brang khams zhes pa'i brda rnying yin nam snyam mi gtsang bas btang snyoms su zhog cig/ ༈ gan mdzod du/ gshis lugs kyi dge ba bshad pa 'di 'thad na/ chos mngon pa'i glegs bam rgyab tu skyur rigs/ zhes bris pa'i ngan rgyab srid gsum du don lhag po med par tshig rtsub mang du smras zer/ tshig rtsub cung zad kyang smra dbang med pa ci yin/ tshig rtsub thams cad khyed kyi bgo skal du thob pa lags sam/ don 'bras/ mkhan chen gser pas/ mngon pa 'og mar so sor brtag 'gog don dam pa'i dge bar byas nas/ des dge ba'i go chod pa dang*/ mngon pa gong mar/ de bzhin nyid la don dam pa'i dge bar byas nas dge ba'i go chod pa dang*/ klu sgrub lugs la/ chos dbyings sogs 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba khas mi len pa'i lugs so sor yod pa las/ kho bo cag klu sgrub kyi lugs de khas len pa'i phyir dang*/ zhes smras pa la/ srid gsum du/ mngon pa gong 'og tu gshis lugs kyi dge ba go chod yod par khyed rang gis bshad la/ klu sgrub sogs 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba khas mi len pa'i rjes su khyed kyis zhugs phyin/ lugs srol so sor 'byed pa'i zol gyis/ chos mngon pa'i glegs bam gnyis ka sku rgyab tu sgob sgra dang bcas skyur ba der gda'o// zhes smras pa'i rigs pa 'di 'dra ma zlog pa'i zol la tshig rtsub smras zhes 'dzer te/

khyed kyis shing rag tu/ rang gzhan gyi mkhas pa phal cher la/ de ni rmongs pa ste/ de ni 'chal gtam ste/ de ni ma shes pa ste/ zhes sogs/ ji snyed smras pa rnams tshig 'jam du byas/ nged kyis rigs tshul rnam dag gi sgo nas tshig nyams dod pos zhe sa phul ba tshig rtsub tu byed pa 'di lta bu ni blo tshad thugs rgyud la 'char ma myong ba'i rang nyams so// yid la 'khon du dam bzung nas// kha nas tshig 'jam smra'o zhes// zhes gong du khyed kyis drangs nas/ nged la dmad pa dang dngos 'gal yang ma yin nam// ༈ yang shing rag bskor ba'i stong sgra las/ thub pa dgongs gsal du/ hwa shang gi lo rgyu zur tsam gsungs pa la/ 'brug pas lo rgyus de ma dag ces dang*/ khyad par srid gsum du/ lo rgyus de la ma dag pa ci dang ci snang ba smros shig ce na/ de bzhin du bya ste/ thog mar rba dang*/ dba' zhes pa don gcig pa la/ brda' gsar rnying gis btags pa ma go bar tha dad du phye ba 'di ma dag ces sogs ma dag pa dgu tshar cig bris so// de'i lan shing rag tu/ sa lugs pa phal cher/ rba bzhed 'ba' bzhed so sor yod dam snyam pa'i tshod 'jog tsam zhig gis grub mtha' u tshugs skyong mod/ kho bo ni rba dang dba' gsar rnying yin pa bden zhing*/ thub pa dgongs gsal na par yig ma dag pa gzhan yang snang ba dang*/ zhes sogs/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa da res drang por smras 'dug pas slar rtsad ma dgos// ༈ yang*/ srid gsum du/ rab dbyer/ zhi 'tshos rgyal po la dngos su lung bstan pa dang*/ thub dgongs su ye shes dbang po la dris par bshad pa gnyis ma mthun pas gang rung cig ma dag ces smras pa'i lan/ shing rag tu/ dang por zhi 'tshos rgyal po la lung bstan pa bden yang*/ slar rgyal po the tshom du gyur nas ye shes dbang po la dris pas/ 'di ni sngon lung bstan pa de yin pas ka ma la shī la spyan 'dren par rigs so// zhes smras pa yin zer ba'i 'gal spang de ka yin pas legs 'dug/

༈ yang srid gsum du/ chos 'byung rnying ma dang*/ sgom rim du/ dkar po chig thub kyi 'phros tsam yang med pa la/ thub dgongs su/ rgya nag dge slong na re/ sems dkar po chig thub yin par smra zhes sgro btags pas ma dag ces pa'i lan/ shing rag tu/ bka' chems kyi yi ge bsre bslad yod med sna tshogs yod pas/ dpe kha cig tu dkar po chig thub kyi ming ma smos pa tsam shes byed du ga la rung*/ zhes smras te/ bsres pa dang bslad pa ni sngar gyi thog tu gzhan bsnan pa'i ming yin pas dkar po chig thub kyi ming bsres pa ma dag ma bsres pa de nyid dag pas de nyid gtan tshigs su bya'o// ༈ de'i 'phros kyi shing rag tu/ sgom rim gtsang ma las dkar po chig thub kyi ming dngos su ma byung yang*/ hwa shang gi phyogs snga brjod pa'i skabs su/ 'di ltar gang dag ci yang mi sems shing ci yang mi byed pas de dag ni 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs drangs nas/ de dkar po chig thub tu sgrub 'dug ste/ des sgom rim du dkar po chig thub sgrub pa ni ha ha ho ho// ༈ yang shing rag 'phros su/ sgom rim du/ hwa shang dang*/ ka ma shī la gnyis kyi dgag sgrub don la brten pa yin gyi/ sngon gyi rtsod yig thams cad tshig zin zhib mor bris pa ma yin pas skyon las grol zhing*/ srid gsum du/ sgom rim gyi gzhung rnams su hwa shang dang ka ma shī la'i rtsod ngag thams cad tshang bar bshad pa'ang 'dis khegs te/ zhes sogs mi 'grigs pa'i dpe dang bcas smras so// nged kyis srid gsum du/ phan tshun gyi rtsod ngag thams cad de gsum ci rigs par tshang ba yin te/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ de ltar legs par gtan phab nas// dpang pos 'dzin du gzhug pa'i phyir// rtsod pa'i ngag rnams bsdus te bsgrags// 'di ni mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs yin// zhes gsungs la/ de yang*/ rang rang gi grub mtha' gzung nas rtsod pa'i ngag 'phen len rnams/

gtam dang bya ba gzhan gyis bar chod pa lta bu'i rkyen gyis don cung zad ma nges pa'am ngag 'thor ba srid pas/ rtsod pa'i mjug thog tu slar go rim bsgrigs nas bstan bcos kyi lus su dril ba 'di lta bu mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs yin par bshad pas so// bsdus te zhes pa'ang*/ sngar rgyas pa zhig phyis bsdus su btang ba lta bu ni ma yin te/ ji skad du/ rang gi gzhung kun las/ btus te sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya// zhes pa lta bu ste/ mkhas mjug gi gzhung de'i rang 'grel las/ de ltar rtsod pa'i dngos gzhi la brgal lan gyi sgo nas dgag sgrub kyi gnas ma 'khrul bar grub mtha'i blang dor rtogs par byas nas/ ngag cung zad 'thor ba rnams tshogs pas go bar bya ba'i phyir bsdus te brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa de tshor da dung thugs rtog chug mdzod dang dgongs mchis/ hwa shang dang slob dpon ka shī rtsod pa'i gzhi/ don rkang gnyis las med la/ de gnyis kyang brgal ba dang ma brgal ba thams cad ni sgom rim du tshang 'dug gzhan rtsod pa'i dus der smras pa'i ngag dang tshig lhad sogs thams cad tshang mi dgos te/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ thams cad 'dus te nyan pa la// ba lang med kyang skyon ma yin// gsungs pa dang 'dra/ de ni don la bsten pas brten go chod pa'i rnam thar yin no// ༈ yang srid gsum du/ rba bzhed gtsang ma dang*/ thub dgongs su/ rgya nag rtsod pa pham 'phral yi ge rnams gter du sbas par bshad pa dang*/ rab dbyer/ phyis rgya nag gi yi ge tsam la brten nas byas par bshad pa 'gal bas gang rung cig ma dag ces pa'i lan shing rag tu/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi tas/ hwa shang gi lo rgyus dang*/ ka ma shī la'i rtsod yig sogs gzigs nas gsungs kyi/ ma gzigs pa'i mi chos bla ma ni des nam yang mi mdzad do// zhes zer ro// rang rang so so'i 'jug sgo'i stabs kyis rtog cing dpyod pa tsam ma gtogs/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid mi dge bcus bsdus pa'i rdzun gsungs pa'i skabs med nges kyang*/

thabs la mkhas pa'i dpyod pa la// g.yo sgyur thub pas gsungs pa med// ces pa ltar dgos pa khyad par ba dang 'brel ba'i gsung ci rigs byon pa la ma dad par ci la rigs/ mi chos bla ma ni spangs rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can gyi ming yin/ de ma thob pa la thob ces smra na mi chos bla ma'i rdzun zer ba lags kyi/ shing rag na/ mi chos bla ma ni des nam yang mi mdzad do// zhes rdzun zer ba cig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang ma byung ba 'di rtsom mkhan 'khrul lam yi ge nor// ༈ shing rag 'phros su/ spyir bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis/ sngon gyi dpe rgyun khyad par can 'ga' zhig da lta mthong yul na dkon te/ 'phags yul gyi dpe rnams kyi lo rgyus dang mtshungs/ des na rang gis ma mthong ba yus su bdar nas gzhan la gshe ba ni dam pa'i lugs ma yin/ hwa shang gi bstan 'chos bstan rgyu med pas ma dag zer ba ni/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min// zer ba der snang ste hwa shang gi bstan 'chos mdo sde brgyad cu pa zhes bya ba de da lta mig mthong ce re dngos su snang bas so// 'di ni 'brug pas/ rgya nag mkhan po'i chos lugs phyis 'phel ba'i gzhung lugs yin na de'i gzhung lugs gar 'phel ston dgos so// zhes sogs dang*/ srid gsum du/ hwa shang gi bstan bcos rnams/ gter ston skyag rdzun gling pas bton na ma gtogs/ gzhan lo rgyus khungs can med zer ba rnams kyang khyed rang dpon slob gzigs rgya chung pa tsam du rtogs nus te/ zhes smras so/ hwa shang gi bstan bcos rnams/ sngon gyi dpe rgyun khyad par can dang*/ 'phags yul gyi dpe dang 'dra mtshungs su bkod nas/ yang de 'gog pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa 'di ni tsha grang bzhin du 'gal/ nged dpon slob gzigs rgya che chung ji ltar yang*/ yod pa mthong zhing med pa mi mthong ba zhig lags kyi/ khyed ni gang zhig yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba// zer ba der gda' bas/

gal te dpe de pa yod pa zhig lags na/ nged kyi 'dod pa hwa shang gi phyogs su 'bul ba ni ches mi rigs te/ nged kyis ma mthong ba'i dpe dang grub mtha' de pa la khyed rang 'dris par khas blangs pa'i phyir// ༈ yang*/ de'i gzhung lugs gar 'phel dris pa la/ mdo sde brgyad cu pa yod zer lan gdab pa de cir gyur soms shig/ ༈ yang srid gsum du/ rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen zer ba tshad ldan las ma bshad ces gzur gnas dag gsung na/ ming gsar 'dogs sgro btags yin pas ma dag ces pa'i lan shing rag tu/ hwa shang gi bstan bcos rnams dang po gter du sbas pa bden yang*/ phyis gter nas thon nas yi ge 'phel bar bshad kyi sogs ni se'u bcu pa'i ngag bzhin dris lan gang yang ma 'brel to// yang na ni khyed rang gi yi ge gong 'og 'khrugs pa'o// ༈ de'i 'phros kyi shing rag tu/ rgya nag gi rdzogs chen yod pa bon lugs kyi rdzogs chen snyan rgyud chig chog chen mo la bltas pas shes te/ de rnams brgyud pa hwa shang la 'ded/ ming rdzogs chen du btags/ zhes sogs so// nged ni rgya gar pa'i dpe hrul lta bas brel nas bon lugs kyi rdzogs chen lta long mi gda' zhing*/ bon lugs kyi rdzogs chen kyi brgyud pa hwa shang la 'ded pa ni ngo mtshar shin tu che ba lags kyi/ de ni gzigs rgya che ba'i phan yon no// ༈ yang srid gsum du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsam gtan gyi gdams ngag 'phags pa 'od srungs la gtad pa nas bzung*/ brgyud pa nyer gcig hwa shang ma hā ya na yin par bshad pa la/ hwa shang gi chos lugs mu stegs las kyang lod par rtsi ba skur 'debs yin pas ma dag ces pa'i lan shing rag tu/ 'phags pa 'od srung nas bzung ba'i brgyud pa nyer gcig hwa shang yin du chug kyang*/ phyis hwa shang nyid lta ba log pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang mi mthun pa mang du smras pas/ ka ma la shī las dgag cing*/ sa skya pas kyang shin tu smad par mdzad pa ste/

'jig rten na/ 'bangs su brdzus nas rkang nas 'dren pa'i dpe bzhin no// zhes zer ro// de ni gya tshom du snang ste/ slob dpon pad+ma'i ngang tshul dang*/ sa skya pa hwa shang gi 'bangs yin nam/ 'on te/ hwa shang*/ slob dpon pad+ma'i ngang tshul dang*/ sa skya pa'i 'bangs yin pa la bsam nas smras sam zhe na/ khyed kyi tshig sbyor de gong 'og 'dzol ba ste/ dper na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang mi mthun par smras pas/ 'jig rten 'bangs su brdzus nas zhes sogs 'god par rigs lags/ gya ma tho de ni khyed rang la 'gebs par 'os pa ste/ sa skya pa'i 'bangs su khas blangs nas/ sa skya pa'i dgag byar gyur pa'i hwa shang gi bstan bcos rnams/ 'phags yul gyi dpe rgyun khyad par can rnams dang mtshungs par smra ma thag yin pa'i phyir ro// ༈ yang shing rag 'phror/ spyir hwa shang 'di 'jug sgo sangs rgyas pa'i grub mthar zhugs/ khyad par dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa zhig yin la/ bod du thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' bzung zhes smras so// 'o na bon po rnams/ spyir shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug dang*/ sgos dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dzin yin par 'gyur te/ bon gyi brgyud pa hwa shang la 'ded par khyed kyis smras pa gang zhig hwa shang kho ni de dang de ltar yin pa'i phyir ro// de la 'dod mi nus pa ni/ bon po shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug ma yin te/ ston pa gshen rab kyi rjes 'jug yin par grags shing grub la/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yang ma yin te/ lta log 'dzin mkhan yin pas so// ༈ yang srid gsum du/ rab dbyer phyag rgya ba'i chos 'di rgya nag gi lugs su thag bcad nas/ thub dgongs su/ phyag rgya ba'i nang tshan hwa shang gi rjes 'brang dang*/ sems tsam rnam med pa'i sgom dang*/ sher phyin ltar snang phyag chen du 'dod pa'i lugs gsum du bshad pa 'gal bas gang rung cig ma dag ces pa'i lan shing rag tu/ dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen gyi gdams ngag rnams/

'ga' zhig rgya nag lugs dang*/ 'ga' zhig sems tsam rnam med pa'i lugs sogs/ sres bsres su yod pa las/ phal cher rgya nag lugs gtso che'i// zhes ston pa la/ da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni// phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin// phal cher gyi tshig nus la brtags pas shes/ zhes smras so// sa paṇa gyi dgongs gzhi khyad par ba zhig yod pa ni khyed kyis mi go dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen gyi gdams ngag dang*/ rgya nag lugs sres bsres su yod tshul khungs dang 'brel ba zhig khyed kyis bskal chen gcig gi bar du bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub mod/ da ltar phyogs gtam smra ba de ni rgad po'i kha rgyun don du gzung ba'i log lta'i kha bun no// ༈ srid gsum du/ thub dgongs su theg pa che chung gang yang min pa 'gog pa la gzhir byas pa'i/ sems tsam rnam med pa dang shes phyin ltar snang*/ theg chen min ces gsungs pa mkhas pa spyi dang mi mthun pas ma dag ces pa'i lan shing rag tu/ nyan thos dang*/ theg chen gnyis ka ma yin pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan par 'dod pa dgag pa'i skabs su/ sems tsam rnam med pa'i sgom la phyag chen du 'dod pa'i lugs dang*/ shes phyin ltar snang phyag chen du 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis gsung mod/ 'di'i don/ sems tsam rnam med pa'i lugs sogs theg chen gyi lugs ma yin zer ba gtan nas ma yin la/ sems tsam rnam med pa'i lta ba dang*/ shes phyin ltar snang phyag chen ma yin pa'i don/ zhes smras so// de ltar yin na 'brel ci yang ma byung ste/ nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis ka ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dod pa dgag rgyu la/ sems tsam rnam med pa'i lugs dang*/ shes phyin ltar snang phyag chen ma yin byas pas phan rgyu gang yod/ de ni dper na/ ra thul dang lug thul gnyis ka btsun pa'i gos yin pa dgag rgyu la/ lham dang zom pa gnyis zhwa ma yin zhes smras pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ gan mdzod du/ rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen zhes sbyar bas 'di ma gzigs par zad de/

'dir mdo sde'i sgom rim du bshad la rdzogs chen ni a ti yo ga yin pas shan ma phyed pa ces gsungs pa la/ shing rag tu/ 'brug pa rang la nang 'gal te/ mdo sngags khyad par med pa khyed kyis khas blangs nas/ 'di mdo sde'i sgom rim dang*/ a ti yo ga'i sgom rim la khyad par yod pa skad smras pa dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro// zhes zer ro// 'di yang gong gi dpe dang 'dra ste/ ra thul dang lug thul gyi gos la grang dro khyad med par khas blangs nas/ don gcig na yang*/ zhes mthar thug gi lta ba dang*/ thob bya'i 'bras bu gcig par byas/ ma rmongs pa dang*/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes khyad chos bzhis sngags lhag par byas/ lta 'bras gcig pa de rtogs byed kyi thabs cha tshang ma tshang gis khyad zhugs pas/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad du byas pa ni legs par bshad pa yin mod kyi/ shing rag gi yi ge ma dag pa yin nam/ mdo sngags khyad par med pa khyed kyis khas blangs zer bris 'dug pa de ni ma nges pa ste/ de gnyis kyi thabs la khyad par byed chos mang du khas len pa'i phyir// ༈ yang shing rag tu ka ma la shī las/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab sngon du btang nas gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog par gsungs pa'i don 'chad pa na/ lugs gnyis snang ste/ thos bsam gyis sor rtog sngon du btang ba'i lugs dang*/ 'jog sgom gyis sor rtog la brten nas gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur ba'i lugs gnyis so// zhes pa nas/ sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug rnams la bka' bkyon bsgyur byang gis mtha' brgyan pa'i bar du smras pa ni/ dkar brgyud pa'i yig cha legs po gcig nas bshus pa 'dra yang*/ de thad du lan/ legs nyes ngo ma mkhyen pa'ang rnam dpyad la ltos pa yin cing*/ gal te mkhyen rab kyi rtsal las grub pa zhig na shin tu legs gda'/ gang ltar yang de thad du lan ldon ma dgos//

༈ srid gsum du/ hwa shang lta log 'gegs pa'i zol can des// zhes sogs dang*/ sa dkar gnyis po hwa shang dang don la khyad par med na med mnyam dang*/ yod na yod mnyam du 'dug pas smra tshod zin par bya'o// zhes sogs bris pa'i lan shing rag tu/ dkar brgyud kyi phyag chen dang sa skya pa'i lam skor phyi ma'i sems khrid rnams la khyad med cing*/ dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen rnams hwa shang gi lugs yin na/ sa skya pa'i sems khrid rnams kyang hwa shang gi lugs su song zhes smra bar snang mod/ hwa shang ni sbyin sogs bsod nams kyi dge ba thams cad bkag nas ci yang mi bsam par 'dod la/ lam skor sogs su bsod nams kyi tshogs med mi rung du bshad pa gnyis phyogs 'dra tsam yang ga la yin zhes smra bar re re bzhin lan btab par bya ste/ hwa shang dang khyad yod na yod mnyam du bsgrub par bya'o// de yang*/ dkar brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsung las/ bsod nams can la sgom gyi skal ba yod/ ces pa bzhin spyir tshogs bsags pa la 'bad cing*/ sgos khrid kyi sngon 'gror maṇ+ḍal dang yan lag bdun pa sogs tshogs gnyis 'phel ba'i rtags ma byung bar du gsog pa lags/ yang nyid kyis lta sgom dngos gzhi'i tshe/ sa skya pa ni/ sems can sna tshogs su 'pho ba/ ces dang*/ bzhugs par dal du mi gzhug ces/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad sna tshogs pa la/ yul can bsam med rtog med du skyong ba de dang*/ hwa shang dran rtogs thams cad 'gegs pa gnyis/ rnam pa kun tu mi mtshungs/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ dkar brgyud pa rnams kyang*/ skye med la brtan pa thob nas 'gag med la rtsal sbyangs zhes sgom gyi dngos gzhi zung 'jug ro gcig gi dus snang thog tu gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa lags// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ sa skya pa rnams/ gsal ba ngos gzung nas mtha' bral dang brjod bral du 'char ba dang hwa shang gsal ba 'gegs pa gnyis mtshungs pa'i skabs gang na yod/

ces pa'i lan ni/ dkar brgyud pa rnams/ gsal ba lha yi rnam pa yang*// rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin te// zhes gsal ba lha dang sngags su longs pa yis zung 'jug mtha' bral 'char ba lags// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ sa skya pa rnams/ sod par bzung*/ bzhag par skyangs/ grol bar rjes bcad ces dran shes bzhin ma nyams pa'i bcos min sems kyi ngo bo shin tu dag pa dmigs med du skyong ba dang*/ hwa shang dran shes ci yang med pa'i mi rtog par 'jog pa gnyis gcig tu ji ltar sgrub ces pa'i lan ni/ dkar brgyud pa rnams snang thog tu ngos gzung*/ rig thog tu rjen par skyong*/ grol thog tu mtshang rig zer zhing*/ rnal 'byor bzhi po yang dran shes mtho dman gyis khyad 'byed pa lags/ de lta na sa dkar gnyis 'di thad du/ hwa shang gi lta sgom dang khyad yod na mnyam du grub gda' bas dkar brgyud pa tsho hwa shang gi phyogs su phyin chad mi 'phul ba zhu/ nyid kyis de nas lam skor rgya nag lugs su yud kyis drangs/ zer ba khyed ni/ dran shes bzhin nyams pa'i smyon pa zhig gam/ 'on te/ hwa shang gi bstan pa la cher gus pa/ chos thams cad hwa shang lugs su 'dren par byed po zhig hwa shang gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'i tshul du gsar du byon pa gang yin snyam pas bdag cag yid the tshom du 'gyur mod/ gang ltar yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nges don mthar thug rnams la skrag cing rmongs pa/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can zhig yin par the mi tshom mo zhes zer ro// lam skor rgya nag lugs su yud tsam gyis drangs/ zhes pa de ni/ dkar brgyud pa'i lta sgom dang hwa shang gi lta sgom gnyis gcig go zhes cha med kyi rgyus gtam smra ba dag la/ lam skor phyi ma'i lung drangs nas khyad par med na med mnyam du mtshungs sgras sgrub pa lags/ kho bo ni dran shes bag yod kyang ma nyams la/ smyo ba med cing smyon pa'i khas len kyang ma byas/

hwa shang gi sprul pa yin tshe sprul sku rin po che zhes ming snyan po thob kyang*/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan med pa'i sprul sku de 'dra lham mkhan la sprul skur bod pa dang 'dra bas nged ni sprul sku yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i yang snying nyams su len bzhin pa yin pas/ de la mi skrag cing ma rmongs pas 'dris par byas/ mi shes pa shes so dang*/ ma thob pa thob snyam pa yang med pa'i gshis kyis mngon pa'i nga rgyal khos 'dir ma zug par kho ra'i sdod sa de phyogs su log song lags// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen dang*/ sa skya pa'i phyag chen yi ge med pa sogs gcig par bris pa'ang mi bden te/ dkar brgyud pa rnams dbang ma bskur bar phyag chen 'chad/ nged rnams dbang bzhi bskur nas phyag chen ston pas so// de'i phyir sa skya pa'i phyag chen ni dbang las byung ba dang*/ gtum mo/ pho nya/ rba rlabs/ rengs byed la sogs kyi rdzogs rim gang rung re dang 'brel bas phyag chen dngos su 'gyur la/ dkar brgyud pa'i phyag chen rnams ni/ lta ba'i ye shes mdo las byung ba de tsam las bogs su ma gyur pas/ sngags kyi phyag chen gyi dri tsam yang mi bro'o// zhes zer ro// khyed kyi phyag chen de/ lam skor rang skya thub pa zhig ma yin par/ gtum mo/ pho nya sogs la brten dgos na/ nged dang mi gcig zer ba yang cha gcig nas bden pa tsam/ khyed la zhu sa med pa ma gtogs/ dri mi mnam zer dgos te/ ro zhes pa dang bro ba zhes pa gcig pas dri mi bro byas na bzhad bgad slong bar 'gyur ro// ༈ srid gsum du/ gnas lugs yongs su shes pa de rtogs pa don gyi dbang yin pas ngo sprod kyis dbang gi go chod byas pa la/ shing rag tu/ nam zhig ngo 'phrod pa na dbang thob pa khyed la yin du chug kyang*/ sems ngo 'phrod pa'i rgyu tshogs su/ gsang sngags nges don gyi gdams ngag bshad nyan sgom gsum byas pa rnams dbang ma bskur ba'i gsang sgrog dang*/

sgom pa rang dgar byas pa'i nyes pa cis mi 'byung*/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud du/ dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang*// zhes lung 'dren dang bcas bris so// phyag chen pa tsho'i bzhed pa la/ rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi rnal 'byor de la thun mong gi nyams len zer te/ rgyu mtshan/ de gnyis zhi lhag la bzhag pas mdo sngags thun mong ba'i nyams len dang*/ ro gcig sgom med kyi rnal 'byor la thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len zer te/ de gnyis slob mi slob kyi zung 'jug la bzhag nas gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len zer ba lags/ des na/ sems ngo 'phrod pa'i tha snyad tsam ni spros bral rtogs pa la zer mod/ de gsang sngags nges don gyi chos ngo mar rang ma yin cing*/ snod rung gi gdul bya la de tsam bstan pas gsang sgrog sogs kyis nyams pa mi 'byung ngo*// lar/ gsang sgrog yong mi yong gi mtshams kyang gzung dka' ba yin te/ dbang ma thob pa'i gong du/ sta gon dang 'jug pa sogs sngags kyi bya ba rgya chen po rnams bshad pa la'ang gsang sgrog gi ltung ba 'byung ngam/ de ni gong dang mtshungs te/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ zung 'jug ngo sprod pa gnyis dgos nus 'dra bas na/ yang na/ dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa'i gang zag yod par dkar brgyud pa rnams bzhed pas so// ༈ shing rag gi 'phros su/ ngo sprod las logs su tshig dbang bskur mi dgos pa yang yang bris mod zer ba byas 'dug pa ni/ yang na tshig rtsa ma zin par dang*/ yang na rdzun smras pa ste/ kho bo ni gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pa dang sbyar nas spros pa rgyas 'bring gis 'dul 'os pa la dkyil 'khor gyi las rim rgyas pa'i byin brlabs tsam gang rung*/ dbang po ches rno ba la rtogs pa don gyi dbang sems thog tu bskur zhes smras pa yin te/ brtags dpyod ma smin par ha ra hu ra pha la na hi/ rab dbyer/ yas babs dang ni mas 'dzegs gnyis// zhes sogs la/

srid gsum du/ rtsed mo byas nas cung zad smras pa la/ sbub 'thums tshod ma thig pa'i nyams kyis phyogs snga ma rtogs pa'i dgag pa ste zer mod kyang*/ rtsod pa phran bu de tsam gyi phyogs snga btsun chung gsar bus kyang rtogs par 'gyur na gzhan gyis lta ci smos// ༈ rab dbyer/ lta ba de yi yan lag yin// zhes pa la/ gan mdzod du/ 'di ni mi rigs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i lta ba mdor bsdus su/ grub pa'i mtha' kho na lta bar bzhag pas so// zhes bshad pa de ka yang skyor mdzad pa ni rmongs pa ste/ zhes zer te/ rang rang gi bla ma'i gsung skyor ba rmongs pa yin na/ bla ma'i gsung 'chal gtam yin zer ba de ma rmongs pa lags sam/ lam 'bras kyi lta grub de 'dra yin shas kha yang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med 'od du gsungs pa de tshad mar 'dzin rigs zer ba byas pa la nyes pa ci 'dug/ ༈ srid gsum du/ theg chen gnyis la'ang lta ba'i khyad par med par zhal gyis 'ches nas/ sngags bla med kyi dbang re re la lta ba mi 'dra bar re bzos pa de rnams spros pa can 'ba' zhig lags grang*/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ sa skya pa mang po dag rab dbyer/ pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la// lta ba'i dbye ba bshad pa med// ces pa'i tshig tsam la 'khrul nas/ yul yul can gyi shan gang yang mi 'byed par/ mdo sngags lta ba gcig kho na yin zer ba de la rtsod pa de song mod zer ro// nged kyi rtsod ngag 'phen yul ni mkhan chen gser pa'i lugs gtsang mar skyong mkhan rnams la lags shing*/ mkhan po la skyon gtong mkhan nged kyis chog par gda' yis/ gzhan mi dgos so// mdo sngags lta ba gcig zer mkhan la rtsod pa song na des song go chod pa gda'o// rab dbyer/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sgom pa// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs yin// zhes pa la 'brug pa dang srid gsum pas dgag pa byas pa'i snying po/

stong nyid snying rje sgom pa phar phyin gyi snying po yin na/ sngags las ma bshad par 'gyur ro// zer rgyu snang yang*/ 'brel med de/ rab dbyer/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu// mdo rgyud kun las rgyal bas gsungs// zhes stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du/ mdo rgyud kun las gsungs par bshad bzhin du/ de 'dra'i rtsod pa spong don ma mchis/ ci ste tshig tsam la rtsod pa btang na/ 'o na rgyud du/ gang gis mi shes kyai rdo rje// de yi ngal ba don med 'gyur// zer ba yang mi bden te/ kyai rdo rje'i chos sgor ma zhugs kyang*/ bde gsang sogs kyi lam las 'bras bu thob pa yod pa'i phyir ro// zhes skyon gtong rigs mod/ de lta bu'i las ngan blo ldan su zhig byed/ skabs kyi don/ phar phyin theg par stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug tsam zhig las ma gsungs/ rdo rje theg par/ stong nyid snying rje dang rdzogs rim ro gcig pa'i gzugs khyad par can gsungs zhes zur khyad par du bton pa'o// zhes 'dzer to// de ni sngon la sdom gsum rab dbye'i dgongs pa tshul bzhin du longs pa dgos rgyu la gnad 'gag phyogs tsam ma go ba'i steng du/ phyogs snga smra ba po'i 'dod pa khong du ye ma chud par smra ba la rings pa'i gtam ste/ rgyu mtshan/ stong nyid snying rje'i sgra gzhung tshan gnyis ka la yod cing*/ sogs sgra gzhung snga ma la yod pa/ zung 'jug gi sgra phyi ma 'ba' zhig la yod pa 'di'i don 'brel shes na/ legs bshad chen por snang yang sku tshe snga phyi gnyis kas ma byung 'dug rgyud kyi lung dper bkod pa de ni ma 'brel te/ gzhan 'di skabs kyi/ kyai rdo rje thod pa bcu drug khyer ba'i zing nge ba de la blo rtse gtad 'dug pas lan mod kyis/ 'di ni/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid// badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud// 'di ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon// ces pa'i skabs kyi/
