kyai rdo rje/ dmigs med snying rje thabs bde ba chen po dang*/ shes rab rnam pa kun mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid/ ye gdod ma nas zung du 'jug pa la kyai rdor dang*/ bde mchog dang*/ gsang 'dus dang dus 'khor sogs su bzhag pa de nyid yin la/ de lta bu'i zung 'jug ma shes na lam gzhan la 'bad pa ji tsam byas kyang ngal ba don med yin gsung par 'dug des na srid gsum du/ zur khyad bton nas bshad gzhi chen po mdzad 'dug ces smras pa'i tshig snyan la zhen yang*/ 'dir yang zur khyad bton zer rjes zlos mdzad 'dug kyang*/ zur khyad 'don lugs ma mkhyen gda'o// ༈ shing rag las/ rab dbyer/ rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos zhes pa la/ 'brug pa dang*/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ srid gsum mkhan po gsum kas/ dgag sgrub du ma zhig bris kyang*/ rtsod pa zhes pa'i skabs don ma go bar dgag sgrub byas pas/ bla ma gsum ka yang ngal zhing dub pa tsam mo// don ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam po che// rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos// zhes pa ni/ gsung rab las/ dgongs pa bzhi gsungs pa'i nang tshan don gzhan la dgongs pa'i rigs pa skabs thob kyi dbang gis/ dgag sgrub kyi rtsod pa byung ma byung dang*/ de las grol ma grol gyi don ma yin gyi/ the tshom nyid las grol ba la rtsod pa las grol ba'i ming btags pa yin/ zhes sogs bris so// de yang 'brel med ngo ma ste/ rtsod pa zer tsa na/ yang na go gyon mtshon thogs sam/ yang na brgal ba gnyis dang dpang po gsum 'dzoms pa 'ba' zhig rang yin ci dgos/ yin nam min nam snyam pa'i the tshom gyi kun slong des rgyu byas/ de brjod 'dod kyi rkyen byas nas/ 'di ni yin te rgyu mtshan 'dis so// 'di ni min te rgyu mtshan 'di'i phyir ro// zhes pa lta bu ka rtsod pa yin mod/ de sogs las grol ba la rtsod pa kun las grol ba zhes zer lags// ༈ srid gsum du/ rdo rje theg pa skya la phud grub ces smras pa ni smyon pa'i gtam dang mtshungs te/

yang na rdo rje theg pa yi// rgyud sde bzhin du nyams su longs// zhes gsungs bzhin du/ rtsod pa de skad smra ba 'brel gang yang med pas so// zhes shing rag las 'byung ngo*// de la 'brel shin tu che ba yod de/ gong gi tshig rtsa mnan nas/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sgom pa// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs yin// ces pa la/ gan mdzod du/ stong nyid snying rje'i sgom las zur du rdo rje theg pa bkar bas so zhes gsungs la/ 'dir/ yang na pha rol phyin pa yi// mdo las ji ltar 'byung bzhin gyis// yang na rdo rje theg pa yi// rgyud sde bzhin du nyams su longs// zhes gsungs pas phar phyin dang rdo rje theg pa ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad rang bzo'i chos su bzhag pas na/ de ni nyan rang gi theg pa dang*/ theg pa thun mong ba tsho'ang yang na ni rang bzo'i chos yin ces bka' bkyon 'phog gam/ yang na ni theg chen gnyis dang mthun no zhes thugs la bdog ces smra ba ste/ don du nyan rang gi theg pa rang bzo'i chos kyang ma yin/ theg chen gnyis gang rung yang ma yin na/ zur du 'don mi rigs zer rgyur 'dug pas tshig 'dzin pa zhu/ lab lob lhag ma tsho zhus dag go/ ༈ rab dbyer/ rtogs ldan mtshan nyid 'di yin zhes// mdo rgyud kun las gsungs pa med// ces sogs la srid gsum du/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ rtogs ldan ye shes 'phags pa thos pa 'dzin// zhes dang*/ bya rgyud du/ dran dang blo gros rtogs ldan 'gyur// zhes pas rtogs ldan bstan tshul bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ 'o na bon kyang rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs par thal te/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa las/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di bon no// zhes dang*/ gang gi tshe/ 'di bon po de'i tshe/ nag po chen po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ sha za la sogs pa thams cad byer bar 'gyur ro// zhes bon zhes pa'i ming dngos su bstan pa'i phyir// rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so// zhes bris so// mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa ngan 'dres kyis ma bslad par yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsol cig

zhes sogs dang*/ gang gi tshe yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di byin pa'i tshe gling bzhi dang lha'i gnas bcas te/ shing chu skyes kyi 'dab ma bzhin du 'gul lo// rgya mtsho 'ching rnam bzhi yang 'khrugs so// bgegs dang bar chad thams cad kyang skrag go /gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ nag po chen po bud med mang po dang bcas pa yang bros so// zhes sogs gsungs kyi/ bon zer ba med kyang*/ yi ge ma lhogs sam bla thabs su bsnan pa gang rung ngo*// ༈ srid gsum du/ sangs rgyas dang rtogs ldan la sgra bshad du yod kyang mi 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan tshad ldan med bya ba la/ shing rag tu yod de/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas la sangs rgyas kyi sgra mdo rgyud gnyis ka las gsungs pa bshad du yod kyang*/ nyan rang rnams sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i phyir na sangs rgyas kyi sgra 'jug tu med la sogs bris so// sangs rgyas dang rtogs ldan la sgra bshad du yod pa gzhir bcas kyi steng du nyid rang gis kyang zhal gyis bzhes la/ sgra 'jug la ni/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes// zhes sogs kyis gsal ba bzhin/ mdo rgyud kyi lung drangs pa des kyang shes so// ༈ shing rag tu/ rab dbyer/ la la grub thob ngan zhes zer// rtogs ldan bzang ba yin no lo// zhes sogs la/ 'brug pa dpon slob kyis dgag pa byas pa'i snying po/ thun mong gi dngos grub grub pa la grub thob tu bzhag 'phags pa'i sa thob pa la rtogs ldan du bzhag par snang mod sogs bris pa ni phyogs snga'i 'dod pa ma dgongs pa'am/ dgongs bzhin du bsnyon brdung ba gang rung ngo*// dgag pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa yin te/ dkar brgyud pa tsho ri khrod du sgrub pa byed pa la 'dir log pa'i klan ka mang du btsal ba'i phyir/ des na 'brug pa dpon slob kyi tshig 'di rigs la brgal lan zer ba yin pas shan phyed par bya'o// ༈ srid gsum du/

de skad zer mkhan phyag rgya ba'i khrod na med de/ rgyu mtshan/ phyag rgya chen po'i shing rta'i srol 'byed/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ til+li/ nā ro sogs grub brgya'i khrod na bzhugs bzhin du de 'dra'i gzu lum ci la byed/ ces smras pas/ grub thob las rtogs ldan mi lhag par go bar rigs so// gan mdzod du/ snying ma sdug gis sun 'byin mdzad pa de la don du gzung na mi legs shing*/ grub thob la bzang 'bring ngan pa gsum du 'byed pa bzhin/ rtogs ldan la'ang 'byed rigs mod/ de'i phyir mtha' cig tu 'phags pa'i rtogs pa mngon 'gyur dang*/ grub thob kyang thun mong grub pa la 'jog pa'i nges pa ga la yod/ mdor na dkar brgyud phyogs kyi ming phran bu la'ang rtsod rtsod mdzad pa 'di 'dra mi rigs par ston phyir lab lob 'dra shor bar gda'// ༈ srid gsum du/ mdo sde rgyan gyi lung 'di'ang grub thob ngos 'dzin pa'i lung ma yin te sogs smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ blun rtags shin tu che ba ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes grub pa de dngos grub ma yin na mchog gi dngos grub med pa'am/ des dngos grub kyi go mi chod par song zhes sogs 'dzer mod/ de ni blun rtags snga ma las ches te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ma grub pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa gnyis po grub pa yin no// de bzhin du ma grub pa thob pa grub thob yin nam soms dang*/ nged kyis grub pa zhes pa dang*/ grub pa de thob zhes pa la go ba legs par thebs nas smras kyis/ gya tshoms su smra ba'i srol med pas ma bsnyon cig/ ༈ shing rag tu/ 'phags pa rtogs ldan du 'jog zer ba de la bsgrub bya'i tshig tsam ma gtogs sgrub byed lung rigs gang yang mi 'dug pas/ slar sgrub byed kyi lung rigs smos shig de nas rtsod par bya'o// zhes zer te/ sgrub byed ting 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ bya rgyud kyi lung drangs shing*/

de la sgra bshad 'jug tshang ba'i rigs pa bkod pa de kas 'grub pa yin te/ ce re long gis ma gzigs par gda' ba// ༈ shing rag las/ srid gsum du/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sgom pa// zhes pa la rtsod pa nas bzung ste/ grub thob rtogs ldan gyi bar gyi rtsod tshig 'di rnams/ byis pa btsun chung gis rtsod pa o thos ltar snang bas/ mkhas pas bzhad gad kyi gnas su 'gyur la/ lan byed ring chog pa rang mi snang yang*/ blo chung sems kyi khrid phyogs lan cung zad smras pa de tsam mo// zhes zer ro// stong nyid snying rje sogs sgom pa// zhes sogs brjod don shin tu bzang po zhig 'dug kyang mkhan chen klu sgrub rnam gnyis kyis tshul bzhin ma dgongs pa der 'dug gis// da dung skye ba phyi ma la dgongs par 'gyur ba'i smon lam thob mdzod/ rtogs ldan dang grub thob kyi skor 'di rtsod pa g.yas chung zhig snang yang*/ nged kyis sa paṇa la skur 'debs ma nus/ khyed zhu phod che ba 'dug pas sa paṇa la yang gze ma ra mgo kho 'dzug par zhu/ mkhan chen klu sgrub rgya mtsho de nyid mkhas pa'i dbang por mthong zhing*/ khong pas gan mdzod la brgal lan yang lan mdzad snang ba la/ 'brug pas lan ma thebs zer ba'i grags pa ma yin pa'i rnga chung zhig khong ra'i slob rigs 'dras brdungs par brten/ 'brug phyogs kyi mkhas grub rnam re zhig phongs par byas/ grwa rigs tha chung bdag gis lan du 'os pa tsam phul ba yin gyi/ khong gi bzhed srol mi skyong ba khyed lta bu la zhu rgyu ma yin pas/ lan byed ring mi chog pa zhig na ma mdzad pa des khyed rang phyogs la phan mchis/ chos rje paṇa chen gyis/ sdom brtson phal cher bkur ba nyung*// ces gsungs phyir go gnas che chung rang la nges gnas med kyang*/ 'jig rten grags tshod dang mthun pa'i go sa chen por khyed bzhugs phyin srid tshul dang 'brel ba'i rgol ba ni zhu ba ci 'os/

dam pa chos dang 'brel ba'i dgag sgrub zhu sa yang min pas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa kho na rigs par mthong yang*/ gdan sa chen po nas gnang ba'i stabs kyis lan med zhus na/ zab dgongs khrel 'khrugs kyi rgyu rkyen du song dogs/ da lam cung zad phul ba lags so// zhes dgos med kyi tshig la lan btab nas sngar gyi 'phror 'jug ste/ ༈ rab dbyer/ la la nyams dang go ba dang*// rtogs pa zhes bya rnam pa gsum// zhes pa la 'brug pas nyams las rtogs pa bzang zhes smras pa'i rgyab rten/ srid gsum las/ nyams yul dang*/ myong ba yul can/ zhes sogs dang*/ go ba thos bsam gyi sgo nas go yul shar tsam de ngan/ nyams myong gong du bkod pa ltar rang rgyud la goms stobs kyis shar ba'i thun mong ba'i mngon rtogs de 'bring*/ rtogs pa mngon sum du shar ba thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon rtogs rab tu byed pa lags te/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ de tsam gyis rab dbye la phan gnod gang yang ma byung zhing zer mod/ dkar brgyud pas/ go ba ngan/ nyams 'bring*/ rtogs pa bzang zhes gsungs pa la/ rab dbyer/ nyams ni ngan la go ba 'bring*// rtogs pa bzang ba yin ces zer// ces phyogs snga'i mi 'dod pa zhig phyogs sngar bzung bas na/ lha rje bi ji'i snyan phra la gsan pa'i skyon byung ste/ de mi bden par shes pa ni gnod pa'o// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ khyed rang la dpyad pa nyams las rtogs pa lhag pa bden med du 'gro ste/ nyams ni sgom nyams yin la/ de la skyon can skyon med kyi/ skyon med sa bcu'i 'phags pa rnams kyis gzigs ngor/ ces sogs bris so// thog mar thos bsam gyi sgo nas go ba rnyed/ de nyams su blangs pas thun mong gi nyams myong skyes/ de nas chos dang chos nyid kyi ngang tshul sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rtogs pa shar bas rig pa de skad du bshad kyis/ sa thob nas nyams myong med ma smras pas na/

khyed kyis lung 'dren bshad bshad rnams gron du song gda'o// ༈ shing rag las/ srid gsum du/ rtse gcig spros bral gyi rnam gzhag cung zad dang*/ rgyu'i bden don bcu gnyis sbyor lam dang 'brel ba rtse gcig kho na la rnal 'byor phye ba yin/ zhes sogs ni/ dgag sgrub lung rigs nus pa can tshig gcig kyang med par rang 'dod kyi bsgrub bya tsam zhig brjod pa ste/ zhes sogs smras so// sems 'grel skor dang*/ mtshan brjod dus 'khor dang mthun par nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis bkral ba sogs las/ rgyu'i bden don bcu gnyis dang*/ rgyu'i de nyid bcu drug sbyor lam la byed/ 'bras bu'i bden don bcu gnyis dang*/ 'bras bu'i de nyid bcu drug 'phags lam la phye ba zhig 'dug pa la/ don la brtag pa skabs 'di gtso che ba'i dbang gis/ dkar brgyud pa rnams myong chos su bzhed pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi la'ang rgyu 'bras kyi tshul de bzhin byas pa la 'gal ba med de/ so so skye bo'i gang zag la// chos mthun tsam zhig brtsi na ni// chos nas gsungs na 'gal ba med// ces gsungs pa dang mthun pa'i phyir ro// yang ming tsam la rtsod par bzhed na/ 'khor lo 'chams pa dang bskor ba la sogs pa lam 'bras las 'byung ba'i brda' chad rnams la'ang rgyu mtshan mtshungs par bkod pa der ltos shig de yi 'khor lo ro zhes brjod// sgom pa ro gcig mnyam pa nyid// ces ro gcig la sbyor zhing*/ sgom med sgom pa po yang med// ces sgom med dang sbyar ba la/ skyon ci yang med de/ tshig don gnyis ka legs par 'byor ba'i phyir ro// ༈ shing rag tu/ sgom med sgom pa po yang med// ces pa rtog btags glo bur ba tsam zhes zer ba ni/ rang blo'i skyon te/ khyed kyis sngas mgo'i dpe cha gsar pa tsho dang ma mthun tshad rtog btags glo bur ba yin na ha cang thal te/ khyed kyis ma gzigs pa'i chos dang*/ bong bus mi thar ba'i lam shin tu mang bas so// bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/

tshig gcig la yang sna tshogs don// ces pa bzhin skabs thob kyi lung don 'grel shes mkhas pa yin gyi/ pir pir rtog btags la ngo mtshar du su zhig 'dzin// ༈ shing rag tu/ rab dbyer/ dper na rmi lam nges bstan las// zhes sogs la srid gsum du/ sa bcu'i rmi ltas gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'jig rten pa'i sa bcu yin gsungs pa 'dra na/ de la nges pa can mi snang ste/ sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang sems don thams cad grub pa lta bu'i srid pa tha ma pa la'ang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas 'byung ba'i nub mo rmi lam gyi mtshan ma bzang po mang du gzigs par 'dul ba lung dang*/ rgya cher rol pa'i mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ sa bcu'i sems dpa' rnams kyi sprul pa'i rnam rol la ni nges pa med cing*/ de'i phyir/ byang sems don grub kyi rmi lam rnams ni/ sprul pa tshul ston gyi rmi lam yin gyis/ las snang rang rgyud pa'i rmi lam ma yin/ zhes zer ro// yab dang sras mjal ba'i mdor/ rang re'i ston pa 'di nyid sngon bskal pa dpag med 'das pa na/ sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin pa zhig slar zhing 'dir sprul pa'i gar mdzad tshul sogs cher gsungs pa dang*/ de mtshungs mdo gzhan las kyang gsungs mod/ de ltar na byang sems don grub kyi rmi lam tsam la cha ma bzhag na/ mdzad pa lhag ma rnams kyang sprul pa'i rnam rol yin te/ rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa 'di// sprul pa yin gyis rang rgyud min// zhes bshad pa dang mthun la/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba sogs kyi tha snyad dus gnas thams cad 'jog dka' bas smra tshod mi zin la/ thun mong theg pa dang sgo bstun nas glengs tshe/ mnal ba dang*/ rmi lam rmi ba sogs kyang 'jig rten dang rjes su mthun pa zhig smra dgos so// ༈ shing rag tu/ thub pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las// byas pa mthong na sa dang po// zhes sogs ni/

las snang rang rgyud pa'i rmi lam ste/ zhes zer ba la snying po mi snang ste/ de rang rgyud pa yin pa'i shes byed mi 'dug pas so// sa paṇa gyis gsungs so zhe na/ kho bo ni de kas 'thus kyang gzhan gyis rtsi don byed pa dka'/ gnyid med pa tsam rang la bzang rgyu med de dmyal ba bzhin/ rmi lam med pa tsam la'ang bzang rgyu med de lha bzhin no// rim lngar/ gnyid log pa dang sad pa ste// gnas skabs gnyis po spangs pa ni// gnyid log pa dang rnam bral ba// zung 'jug yin par ston pas gsungs// zhes pa ni/ gnyid rmi lam zhes pa'i skabs kyi gnyid ma yin la/ 'di'i gnyid ni ma rig pa'i gnas skabs/ gnyid sad pa ni ma rig pa de dang bral ba'i skabs zhes rnam par dbye ba med de/ dus rtag tu ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs phyir dang*/ zhes pa'i skabs dang mthun cing don du na/ ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med ces gsungs pa de yin pas/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi 'phros glengs 'di la phan gnod mi snang ngo*// ༈ shing rag tu/ sbyor lam gyi skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mthong*/ chos 'chad pa thob pa'i phyir/ rmi ltas bcu po yongs spong gi skabs yin zer ba 'brel ba med de/ sa dang po bas sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhes pa nas sa bcu'i bar du/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang*/ chos thos pa je mang du 'gyur bar bshad pa'i phyir/ de lhag gi lab ro rnams dud 'gros za bar 'gyur ram bor zhog/ ༈ rab dbyer/ deng sang 'ga' zhig bla ma yi// mos gus tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas// rtog pa cung zad 'gags pa la// phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod byed// ces sogs la/ srid gsum du/ lam 'bras las/ khams 'dus pa gsum zhes 'byung ba de don gyis 'gog par bzhed pa ste/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ de ni mi rigs te/ zhes sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas smras pa ni/ thugs srab mo yod pa'i rnam 'gyur te/ lam 'bras sa paṇa gyis 'gog par mi srid cing*/

kho bos ni sa paṇa gyi lugs 'dzin kha cig la co dris pa'o// ༈ shing rag tu/ rab dbye'i dgag bya ni/ mos gus kyi stobs kyis rtog pa mngon 'gyur ba skad cig 'gag pa la/ phyag chen du ngo sprod pa dgag pa yin/ gnyid kyi tshe rtog pa mngon 'gyur ba skad cig 'gags kyang*/ phyag chen du ngo sprod par mi rung ba dang 'dra/ des na rtog pa cung zad 'gags pa la/ zhes cung zad kyi nus pa la brtags pas rtsod pa rang grol yin/ zhes smras so// gnyid 'thug gi tshe rtog pa mngon 'gyur ba'i skad cig 'gags pa de phyag chen du ngo sprod mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ gnyid sgom du ma shar na sgom khor yug tu 'ong ba med par 'jog gis/ des sa lam cher mi bsgrod pas khyed kyi ngo sprod de ni/ tshod 'jog ngo sprod la go yul gyis sham bu btags pa tsam mo/ jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag nyams su len mkhan rnams ni/ nyin mtshan bar gsum gyi 'od gsal ngos 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi mtshan dus su/ nyin snang gis bsdus pa'i snang gsum lugs zlog tu thim/ rmi lam 'char ba'i sngon gyi snang gsum lugs 'byung du ma lang gong gi bar der/ rang bzhin gzhi la gnas pa'i 'od gsal/ de la 'od gsal ma'i ming bzhag goms stobs las byung ba'i yang dag gi dran pa la 'od gsal bu'i tha snyad byas nas/ de'i skabs su/ 'od gsal de gnyis chu thog tu chu blug pa bzhin dbyer med du 'dres pa la/ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa zer zhing*/ de la mnyam par bzhag pas/ tha snyad du btags pa'i gnyid ma sad kyang*/ sgom la 'du 'bral med pa zhig 'ong ba ni/ lag len gyi rgyun ma nyams pa'i khyad chos so// des na gnyid kyi rtog pa mngon 'gyur 'gags pa'i skad cig phyag chen du 'gro tshul de ltar lags/ rtog pa cung zad 'gags pa phyag chen du ngo sprod byed mkhan gyi dkar brgyud pa med pas cung zad kyi tshig nus la brtags dgos ma mchis so//

༈ rab dbyer/ dbang ma bskur la bla ma med// ces pa la/ srid gsum du/ bla ma gcig las dbang thob rjes/ gzhan gcig las rgyud dam man ngag lta bu thob pa'i bla ma de/ gsang sngags kyi bla ma min par bsgrub e spobs/ zhes sogs bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ sngar smin dbang gcig kyang ma thob pa la/ bla mas dbang ma bskur bar rgyud man ngag bshad na/ de bla mar mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ dbang ma bskur la bla ma med// zhes bshad/ sngar bla ma gzhan las dbang thob pa zhig la/ bla mas dbang ma bskur bar rgyud sogs bshad kyang bla ma'i go chod pa slob ma de'i rang ngor ni byed dgos te/ dbang khrid brgyud pa so so'i chos mang du snang ba bzhin no// zhes smras pa cha gcig 'dra mo snang ste/ 'on kyang*/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong las/ yang dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud bshad pa dang*/ man ngag thob pa ste gsum ldan nam/ gang yang rung ba gnyis thob pa ste gnyis ldan nam/ gang yang rung ba gcig las ma thob kyang rung ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i bka' drin mnos pa la ni bla ma zhes yongs su grags pa yin no// zhes pa dang cung ma mthun pas chos rje'i dgongs par song ma song brtag par bya'o// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs la// 'di yi ming yang bstan mi bya// dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la'ang*// 'di yi gsang ba bstan mi bya// zhes pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ sa lugs pa kha cig phyag len gtsang zhib can du mdzad pa'ang snang ste/ phyogs gcig nas legs par snang yang*/ rje btsun gong ma rnams la dbang rgyun med par rgyud kyi lung rgyun yod pa 'ga' re snang zhing*/ deng sang yang lung rgyun ci yod la dbang rgyun med pa'i chos du ma zhig snang ba rnams/ spangs dgos pa'i nyes par 'gyur bas lugs de legs pa ma yin no// zhes smras so// lung 'di mi g.yo bla med dang*/ phag mo mngon 'byung gnyis su tshig mthun par byung*/ rgyud 'ga' zhig tu'ang phyogs 'dra 'byung mod kyi/

'di'i don 'chad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs la// rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya ste// zhes pa'ang*/ mi g.yo ba dang phag mo'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa la de gnyis kyi rgyud bstan du mi rung zer ba ma yin te/ dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i skabs su/ bye brag tu bkar ba'i tshigs ma byung bas so// dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la'ang*/ zhes pa'i gzhan de yang*/ dus gsang la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma yin/ dper na spyi rgyud du/ ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi chod// ces pa dang cha 'dra bar/ mu stegs can la sogs pa'i gzhung las bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing*/ de'i dam tshig khas len bzhin pa'i gang zag la 'di'i gsang ba mi bstan ces pa'am/ yang na/ gzhan zhes pa rgyud sde phyi ma la bzhag nas/ de'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ de ka'i thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs la mchog tu 'dzin pa la/ 'di nyid mi bstan zhes pa'i don du song ngo*// de lta ma yin par bla med kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gang rung gcig tu zhugs shing dbang thob kyang*/ rgyud 'di gnyis bstan du mi rung na ha cang thal te/ sgos kyi dbang rgyun med la/ lung rgyun dang bshad rgyun yod pa rnams la ji ltar bya/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bzhi thob na/ rgyud sde thams cad 'chad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du'ang grub par/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug kyis bshad na/ bstan pa'i snod du lta zhig ci smos snyam du go bar 'gyur ro// grub don ni/ 'chad tshul de lta bu ma byas na/ rgyud sde las bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs phyin/ mi g.yo bla med dbang gi rgyud kyi gdul byar mi 'gyur ba'i khyab mtha' 'god par 'gyur bas mi rung ngo*// des na/ rgyud lung de dang rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa 'gal bar bzung nas/ lugs de spangs na khyed la nyes ltung du gyur ta re// ༈ srid gsum du/

yang*/ dwags po bas rang bzhin yongs shes la blo rtse gtad nas/ sems ngo mthong bas chog ces dang*/ rang ngo shes pas grol zhes glengs pa la/ de 'dra bdud kyi gsang tshig yin// ces dang*/ kho bo'i lugs kyi sems la ngo bo med pas sprad rgyu mi bdog ces gsungs nas/ yang dkon mchog mgon po'i zhus lan du/ sems sems kyis stongs shing cir yang ma grub pa la/ cir yang ma red pa zhes pa nas/ dbugs 'gags na rnam shes 'gags nas sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo 'gags par ngo 'phrod na sems ngo 'phrod lugs legs pa lags/ zhes sems ngo 'phrod rgyu yod pa dang*/ sems rten brten pa dag ma dag rang ngo shes pa'i don du bzhed pa snang zhing*/ rje btsun grags pas kyang*/ rnga mong bu dang phrad pa bzhin// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// zhes gsungs pa rnams 'gal ba ltar snang zhes dang*/ snye mo mdzes sgom gyi zhus lan du/ sems stong par rtogs pa dang*/ zung 'jug tu rtogs pa gnyis kyi phyi ma la sde snod dang*/ rgyud sde dang*/ dkon mchog gsum tshang bar gsungs 'dug pa/ sems la ngo bo med na tshang lugs ji lta lags/ zhes bris pa la/ shing rag tu/ nges don gyi skabs 'dir/ gnas skabs gnyis te/ mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo la zla ba'i skabs dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gzhan la brda' sprod pa'i skabs gnyis so// dang po'i tshe/ sems bzhag bya 'jog byed/ bsgom bya sgom byed/ myong bya myong byed/ 'thob bya thob byed/ ngo sprod bya sprod byed dang bral ba yin la/ sa paṇa gyis/ sems la ngo bo med pas sprad rgyu mi bdog ces pa'ang de la dgongs/ yang dag par na/ sems la ngo bo yod med gnyis ka las 'das shing*/ ngo sprod rgyu yod med kun las 'das pa zhig yin yang*/ de go bar byed pa'i brdar sems la ngo bo med pas sprad rgyu med ces gsungs pa ni/ dper na slob dpon tog rtse pas/ gnyis su med pa'i ming tsam ste// zhes sogs dang*/

snying po gsal por brjod na/ gal te ngo sprod rgyu yod na/ 'di ni 'di'o// zhes mtshon pa'i tshul gyis ngo sprod dgos mod/ don dam pa'i gshis lugs ni gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa/ brjod du med pa blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir ngo sprod rgyu med do// ces pa la/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// ces pa dang*/ sa ra ha'i lung dang bcas smras/ de ltar na/ khyed kyis smras pa 'di la/ la zla tshul de bdud kyi gsang tshig yin nam rtsod gzhi yin soms dang*/ rang mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo la zla ba'i bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa de ka gsang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas gzhan la brda' sprod pa yin gyi/ rang la sems ngo sprod rgyu med na gzhan la sems ngo ji ltar sprod soms dang*/ 'di ni 'di'o// zhes mtshon du med pa'i sgo nas mtshon par bshad de/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// zhes sogs dang*/ mchog dgar sgom pa med cing sgom pa po yang med/ ces sogs gsungs pas so// de ni/ gnyis su med pa ming tsam ste// de la ming yang yod ma yin// ces pa de'i don du song*/ de la dgongs nas/ sa ra has/ bla mas smras pa gang gis snying zhugs pa// lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra// zhes gsungs gda'/ sa ra ha'i lung khyed kyis drangs pa las/ bsam gtan bral bas ci zhig bsam byar yod// ces sogs rang gis myong ba med tshul gyis myong rjes/ gzhan la brjod pa med tshul gyis brjod pa yin pas don bzang po'o// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhu 'phrin du/ so mar bzhag na bal nyid yin// skud par byas na bcos par 'gyur// zhes sogs kyi dpe la/ srid gsum du/ 'di phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la zhu log 'bul gnang 'dug pa la gser sbyangs 'di ltar 'bul te/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ ma rangs pa'i tshig snga phyir bris pa ni/ spro gtam byung na rang dang mthun pas dgyes rgyu la/

don du nged kyis sa paṇa la skur 'debs su mi 'gro la/ gnas skabs tshig nyams 'tshar po bris pa de la dgongs rtags su 'dug pas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ hrīḥ des de la/ gsed dgrol srid gsum du zhus pa de kas sa paṇa chen po'i dgongs pa rdzogs 'gro ba yod pas slar bzlas ma dgos// ༈ yang nyid kyis/ don gyi tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhu 'phrin du/ so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /de la phyag rgya chen po zer/ zhes dgag par mdzad pa la/ srid gsum du/ so ma sogs la bka' bkyon mdzad na/ rang phyogs dma' dbab pa'i sgyu thabs su 'gro ba 'dra lags/ zhes sogs bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ ma dgongs pa ste/ nged kyis lam skor dgu'i sems khrid rnams su/ so ma lhug pa rang 'thad ma bcos par bzhag ces kyang bshad mod/ de dag gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs sam rgyu yin gyi/ so ma ma bcos par bzhag pa de tsam zhig gnas lugs ma yin/ 'brug pa rnam so ma ma bcos lhug pa de gnas lugs phyag chen rang du byed pa ni lta sgom shan ma phyed pa'i blun rtags shin tu che bar snang*/ zhes sogs mang du smra mod/ zhu log 'bul ba gnang zhes pa'i tshig gnad 'dzin sa 'di yin te/ so ma ma bcos lhugs par bzhag pa phyag chen yin ces 'brug pas mi 'dod pa sa paṇa la thugs rgyus yod bzhin du/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la de dang mi mthun pa'i zhu 'phrin phul zhes pa'i don/ so ma lhug pa sogs ni/ phyag chen gyi gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod zin de skyong ba'i thabs su 'brug pas bzhed kyi/ so ma sogs gnas lugs phyag chen rang du byed mkhan gyi 'brug pa su 'dug phyogs snga'i nam ma langs par dgag pa'i nyi ma kha shor shar ba 'di rigs la zer bas/ mkhas pa'i bya ba mdzad par bzhed na gzhan gzhung la'ang bag tsam sbyangs dgos kyi/ gzhan du na rdza bcag 'di 'dra ba mang du 'byung bas na/ glen pas rdza gcog zer ba der 'gyur ro//

༈ yang khyed kyis/ sems khong glod pa'i so ma ma bcos lhugs pa de/ mar me ltar rang gsal gyi zhi gnas zhes bya ba yin zer ro// 'o na/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang*// mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar// rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis// nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces gsungs pa 'di yang*/ zhi gnas kho na yin nam/ yin tshe/ de nyid ces pa'i tshig gis bstan don gnas lugs de kho na nyid yin la/ gnas lugs de kho na nyid skyong ba zhi gnas skyong ba yin nam/ thugs rnal du phobs shig/ ༈ yang khyed rang gis skabs mang por mgo ma tshos par klad pa ldag pa'i zol du/ dkar brgyud kyi nges don pa spyi la kha zer bar 'dug kyang*/ dam par khas blangs pa de mi bden par ston pa'i sgo yig mtshon khra ma'o// khyed kyis/ sa phyogs kyi bla ma chen por grags pa phal cher zhig gis kyang ma dgongs par gsung grul ma btub mang du byon mod/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas zer ro// sa phyogs kyi bla ma che shos ni/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnams yin la/ de dag gis ma dgongs pa'i gsungs grul ma gtub byon cing*/ nyid kyis dgongs pa'i gsung grul btub byon par smra ba 'di ni shin tu ham che ba ste/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhabs tog yin nam zhabs 'dren yin gzigs 'tshal lo// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ 'dir snying por cung zad brjod pa 'di ni/ nges don gyi mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i snying po gsong por smras pa yin la/ nges don la sngar myong ba'i rlan cung zad yod pa zhig gis/ kho bos ji skad bshad pa de la myang na/ zhi gnas kyi mthar mi lhung ba'i/ myong ba khyad par can nang nas skye bar 'gyur te/ mdor na deng sang gi sgom chen blun po'i bla ma grags pa can la/ gdams ngag lo brgyar sdug nyan byed pa bas/ kho bos snying por smras pa'i nges don gyi gnad de tsam zhig la lan gsum tsam klags shing myong gzhig 'jug pa yang*/

nges don gyi rtogs pa la bogs thon pa zhig yong nges pa ni bden pa ste/ 'dis ni nges don gyi bstan pa la bya ba chen po bgyis pa'o// zhes ham zog 'dres pa'i thal ba nam mkha' la phyar ro// slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ kho bo cag ni smyon pa dang lhan cig tu rtsod pa ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i lung bzhin/ shes pa rnal du mi gnas pa'i skyes bu dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar mi rigs kyang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad gzer dang*/ sngags kyi thun brab sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyis/ kho bos smyon pa mang po sngar yang brtul zin gyi/ da lam yang de bzhin du bgyis pa'i lhag bsam gyis cung zad smra bar bya'o// de yang khyed kyis phyogs snga ma'i 'dod pa ma go sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa ma lon/ don gyi khog ma phub/ tshig skyon 'gal zlos can rgyud mar bris pa ni/ ham pa la skyabs bcol nas smras par zad kyis/ de la snying po 'chang du rung ba ci zhig yod/ gong ma lnga tsam ma gtogs pa/ sa skya pa'i zhal ngo slob rgyun dang bcas pa thams cad/ mi shes pa dang*/ ma go ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i gral mgor yang yang skyal/ dkar brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin che phra thams cad blun po sgra che khog chung du btang rjes/ nor nyan pa khyed kho na yin pas/ de'i 'chal gtam lan gsum bklag na nges don bogs thon zer ba 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dma' 'byin pa'i bdud tshig yin par gor ma chag tshul 'di lta bu ni bod kyi bstan 'dzin spyi dang*/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lugs 'dzin rnams kyi thugs kyi zug rngur mi 'gyur ba zhig na ni/ chos dang 'jig rten gang yang mi bden pas ci dga' ba'i spyod pa la 'jug par bya'o// thar 'dod kyi gdul bya phal cher sgom chen tsho'i mdun du pad mtshor ngang pa bzhin/ ma bos par yang ngang gis 'du ba 'di la spyan du dud khus byugs pa bzhin tsha yang tsha ba tsam du zad la/ khyed kyis tshig lan gsum klog mkhan dang*/

yid rton mkhan gyi shes rig can ni/ ji skad du/ ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// ༈ yang zhu 'phrin las/ gol sa gsum po bcad tsam gyis// phyag rgya chen por 'gyur na ni// nyan thos 'gog pa'ang der 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa la/ shing rag gi stong sgra las/ 'jog sgom rkyang pas shor gol spangs pa tsam gyis gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong mi nus kyi/ de'i grogs su bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags dgos/ ma bsags na nyan thos 'gog pa dang khyad med du 'gyur ba'i don yin cing*/ mdo sdud par/ ji srid tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par ma gyur pa// de srid stong nyid dam pa 'di ni mthar mi phyin// zhes gsungs pa dang phyogs mtshungs so// zhes rigs pa mi 'gab pa zhig gi rgyab tu lung tshig ma dag pa cig drangs shing*/ srid gsum pa'i rigs pa sbas nas bzhag pa ni/ lkug ma'i spyang bcos su go bar mdzod cig/ ༈ yang rnam rtog phyag rgya chen po ma yin/ zhes pa la/ srid gsum du/ rnam rtog phyag chen yin min sgom pa po'i nyams len gyi 'khos kha la rag gda'/ zhes bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ khyed rang la rnam rtog chos skur khas blangs pa dang 'gal/ rgyu mtshan/ skabs 'dir sgom bzang ngan la ltos te/ rnam rtog phyag chen yin min gnyis byung ba'i/ rnam rtog phyag chen ma yin pa de mi srid/ khyed kyi lugs la phyag chen dang chos sku gcig la/ de bas na/ rnam rtog chos sku ma yin pa mi srid pa bzhin/ rnam rtog phyag chen ma yin pa yang khyed la mi srid pa'i phyir ro// de la da lam lan rnal ma mi 'debs par mi smra ste/ sgom pa po bzang ngan la ltos pas ka sgom pa po bzang ba nged kyi ngor rnam rtog chos sku dang*/ ngan pa khyed kyi ngor rnam rtog ma rig pa yin no// zhes bya'o// ༈ sa paṇa gyis/ rtog pa med na spong mi nus// zhes sogs la/ srid gsum du/ rtog pa med na spang bya spong mi nus pa'ang mi mad de/

zhi ba lhas/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa'i gnyen por stong pa nyid// myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas// de ni ci'i phyir sgom mi byed// ces dang*/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ blo dang ldan pas mi rtog ye shes stobs// rtag tu kun nas mnyam par song ba yis// de la brten pa'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing rnams// dug sman chen pos dug bzhin 'joms par byed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan du na/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgoms pas spang bya spong mi nus na/ de bsgoms kyang don med bsgom par song ba 'dra/ zhes sogs bkod pa la/ shing rag tu/ rtog pa med na spong mi nus// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ don gzhan la dgongs pa'i tshig yin pas/ mi mthun phyogs rtog pa 'phror mi 'jug pa'i gnyen po dran shes bzhin de la/ rtog pa'i ming btags pa'am/ yang na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab la rtog pa'i ming btags kyis/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa la mi zer/ de 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang 'dra/ khyed phyogs snga ma nges pa'i dgag pa la brtson brtson 'dra yang*/ 'ben la mi 'phogs pa'i mda' des don mi snang zer ro// sa paṇa gyi gsung de nyid don gzhan la dgongs pa yin na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la zhu log tu song ste/ sgra ji bzhin du ma zhus pa'i phyir ro// dran shes la rtog pa'i ming btags zer ba yang*/ ma yin pa la yin pa'i ming 'dogs pa la khyed zhal byang bas lan no// des na phyogs snga gsar rnying gnyis ka 'di'i 'ben yin pas na/ mda' mo ka ra'i dkyil du 'phog song ngo lags// ༈ yang shing rag tu/ ye shes cung zad skyes na yang*// zhes pa'i ye shes phyag chen yin pa gzhir bcas su mdzad pa yang ma dgongs pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ dpe'i ye shes dang dpe'i phyag chen la/ nor sa yod pas shan phyed dgos zer ro// nged la nor sa med kyis nor sa yod na khyed rang gzobs shig/

༈ srid gsum du/ phyag chen la shor gol med na/ de'i mtshungs ldan gyi rigs pas/ sa lam gyi rim pa kun la'ang gol 'chugs sogs 'ong rgyu ma yin 'dug pas smras pa la/ shing rag tu/ khas blangs 'gal ba ste/ de'i gong du/ des na phyag rgya chen po nyid// yin na shor sa gol sa med// ces pa de khyed rang gi blo la 'thad par khas blangs nas/ skabs 'dir/ phyag chen la shor gol yod par smras pas so// zhes pa ni stong pa'i sgra ste/ skabs 'dir phyag chen la shor gol yod par nged kyis khas ma blangs pa mngon sum pa'i phyir ro// khyed kyis/ kho bo cag ni/ zhes sogs rigs pa bkod pa la ni snying po cher mi snang*/ sa paṇa gyi bzhed dgongs yang dag pa ni/ nged kyis snying la gnas/ ltar snang tsam du de la sun 'byin gyis rigs pa ni song*/ mdo sde rgyan dang sdom 'byung gi lung ni kho bo'i phyogs na bzhugs pas smra ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ rtog pa cung zad 'gag pa la// zhes pa nas/ 'di'i bar gyi lung rigs khyed kyis smras pa rnams sku khams nyogs pa'i dus mdzad pa zhig yin nam/ don la 'bab pa zhig mi snang na'ang*/ 'gags thug na brla bsgrad kyi rnam pas 'gro dmigs chung ngus sbad gog 'thag pa cig 'dug pa ltar/ skabs 'dir tshigs su bcad pa cig kyang smon lam gyi tshul du mdzad pa rjes su yi rang*/ lar klu sgrub kyis/ rigs pa'i don dang mi ldan pa'i// gzhung lugs gang zhig rtsom byed pa// de yis dgongs pa 'grub mi 'gyur// sngags dang bral ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin// zhes gsungs pa la thugs gzhig 'jug 'tshal lo/ ༈ rab dbyer/ lus rgya zhig pa'i shi ma thag /yon tan phyis nas 'byung zhes zer// zhes sogs la/ srid gsum du/ khyung sgong rgya dang*/ seṅge'i mngal rgya dang*/ rnal 'byor pa lus rgya grol ba dang ma grol ba/ shes rab rkyang grol gyi dgra bcom pa sogs kyi dper brjod 'thad ldan bkod/

rgyud lung gis rgyab mnan byas pa la/ shing rag tu/ lha mo bzhi zhus drangs pa la/ nus pa ci yang ma byung ste/ rgyud tshig de dag gi don ni/ tha mal gyi phung po rnam par dag nas ye shes kyi lha skur 'gyur ba tsam gyi don yin gyi/ khyed kyi grub mtha'i drag shos tshe 'dir mthong lam skye/ mthong lam gyi yon tan shi nas skye zer ba de la zur cha tsam yang ma phan zhing*/ sa paṇa gyis/ nyi ma de ring shar ba yi// 'od zer nang par 'byung ba mtshar// zhes dgag pa mdzad pa la gnod byed phyogs 'dra tsam yang ma byung bas lan byed dgos kyang mi snang zer ro// rgyud kyi lung 'dis ni/ rang lugs la gnod shugs shin tu che ba'i tshul re zhig nyon cig de yang*/ gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa las/ lha mo spyan mas zhus par/ chos kyi dbyings rnams 'phro ba ni// gang las skye bar 'gyur ba lags// dang po ci ltar 'ongs pa yin// de bzhin phyir 'gro ci ltar lags// zhes dris pa'i lan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te/ de bzhin phyir 'gro ci ltar lags// zhes pa la/ bcu gnyis mtha'i tshig gi don// gang gis rtag tu sgom byas na// de ni dngos grub rgyas pa yi// rdo rje 'dzin par rang nyid 'gyur// bcu gnyis ni yul yul can 'dres pa'i shes pa lnga/ 'byung bzhi/ snang gsum ste bcu gnyis/ mtha'i tshig gi don ni/ de'i mthar rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal 'char ba de nyid/ rnal 'byor gyis mngon sum du gyur pa la ni bden pa mngon pa zhes bya la/ gang gi tshe rnal 'byor pa brtson 'grus dang ldan pa zhig na/ rgyud de dag sgom pas tshe 'dir rdo rje'i sa thob par 'gyur zhes 'chad pa la/ gang gis rtag tu sgom byas nas// sogs gzhung lhag ma rnams byung mod/ brtson pa lhod pa zhig na/ mthong lam mngon du byas pa des kyang rnam smin gyi lus rten ma spang pa de srid du tha mal gyi kun tu spyod pa'ang ston srid kyi/

rang thad kyi yon tan snang ba'i nges pa med ces ston pa la/ ji snyed lus de gnas kyi bar// de yi las dang las min byed// dge dang mi dge'i bsam pa yang*// bya ba'i las kun byed pa yin// zhes gsungs/ gal te las dang rnam smin las byung ba'i lus rten 'di zhig pa ste bor ba na/ rang sa'i yon tan gang yin pa de srid pa bar ma do'i rten la snang bar 'gyur zhing*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lus su langs pa des rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin par byed tshul ston pa la/ gang tshe las kyi lus zhig na// de tshe de yi rang mthu yis// de 'dra'i lus su de gyur te// gang gis g.yo dang mi g.yo khyab// nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid 'dra bar// de ni gnas par shes par bya// zhes gsungs te/ tshe 'dir tshogs bsags pa bar ma do'i rten la smin pa bzhin no// nyi ma de ring shar nas 'od zer nang par yang mi 'ong na/ nang par gyi nyi ma de 'od zer med pa'i mun pa can cig lags sam/ des na rgyud kyi don rtsa slong nas bshad na de ltar yin te/ gtam sgum 'thu mkhan kha cig gis ma go rje sa paṇa gyi bzhed pa tshul bzhin shes par 'dod na/ da dung blo sbyongs dgos par gda' bas sgyid ma lug cig/ ༈ yang khyed kyis/ mthong lam pas zung 'jug gi lus ma grub kyang 'chi ba nam yang med do// 'phags pas na dang 'chi ba dang*// rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs// zhes pa ste/ theg chen 'phags pa spyi'i yon tan yin par thogs med zhabs kyis bshad pas so// zhes smras pa la 'brel gang yang mi snang ste/ byams chos kyi lung don/ 'phags pas skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal spangs pa'i don yin gyi/ skye rga na 'chi spangs zer ba ma yin/ bcad du med pa sogs kyang rnam smin gyi lus la zer ba ma yin/ ye shes kyi lus sam/ 'phags rgyud kyi mngon rtogs la zer ba yin pas shan ma phyed par smra nyog mang du glengs kyang gnyid 'thug pa'i cho ga tsam du zad do// khyed kyis/

gsung rab kyi don phyin ci ma log par shes pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' la rnam dpyod kyi dbang po 'byor pas/ legs bshad mi zad pa'i gter chen blo gros kyi klong nas rtsol med du 'byung ba dang*/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa dang*/ bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad las khyad par du 'phags tshul dang*/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga ma gtogs/ sa lugs pa spyi rmongs par btang nas khyed gcig pus shes par khas blangs nas/ yang skabs 'dir/ bdag cag so so'i skye bo blo phyogs re bas chos kyi don ji bzhin du ma nges pas/ blun po bdag lta bu'i tshig la bden pa ci yod ces smras pa rnams ni 'gal ba'i phung po bla na med pa ste/ shar nub go brjes sam ri rdo klung skyil gyi gtam du snang bas so// 'on kyang blun po bdag lta bu'i tshig la bden pa ci yod ces gsungs pa kho na snying por gzung ste/ gong 'og gis zhal tsho rnams mi bden pas rdzun yin ce'am/ snga ma'i yon tan rnams skabs 'di ka tsam du 'grigs pa yin ces par song bas/ rdzun gyi nang du drang po zab// zer ba de dgongs par zhugs pa'i gsung rigs su gda' bas/ la la bzang la la la ngan par 'di shes pa ni chos spang ba yin no// ༈ yang khyed kyis mdo'i lung drangs pa de ni/ dkar brgyud kyi ring lugs 'gog pa po rnams dang*/ nyid rang la 'phogs pa'i chos spong las grangs su bgrang pa ste/ la la bzang la la la ngan par 'du shes pa de ni chos spong ba yin no// zhes pa nas 'di ni rigs 'di mi rigs ces zer na/ chos spong ba yin no// ces gsungs pa'i bar thams cad khyed la tshang zhing*/ khyed rang gi tshig las kyang*/ dam pa'i chos la phyogs dang ris su phye ba'i dgag sgrub dang*/ 'di ni yin gyi 'di ni gti mug go /zhes sdang zhugs kyi smod pa rnams ni/ dam pa'i las kyang ma yin mod// ces smras pa yang khyed rang la gnas pa dang*/ theg pa chen po spong byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o// zhes dang*/

rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smad pa dang*// zhes dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang gzhan mthun pas// chos ltar bcos pa brjod pa'o// zhes dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa// gnyis por thub pas gsungs pa yin// zhes dang*/ rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu'i gzhan smod dang*// bdag ni zab mo bzang po'i zhes// log pa nyid ni smra ba dang*// zhes byang sems kyi sde snod las bshad pa'i ltung ba'i tshogs kyang shas cher shing rag gis smras pa dang bsags shing*/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs// de bas de la brnyas pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad// zhes gsungs te/ 'khrul spong las/ de la brnyas pa ste/ rigs sam/ tshul khrims sam/ thos pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bdag la mchog tu 'dzin cing*/ bla ma la dman par 'dzin pa ni brnyas pa'o// zhes pa ste/ 'chal gtam smras so zhes sgrogs pa lta bu'o// gzhan yang*/ rdo rje spun la khros pa ni// nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin// zhes pa'ang tshang bar gda'/ de lta bas na/ theg pa chung ngu lta zhog theg chen gnyis kyi bcas mtshams kyi rtsa ba mang po/ shing gi rang 'thag 'dis zhib tu bcug gda'i/ nyes pa la nyes par gzigs pa de'i tshe/ phyin chad legs par sdom pa'i slad du/ shing rag mun pa'i khang bur chug la/ dran pa'i sgo sdoms/ shes bzhin gyi sgo lcags rgyob/ bag yod kyi lhan tshal dkris/ ngo tsha'i skud pas 'chings/ khrel yod kyi dam rgyas thob la/ oṃ sarba dur+gha'i ṣi ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes sngags zab mo bgrang bar bya'o// ༈ yang khyed kyis 'di ltar/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' bstan bcos dang mi mthun pa'i rnam gzhag log par 'chad pa rnams ni nges par dgag rigs pa ste/ blang dor gyi spyod pa phyin ci ma log pa'i rnam bzhag phun sum tshogs pa rnams la bsngags bstod dang*/

de las nyams shing log par spyod pa dang*/ chos min pa la smod pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bya ba'i las yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du mdo sde rgyan las/ zhes lung 'dren mang po dang bcas gsungs pa ni kho bo la mgo 'dren du che ba yin no// zhes sku rtsed gyis mtha' brten par yang byas so// yang khyed kyis deng sang ni dgag sgrub cung zad re byas na/ de bstan pa'i dag byed du ma bsam par/ chags sdang gi kun slong kho nar mthong bas/ shin tu byed dka' bar gyur mod/ ces smra ba ni cung zad bden mod kyang*/ nyid rang gi thugs gshis kyi rang babs sam bcos ma ci zhig yin kyang rung*/ tshig gi rjod byed mi legs par mtho rdeg dmas rdeg mang po dang*/ gzhan tshig rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba'i smra ba nyung ngu la/ tshig mang don nyung gi skur 'debs dang*/ khyed rang gi tshig mang po la 'brel mi 'grigs pa'ang tshan grangs bdun brgyad 'dug pa legs bshad du bsgoms pa'i sgro btags rnams thugs ma tshad kyis 'ur 'jun du snang zhing*/ lhag par bdag bstod gzhan smad kyis sa dkar gyi skyes chen rnams la gshe ba ni/ dam par zhal gyis bzhes nas dam pa ma yin gyi spyod pa mdzad pa la bdag cag ma dad par/ skabs de dang der nyid la skur pa'i rnam pa'ang kha yar shor mod kyis/ de ni khyed rang gi nyes par 'khums pas bzod par mdzad du gsol// ༈ yang khyed kyis/ de ltar na yang chos kyi rje rnam dpyod can sangs rgyas rdo rje bas/ srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes bya ba brtsams nas bdag gi mig lam du smin pa 'di ni/ bdag cag dga' zhing mgu la yi rang ba'i rgyur son te/ tshul 'di lta bu mthong ba na bstan pa 'di la chos kyi rtog dpyod blang dor shes pa cung zad/ deng dus kyang yod 'dra'o snyam nas dga' bar gyur pa dang*/ khyad par chos rje sangs rgyas rdo rje bas/ chos la sbyangs pa nan tan mdzad pa'i grub 'bras su gsal bas shin tu ngo mtshar skyes la/

srid gsum dge mtshan na/ 'ga' re 'brel med kyi tshig kyang snang mod/ bstan 'chos kyi babs 'gros spyi rnams/ rnam dpyod yod nges pa mtshon byed du snang ba'i phyir/ shin tu yi rang bar gyur pas da dung 'bel gtam rgya chen po la brtson pa ma dor zhig ces legs mdzes kyi mol mchid mdzad pa'ang dge mod kyi/ so so skye bo'i blo gros dri ma dang bcas pas legs bshad kyi gter kha phyed pa dka' mod/ gser ri'i ngos la brten byas pa'i// 'dab chags gser gyi mdog tu snang*// zhes pa ltar/ sa dkar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' la brten cing*/ gong ma'i gsung rab la cung zad sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis/ ma 'tshams pa'i kha 'chal kyang 'ong don mi bdog kho bos chos la sbyangs pa'i grub 'bras dam pa'i chos la blo khugs pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la skyugs log pa tsam lags kyi/ 'di la dgyes par mdzad rigs so// ༈yang*/ khyed la ched du 'di gsol te/ blun po'i yon tan khar 'byin te// mkhas pa'i yon tan khong du sbed// ces pa dgongs pa'i za ma tog bkod par bzhugs su gsol nas/ gsung 'jam pos chos kyi gtam smras na mkhas blun phal cher dga' bar 'gyur gyi/ brlangs po'i tshig brjod pa la de lta ma yin pas na/ smra na yid phebs 'brel pa dang*// don gsal yid du 'ong ba dang*// chags dang zhe sdang spang ba dang*// 'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya// zhes gsungs pa bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes na bstan pa la phan mchis so// de ltar yang sa pa ṇ+ḍi tas/ chen pos nga rgyal bya mi dgos// ngan pas nga rgyal byas ci phan// rin chen tshig gis bsgrag mi dgos// 'ching bu bsgrags kyang su zhig nyo// zhes gsungs pa'i chen po de yang*/ skyes bu chen po'i bdag nyid chen po zhes grags pa de yin mod/ de lta bu yin pa dang ma yin pa'i tshul shes pa ni/ gang zag gi rgyud tshod mtho dman la rag las kyang*/ de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthu bdag cag mngon shes dang bral ba rnams la med kyi/

ji skad du/ mdo las/ du ba las ni mer shes dang*// chu skyar las ni chu dpog bzhin// byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi// rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes// zhes dang de bzhin du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ du bas me bzhin rnam thar las// nang gi yon tan legs brtags te// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gong 'og bar gsum gyi gsung rigs la rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas gzhal ba de'i tshe/ ji skad du/ srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes bya'i bstan bcos las/ dgos pa ci'i slad du zhe na/ kun slong ngan pa zhe la brnags pa'i ngan shags smra ba ma yin gyi/ rang gzhan gyi lugs 'dzin par rloms pa rnams la blo gros gyi mthu brtas pa dang*/ legs bshad smra ba'i sgo dbye ba'i ched du'o// zhes smras pa de'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa 'di ni/ dgos pa mchog tu grub pa'o// // dus gsum rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// thog mtha' bar du dge ba phyag rgya che// skal bzang snying gi bcud du 'bebs mkhas pa// grub pa'i gtsug rgyan dkar brgyud rin po che// gang gi ring lugs lha yi chu bo'i rgyun// sa gsum don du rgyu ba'i rba rlabs 'dzum// phyogs kyi 'khor lor 'grem pa'i ngo mtshar mthu// rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gzhal byar 'ongs pa bzhin// de las sa gzhi zla 'od ltar skya ba'i// thig ler chags pa ma hā paṇ+ḍita// kun dga'i rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgreng de yis// dpal gyi legs bshad bzang pos mgron du gnyer// des ni pad+ma dkar po'i tshal// blo gros 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor las// lung rigs ke sa ra bzhad pa'i// khu bas blo gsal lang tsho brtas// de tshe klu sgrub rgya mtsho yis// rtsod spongs dbu ba brdos pa'i mkhar// lan bzang ke la shar 'khrul ba'i// karka ṭa rnams kun tu rmongs// de dus ha nu man dha yang*// snying po'i bstan la dga' byed pa'i// grogs su sbran pa'i snying stobs mdas*// log smra'i 'bod sgrogs mgrin pa gcod// slad kyis smra ba'i seng ge zhig

/rgol ba'i ri dwags za 'dod kyang*// cher rloms 'thibs pa'i nags phug tu// lung rigs mche sder chag nas 'khun// de la snying rje'i gzhan dbang can// rnam dpyod mtho ris dbang po'i yul// skye mched rdzogs pas brgal lan gyis// bdud rtsi'i gru char sman du sbyin// de yi dge ba'i stobs kyis deng phyin chad// mngon rloms ma zhu'i nad gyis bdag bstod cing*// gzhan la smod pa'i bshal skyug kun byang nas// dag snang bzang po'i bcud kyis 'tsho bar shog /gzhan tshig ka la ping ka'i dbyangs 'gog cing*// rang tshig khwa ta'i skad kyang sgrub byed pa// 'khyog po'i smra sgo bsdam nas drang gtam gyis// dbyangs snyan phyogs kyi 'khor lor spro bar shog /gzhung lugs rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams kyi// rjod tshig rdul rer brjod don rdul snyed pa// smra ba'i lam du zhugs pa'i ltad mo la// longs su spyod pa'i blo mig 'thob par shog /rang gzhan lugs la 'dris pa'i blo gros smin// sgrub dang sun 'byin la mkhas spobs pa dag /'jam ran snyan pa'i ngag la dbang phyug nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /don zab rin chen snying pos yongs gang rgya che'i gtam gyis rlabs 'phreng g.yo// tshigs sbyor lbu ba'i do shal mtshar po phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i dpyid du yangs// legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho chen po blo gsal klu dbang kun dga' ba'i// bstan bcos che 'di rnam pa kun tu phyir rgol g.yul las dza yan tu/ /de yang*/ dkar brgyud gong ma rnams sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la gcig tu gzhol ba tshangs pa'i drang srong gi brtul zhugs la gnas skabs/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas co 'dri bar mdzad pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i zhabs kyis cung zad spros pa la/ mkhan chen klu sgrub rgya mtshos rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer cha lag dang bcas pa brtsams te/

sgrub brgyud ku mu ta'i dga' tshal zum par bzhed tshe/ de nyid kyi gnyen por gyur pa srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes bya ba/ g.yas su bskor ba'i 'gros kyis 'od zer dang bcas pa'i nyi ma khyur mid du byas pas re zhig ma snang yang*/ slar 'od zer bdun dang ldan pa'i gshin rje'i ba dan glo bur du phyar ba de nyid/ sra mkhregs rdo rje'i snying po mchog tu grub pa'i gtam zhes bya bas lhang lhang du brdzis te/ dkar brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs pa'i tshul 'di ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' 'bangs mang du thos pa'i dge sbyong*/ snying po'i don gyi sgom chen ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ku sā lis/ zad byed ces pa me pho stag lo/ mgo zla ba'i dkar tshes gsum la/ zla ba gro bzhin gyi khyim du bsus pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po'i nyin/ grub pa'i gnas chen rgyal gyi shrī'i bsam gtan gyi gling du grub par sbyar ba'o//
